chapters.title: Chapter 4539: Endgame II
paragraphs: In the Injunction Sanctuary of Law, within a grand domain in the shattered skies where authority itself seemed to crystallize into visible form, Alexander Asmodeus opened his eyes.

The moment his consciousness fully returned, he felt the glorious Absolute Sovereignty of Law permeating every aspect of his existence. The Shattered Part of The Heart of Law had integrated completely, fusing with his being at the most fundamental level.
His body radiated such pure authority that the very concept of lawlessness seemed to flee from his presence. Law emanated from him like light from a star, touching everything within range.

He could feel the pathways of power laid out before him with crystalline clarity. After all, this was a path already laid down and completed by another. Gaining False THE status would be trivially easy from this position, a simple matter of pushing his Sovereignty just slightly further along established routes.
But something made him hesitate.

There was a better route to take, he sensed. A path that would require more time and effort but would yield results that transcended the limitations of False THE entirely. The distinction was subtle but profound, like the difference between building on a flawed foundation versus taking time to establish something truly solid!
He would pursue the harder path, because mediocrity had never been acceptable. Not for him. Not for the countless lives inside his Enneagram!

As he rose from his meditative position, his body radiating waves of pure lawful authority, Deborah and her entire Legion of Laws moved as one. They bent the knee toward him in synchronized motions of absolute commitment.
Deborah’s voice carried reverence as she spoke.

"The Sovereignty of Law is clearly budding within you with utmost purity, taking root with strength we have not witnessed in ages," she said. "The Reclamation of Law can occur from this point forward. We will follow your lead without question or hesitation, so please, command us as you see fit."
Her words were not mere platitudes but binding commitment from one who understood the weight of such declarations.

Behind this display of loyalty, Seraphina Valorheart watched the scene unfold with eyes shining with fervor. Her expression showed genuine admiration mixed with something more complex, but really, it was just this girl being utterly smitted

Even further behind her position, the gazes of various Dukes of Law met each other with decidedly mixed emotions written across their features. They had genuinely hoped and expected for Seraphina Valorheart to be the one to take the commanding lead in the Reclamation of Law.
But this outcome seemed increasingly unlikely now!

Further behind even them, Riya, Malphas, and Kael stood among groups of Primus Inevitabilities that had been left behind to maintain presence in this place. They observed the proceedings with the detached perspective of those who served a different master.
Riya spoke with weight in her voice.

"More and more power accumulates in this place and these people as their eyes burn with hope," she said with quiet observation. "Yet none of them truly know that nothing has fundamentally changed. None of them understand that the variables they think they control are nothing, and even now...the light remains dim..."
Kael looked at her with confusion evident in his expression.
"What do you mean by that, troublemaker? Since when did you becime philosophical?" he asked with genuine curiosity.
Riya just shook her head with something resembling melancholy.
"Nothing," she said while turning away, a smile forming on her lips. "I just miss the Ancestor."
In another region of The Wandering Territories, The First Farmer opened his eyes.

He sat within a field of verdant-gold herbs that stretched to the horizon in every direction. Around his existence, extremely potent waves of the same verdant-gold effort permeated the atmosphere, saturating everything with concentrated authority.

He had already attained an extremely high level of power before THE Living Emotive had crushed his foundation. That defeat had set him back considerably, stripping away progress that had taken eons to accumulate.

But after consuming the Fruits of Effort, all that glorious accumulated effort had catapulted him back toward his previous Sovereignty with astonishing speed. The recovery had been faster than he had dared hope!
Right now, his goal was clear and unwavering: achieving the state of a Pre-THE Existence.
His daughter Elyndra walked over from behind his position, her steps careful not to disturb the surrounding herbs. She looked at her father with a question that had been weighing on her mind.
"Father, what is the fundamental distinction between False THE and Pre-THE Existences?" she asked.
The First Farmer considered the question with the patience of someone who had spent lifetimes contemplating such matters.

"False THE is a state where one has touched upon their Sovereignty and have laid a false claim over their Way, but has not truly begun walking towardTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty," he explained with measured words. "It is power borrowed or mimicked rather than genuinely claimed. Like wearing armor that belongs to someone else. It is easire to lay that claim over Existence, even if it is false...."
He gestured to the fields around them.

"Pre-THE is different. It represents genuine progress toward THE, actual advancement along that path. The difference is between pretending to be something and actually becoming it through proper cultivation. But False could lead to the truth."
His eyes focused on his daughter with paternal concern.

"For you, Pre-THE would be a distant dream at your current level of development, so False THE would represent a significant first step forward. But if I can help you avoid that intermediate state entirely, that would be far better. You would be able to genuinely grasp Pre-THE without the limitations that come from taking shortcuts."
Elyndra nodded with understanding before her expression shifted to something more serious.

"Father, something is approaching," she said with tension entering her voice. "The forces of Sir Osmont have informed me that an enemy at the level of a Pre-THE Existence may be coming. They say we need to prepare for potential conflict."
The words hung in the air between them with heavy implication.
The First Farmer rose to his full height, and as he did so, the fields around them seemed to respond to his movement. The herbs swayed in patterns that defied natural wind.

"Effort is the foundation of all growth," he said with voice carrying authority that made the ground tremble. "Farming is the art of nurturing that growth with patience and dedication. Many entities across existence believe that nurturers and farmers cannot be effective fighters."
His eyes gleamed with something dangerous.

"They hold this belief because they have never witnessed the true power of those who farm. They do not understand that one who can cultivate life can just as easily cultivate death. That one who understands growth also understands decay."
He looked toward the horizon where threats would eventually emerge.
"It may be time to teach this lesson to those who have forgotten it," he said with finality. "Let them come. These fields will welcome them, and the harvest will be bountiful."
BOOM!
His words carried the weight of absolute conviction.
The farmer was ready to fight, and that was a terrifying prospect for anyone who truly understood what that meant!

chapters.title: Chapter 4540: Merely Different Flavors!
paragraphs: Far from the current Era.
Even further past The Earliest Folds.
In The Infinite Unfurling, in a region where space itself had been shattered by conflicting authorities, a battle of apocalyptic proportions raged.

Tor,THE First Hunger, stood at the epicenter of devastation with seas of obsidian-crimson hunger radiating from his form in all directions. The authority pushed back against radiant purple waves of time manipulation emanating fromTHE Time Surfer.
But shockingly, she was no longer his only opponent.

Three more entities had arrived to surround him on all sides, each one radiating overwhelming waves of power atTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.Their combined presence created a formation designed to completely eliminate any possibility of escape.
FourTHEentities surrounding the lone figure of Tor!

And yet despite the overwhelming numerical disadvantage, Tor appeared utterly magnificent in his defiance. His form stood tall and unwavering, showing not even the slightest hint of fear or concern. His eyes pulsed with genuine brutality and anticipation, as if he was looking forward to the challenge.
The three new arrivals were impressive in their own right, each representing a different fundamental aspect of existence.

To Tor’s left stood a crystalline entity that seemed to be composed entirely of compressed space itself. Its body constantly shifted dimensions, appearing simultaneously near and far, large and small. Brilliant cyan light emanated from its form as it wielded The Way of Space with terrifying mastery. Space bent and folded around it automatically, creating layers of compressed reality that could crush anything caught within.

To his right floated a being wreathed in emerald flames that burned without consuming. Its form was vaguely humanoid but composed entirely of verdant fire that represented pure vitality and life force taken to absolute extremes. This was one who walked The Way of Vitality, having achieved Sovereignty over life itself. The flames pulsed with regenerative power so intense that the surrounding collapsed existence was actually beginning to heal and reform.

Behind him descended a shadow that was somehow darker than the void around it. This entity had no fixed form, constantly shifting between shapes that hurt to observe directly. Tendrils of absolute darkness extended from its core, and wherever they touched, light ceased to exist entirely. This was a master of The Way of Darkness, having claimed Sovereignty over the absence of illumination itself. The darkness was so complete that it seemed to devour not just light but the concept of perception.

Combined withTHE Time Surfer’spurple temporal authority, it felt like four terrifying bubbles of concentrated power. Four distinct domains of Sovereignty were simultaneously seeking to impose themselves and systematically crush the obsidian-crimson light of Hunger that Tor represented.
The pressure was immense enough to collapse entire Primordial Folds!
THE Time Surfer’svoice cut through the tension with cold calculation.

"Do you truly understand the nature of the thing you are protecting?" she asked with measured intensity. "It is an entity from another time entirely. A thing that should not possibly be capable of arriving in this era through any conventional means."
Her eyes gleamed with certainty.

"The only power in existence that possibly has the capability to influence temporal placement to such a degree is none other than THE Creature itself. And anything dealing with such a being is absolute taboo, a lost cause that brings nothing but destruction to all who touch it."
She gestured toward where Noah had disappeared.

"If the anomaly you hide possesses power relating to or derived from such a being, you would benefit immensely from studying it as well. So why fight against us when cooperation would serve your interests far better? We could all study and benefit from understanding that temporal impossibility."
Her proposal was delivered with false reasonableness, as if she was offering genuine partnership rather than thinly veiled threats.
Tor laughed with cold amusement that echoed across the shattered landscape.

"My Way is more than sufficient to carry me across all the Depths of Existence that matter,"he said with absolute conviction resonating through every word. "I have walked the path of Hunger for longer than most civilizations have existed. I have devoured many, many Sovereignties and integrated their understanding into my own."
His smile became predatory.

"Why would I possibly need to study some temporal anomaly or worry about THE Creature when my own path leads to heights you cannot even comprehend? Your offer reveals weakness and not strength. It shows that you believe external sources are necessary for advancement."
He paused for emphasis.
"I do not share such limiting beliefs."
At these dismissive words,THE Time Surfer’sexpression transformed from negotiation to absolute fury. Her composure shattered as rage flooded through her.
"Then it seems like Hunger will collapse here today!"she roared with voice amplified by temporal authority. "Your arrogance will be your end!"
The four Ways of Existence erupted simultaneously around Tor’s position with coordinated precision.

Purple temporal waves sought to slow his perception and movement to a crawl. Cyan spatial compression attempted to fold Existence around him until he was crushed into nothing. Emerald vitality flames paradoxically tried to force his existence into uncontrolled regeneration that would consume itself. Absolute darkness moved to erase his presence from perception entirely.
The combined assault was designed to leave no possibility of survival or resistance!
HUUM!
And yet, Tor laughed with genuine delight as his own Hunger erupted in response.

"You bring four Sovereignties to bear against one and believe this gives you advantage," he said with voice carrying across dimensions. "But you fundamentally misunderstand the nature of what you face."
Obsidian-crimson authority exploded outward with devastating force.

"Time is consumed by Hunger because all moments eventually end, devoured by the progression of existence itself. Space is consumed by Hunger because emptiness demands to be filled. Vitality is consumed by Hunger because all life requires sustenance to continue. Darkness is consumed by Hunger because the absence of light still represents something that can be devoured."
His eyes blazed with terrifying certainty.

"Hunger stands above all of your Sovereignties because Hunger is the fundamental truth that underlies existence. Everything that is will eventually be consumed. Everything that exists serves as potential sustenance. Your Ways are merely different flavors of the sameinevitablemeal."
He took a single step forward with deliberate intent.

And Decillions upon Decillions of obsidian-crimson jaws and teeth bloomed all around him with ravenous fervor. Each jaw was large enough to swallow omniversal systems whole. Each tooth was sharp enough to pierce through Sovereignties themselves.
They opened wide with hunger that had been refined across eons, ready to devour absolutely everything before them without discrimination or mercy.

The fourTHEentities found their attacks being systematically consumed before they could even reach Tor’s actual position. The jaws intercepted temporal manipulation and ate the concept of altered time.
They caught spatial compression and devoured the folded dimensions. They engulfed vitality flames and consumed the life force as fuel. They swallowed darkness and fed on the absence itself.
THE Time Surfer’sexpression became increasingly sour as she witnessed her coordinated assault being nullified with such apparent ease.
But something else was wrong as well.

All of a sudden, she found herself completely unable to perceive the immediate future that she had always been able to see with crystalline clarity. The temporal threads that normally extended forward from any given moment were becoming murky and dark.
Why...would the future be becoming obscured at this critical moment?
She did not like such a sensation at all. The loss of her greatest advantage filled her with instinctive dread.
Before she could process this development or adjust her strategy, seas of obsidian-crimson Hunger crashed down onto her position with overwhelming force!
The attack was not something she could see coming becausethe future itself had been devoured before it could arrive.
Oh!
Sometimes, existence demonstrated truths that were uncomfortable to acknowledge.

Even if one possessed the capability to see the future with perfect clarity, if a power sufficiently terrifying existed in the present, they would not be able to evade or meaningfully change that coming future regardless of what they could perceive.
Because some forces were simply too overwhelming to resist.
Because some appetites could not be denied.
Because Hunger, when refined to its absolute peak, consumed not just matter and energy but possibility itself.
THE Time Surferhad made the mistake of believing that seeing the future meant controlling it.
She was learning otherwise.
And the lesson would be written in blood, gore, and collapse!

chapters.title: Chapter 4541: Go Towards The Light!
paragraphs: Speaking of blood, gore, and collapse, there were outcomes far more devastating than simple physical destruction.
In another region of the Infinite Unfurling, far from the battles raging across multiple fronts, a singular figure arrived at a specific coordinate.

THE Living Originstood before a certain wormhole that Lumivara, Noah, and Stellara had passed through not long ago. Her body currently blazed with power at THE, the full weight of her genuine capability on display.

None of the weavings or limitations of Pre-THE could be detected anywhere on her form. She had clearly been concealing her true strength when she appeared amongTHE Time Surfer’sentourage. As for the reason why? Who knew!
But despite her overwhelming power, she frowned and did not enter the wormhole. As if she knew precisely what lay on the other side.
She remained outside the spatial anomaly, her white-gold eyes looking deeply into the distortion with intensity. When she spoke, her words seemed to be only for herself, a contemplation voiced aloud.

"Origins," she said with measured thoughtfulness. "What constitutes a true origin when one perceives a glimpse of that same origin manifesting on another entity, even if they do not belong to this time or place?"
Her expression became complex.

"Origin belongs everywhere it currently stands because Origin is the beginning point, the source from which things emerge. So if I see my own Origin reflected in another who should not exist here, what does that mean for the nature of reality itself?"
She reached out with one hand toward the wormhole without touching it.

"What is real, and what is false? If I exist here and now, am I the true Origin? Or am I merely an echo of something that will come later? Does the chronological sequence of manifestation determine authenticity, or does Origin transcend such temporal constraints?"
Her hand trembled slightly.
"What is real, and what is false?" she repeated with quiet intensity.
The question hung in the air without answer asTHE Living Origincontinued to stare into the wormhole, not going in just yet!
Meanwhile, past this wormhole and through the unique frequency barrier, inside a domain of concentrated authority and blinding brilliance...
InsideTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence of THE Creature, a scene of devastation and emotion played out.
The body of Stellara was breathing heavily with tears dripping steadily from her face. She was actually wailing with unrestrained grief, her voice echoing across the white-light landscape with pain.
This was a powerful entity who had cultivated strength for eons, now reduced to crying like a broken child.

The immense rage and pain she was expressing came through clearly in every sobbing breath. Her body looked torn and collapsed all over, with sections of her form literally unraveling as her existence began to lose cohesion.
Near her sat Noah’s figure, calm and unhurried.
He moved to sit beside her with ease, as if they were old friends rather than mortal enemies who had just tried to kill each other.
"Come on, why the tears?" he said with measured tone. "They will not change anything at this point."

Behind Noah, Lumivara looked over the scene with a profound trace of awe and shock written across her features. Noah’s figure had shown heavy injuries during the battle that were now completely healed, testament to the power of his Way.
The terrifying battle between him and Stellara, who had been stripped of her Pre-THE power by the domain’s mechanisms, had finally ended after what felt like an eternity of conflict.

It had concluded with a constant barrage of expressions of Noah’s Way that already superseded the Way of Light at fundamental levels. He had gradually worn her down through relentless assault, each attack proving that his Sovereignty stood above hers.
Until her entire existence had been decimated to the point where she now sat at the edge of unraveling completely.
And at that critical moment, she had begun to wail with grief.
Stellara’s emotional voice rang out between sobs as she looked at the radiant light suffusing everything around them.

"Since I first opened my eyes in existence, I dreamed only of Light," she said with voice breaking. "Having attained Pre-THE status, this perfect Light I was always pursuing felt so near. So close I could almost touch it."
Fresh tears streamed down her luminous face.

"But thenTHE Time Surferappeared and demanded I join her. Then all of this happened in sequence beyond my control. To be stripped of my Light by this domain, to lose to you..." Her voice filled with bitter rage. "To lose to afucking nobodylike you who apparently should not even exist in this time..."
Noah heard these words and shook his head with something resembling exasperation.
"What the fuck?" he said with genuine disbelief. "I was giving you your time to have your dramatic monologue and you use it to curse at me?"
Stellara’s wailing stopped abruptly as she looked at him with eyes that held nothing but exhaustion.
"I am already unraveling," she said with quiet resignation. "My existence is falling apart at the seams. Don’t be needlessly cruel and just finish it quickly."
Noah looked at her with before nodding with acceptance.
"You dreamed of Light," he said with measured words. "I will show you Light as you travel toward your collapse."
At such unexpected words, Noah opened his mouth unnaturally wide. His True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger was still active, burning through another Rudimentary Unit of Everything.

He allowed his opened jaws to surge with concentrated authority, manifesting as a singularity of radiant white light burning with the pure essence of The Way of Light itself. Light more perfect than anything Stellara had ever managed to create.
He turned his opened maw toward her as his voice rang out with finality.
"Go toward the Light," he said simply.
Stellara’s eyes trembled as she witnessed the pure Light emanating from Noah’s manifestation. It was everything she had dreamed of, concentrated into a single point of perfect illumination.

She raised her hand toward it with something resembling peace settling over her features. Her body turned into a glimmer of brilliant light that was instantly swallowed by Noah’s Hunger without resistance.
She disappeared into that perfect Light she had always sought.
Silence settled across the surroundings like a blanket.
Prompts bloomed before Noah’s vision.
|You have successfully defeated and devoured a former Pre-THE Existence.|
|Stellara, The Radiant Executioner has been consumed.|
|Complexity increased by: 166|
|Purity increased by: 166 Decillion|
|Grand Principle Fragments Acquired: Luminous Annihilation, Photonic Supremacy, Blinding Authority, Light Convergence, Brilliance Dominion, Purification Mastery, Illumination Genesis|
|Additional Boon: Your understanding of Light-based Sovereignties has been perfected.|
|Additional Boon: Your Way of Mana has been confirmed to completely supersede all Light-based concepts.|
|THE Organ of Civilization Progress: 1.2% toward THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|THE Rudimentary Units of Everything: 13/24 (Regeneration continuing)|
|You have consumed an entity who was on the path toward THE. Your growth accelerates.|
After Noah reviewed these prompts with satisfaction, he rose to his full height and turned toward the silent and thoroughly awed Lumivara.
"Alright," he said with calm certainty. "Let us have a proper look at this place, shall we?"
THE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence awaited their exploration.
And Noah intended to claim every benefit it could offer!

sentences.text: Speaking of blood, gore, and collapse, there were outcomes far more devastating than simple physical destruction.
In another region of the Infinite Unfurling, far from the battles raging across multiple fronts, a singular figure arrived at a specific coordinate.
THE Living Originstood before a certain wormhole that Lumivara, Noah, and Stellara had passed through not long ago.
Her body currently blazed with power at THE, the full weight of her genuine capability on display.
None of the weavings or limitations of Pre-THE could be detected anywhere on her form.
She had clearly been concealing her true strength when she appeared amongTHE Time Surfer’sentourage.
As for the reason why?
Who knew!
But despite her overwhelming power, she frowned and did not enter the wormhole.
As if she knew precisely what lay on the other side.
She remained outside the spatial anomaly, her white-gold eyes looking deeply into the distortion with intensity.
When she spoke, her words seemed to be only for herself, a contemplation voiced aloud.
"Origins," she said with measured thoughtfulness.
"What constitutes a true origin when one perceives a glimpse of that same origin manifesting on another entity, even if they do not belong to this time or place?"
Her expression became complex.
"Origin belongs everywhere it currently stands because Origin is the beginning point, the source from which things emerge.
So if I see my own Origin reflected in another who should not exist here, what does that mean for the nature of reality itself?"
She reached out with one hand toward the wormhole without touching it.
"What is real, and what is false?
If I exist here and now, am I the true Origin?
Or am I merely an echo of something that will come later?
Does the chronological sequence of manifestation determine authenticity, or does Origin transcend such temporal constraints?"
Her hand trembled slightly.
"What is real, and what is false?" she repeated with quiet intensity.
The question hung in the air without answer asTHE Living Origincontinued to stare into the wormhole, not going in just yet!
Meanwhile, past this wormhole and through the unique frequency barrier, inside a domain of concentrated authority and blinding brilliance...
InsideTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence of THE Creature, a scene of devastation and emotion played out.
The body of Stellara was breathing heavily with tears dripping steadily from her face.
She was actually wailing with unrestrained grief, her voice echoing across the white-light landscape with pain.
This was a powerful entity who had cultivated strength for eons, now reduced to crying like a broken child.
The immense rage and pain she was expressing came through clearly in every sobbing breath.
Her body looked torn and collapsed all over, with sections of her form literally unraveling as her existence began to lose cohesion.
Near her sat Noah’s figure, calm and unhurried.
He moved to sit beside her with ease, as if they were old friends rather than mortal enemies who had just tried to kill each other.
"Come on, why the tears?" he said with measured tone.
"They will not change anything at this point."
Behind Noah, Lumivara looked over the scene with a profound trace of awe and shock written across her features.
Noah’s figure had shown heavy injuries during the battle that were now completely healed, testament to the power of his Way.
The terrifying battle between him and Stellara, who had been stripped of her Pre-THE power by the domain’s mechanisms, had finally ended after what felt like an eternity of conflict.
It had concluded with a constant barrage of expressions of Noah’s Way that already superseded the Way of Light at fundamental levels.
He had gradually worn her down through relentless assault, each attack proving that his Sovereignty stood above hers.
Until her entire existence had been decimated to the point where she now sat at the edge of unraveling completely.
And at that critical moment, she had begun to wail with grief.
Stellara’s emotional voice rang out between sobs as she looked at the radiant light suffusing everything around them.
"Since I first opened my eyes in existence, I dreamed only of Light," she said with voice breaking.
"Having attained Pre-THE status, this perfect Light I was always pursuing felt so near.
So close I could almost touch it."
Fresh tears streamed down her luminous face.
"But thenTHE Time Surferappeared and demanded I join her.
Then all of this happened in sequence beyond my control.
To be stripped of my Light by this domain, to lose to you..." Her voice filled with bitter rage.
"To lose to afucking nobodylike you who apparently should not even exist in this time..."
Noah heard these words and shook his head with something resembling exasperation.
"What the fuck?" he said with genuine disbelief.
"I was giving you your time to have your dramatic monologue and you use it to curse at me?"
Stellara’s wailing stopped abruptly as she looked at him with eyes that held nothing but exhaustion.
"I am already unraveling," she said with quiet resignation.
"My existence is falling apart at the seams.
Don’t be needlessly cruel and just finish it quickly."
Noah looked at her with before nodding with acceptance.
"You dreamed of Light," he said with measured words.
"I will show you Light as you travel toward your collapse."
At such unexpected words, Noah opened his mouth unnaturally wide.
His True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger was still active, burning through another Rudimentary Unit of Everything.
He allowed his opened jaws to surge with concentrated authority, manifesting as a singularity of radiant white light burning with the pure essence of The Way of Light itself.
Light more perfect than anything Stellara had ever managed to create.
He turned his opened maw toward her as his voice rang out with finality.
"Go toward the Light," he said simply.
Stellara’s eyes trembled as she witnessed the pure Light emanating from Noah’s manifestation.
It was everything she had dreamed of, concentrated into a single point of perfect illumination.
She raised her hand toward it with something resembling peace settling over her features.
Her body turned into a glimmer of brilliant light that was instantly swallowed by Noah’s Hunger without resistance.
She disappeared into that perfect Light she had always sought.
Silence settled across the surroundings like a blanket.
Prompts bloomed before Noah’s vision.
|You have successfully defeated and devoured a former Pre-THE Existence.|
|Stellara, The Radiant Executioner has been consumed.|
|Complexity increased by: 166|
|Purity increased by: 166 Decillion|
|Grand Principle Fragments Acquired: Luminous Annihilation, Photonic Supremacy, Blinding Authority, Light Convergence, Brilliance Dominion, Purification Mastery, Illumination Genesis|
|Additional Boon: Your understanding of Light-based Sovereignties has been perfected.|
|Additional Boon: Your Way of Mana has been confirmed to completely supersede all Light-based concepts.|
|THE Organ of Civilization Progress: 1.2% toward THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|THE Rudimentary Units of Everything: 13/24 (Regeneration continuing)|
|You have consumed an entity who was on the path toward THE.
Your growth accelerates.|
After Noah reviewed these prompts with satisfaction, he rose to his full height and turned toward the silent and thoroughly awed Lumivara.
"Alright," he said with calm certainty.
"Let us have a proper look at this place, shall we?"
THE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence awaited their exploration.
And Noah intended to claim every benefit it could offer!

chapters.title: Chapter 4542: Existence Simply Is! I
paragraphs: InTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence of THE Creature, Noah and Lumivara began their exploration of the Outer Periphery.

The landscape stretched before them with deceptive serenity. Lush grasslands swayed despite the absence of wind, and flowers bloomed in colors that should not exist naturally. Floating landmasses drifted overhead with slow grace, each one pulsing with concentrated authority.
But beneath this tranquil appearance lay something else entirely.
The atmospheric authority was oppressive in a way that went beyond simple pressure. It felt intentional, as if the domain itself was aware of their presence and tolerated them only provisionally.
Noah’s analytical eyes swept across the environment. He noticed the nine scattered trees more carefully now, having finished dealing with Stellara and gained breathing room to truly observe.

Each tree radiated distinct frequencies of power that his enhanced perception could differentiate. One hummed with electrical potential. Another emanated waves of freezing cold. A third pulsed with rhythmic earth vibrations.
The trees were evenly spaced, and their bark was not normal wood but something crystallized, pulsing with faint light that matched the dominant authority each tree represented.
Most striking were the roots. They extended down into the ground and seemed to penetrate impossibly deep, as if reaching toward something far below the surface layer of this domain.
Lumivara walked beside him in her humanoid form, her fox ears twitching with nervous energy as she took in the environment.

"Master, I only dared to take some fruits before fleeing previously," she said with voice carrying lingering fear from that memory. "The moment I plucked it, the entire domain seemed to focus on me. The pressure became unbearable even in this outer area."
Noah nodded with understanding but continued moving toward the nearest tree.
The tree stood perhaps a hundred meters tall with branches that spread wide like grasping fingers. Heavy with crystalline fruits, each branch bent slightly under their weight.
As Noah approached, he could see the fruits more clearly. They were extraordinary in their construction.

Each fruit was roughly the size of a human head, with a translucent surface that revealed swirling storm patterns contained within. Purple lightning crackled through miniature clouds, creating an eternal tempest frozen in crystal.
These were not natural growths. They were something else entirely.
Noah reached forward, his hand extending toward the nearest fruit.
The moment his fingers made contact with the crystalline surface, the domain reacted with violent immediacy.
The atmospheric pressure spiked dramatically, increasing by orders of magnitude in a single instant. The white light suffusing everything brightened until it became almost blinding.
But instead of crushing Noah as it clearly intended, something unexpected occurred.

HisTHE Organ of Civilization, that impossible structure rotating within his mind, began ravenously devouring the increasedTHEauthority flooding the atmosphere. It drank in the concentrated power like a starving creature finally finding sustenance!
He plucked the fruit from its branch with deliberate motion, and as it separated from the tree, he activated another capability.
"Lens of Civilization," he said quietly, focusing his enhanced perception on the crystallized fruit in his hand.
New prompts materialized with shocking detail.
|Crystallized Fruit of Storms|
|Classification: Concentrated Sovereign Authority (THE-level)|
|Source Entity: The Storm Bringer|
|Source Entity Status: THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Source Entity Current Location: Imprisoned within the Inner Domains ofTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence of THE Creature|
|Authority Concentration: 87.3% purity and continuing refinement|
|Function: Crystallized essence of Storm Sovereignty continuously refined through imprisonment.|
|Warning: Consumption will grant understanding of Storm-based THE concepts.|
Noah’s eyes widened fractionally as he absorbed this information.
ATHEentity was actually imprisoned in the inner domains of this place. Not just imprisoned but having their authority continuously extracted and refined into these fruits!
His mind worked rapidly through the implications.

If there were different crystallizations of Sovereignties scattered across just this outer area alone, representing different fundamental concepts, did that not logically mean that multiple entities at THE level of power were currently imprisoned deeper within this domain?
The thought was genuinely terrifying when he considered the scale.

He had already learned from the initial prompts that this place’s primary function was the concentration and preservation ofTHE Civilizational Authority. That authority at THE level became trapped within this domain and concentrated in increasingly high density the further inward one traveled.
But for it to truly be an active prison that THE Creature was utilizing to hold terrifically powerful entities captive, what was the ultimate goal of such an endeavor?
Noah raised his hand upward as it began to burn with visible waves of blue-gold Mana and obsidian-crimson Hunger intertwined.

"O Creature," he said with voice carrying across the domain, though he knew THE Creature was not present to hear. "Just what were you doing in the Infinite Unfurling? If you were seeking to fully lay your claim onto existence itself, did you use these THE Unfurling Nodes of Existence to trap entities of THE Civilizational Scale for the sake of putting their different Sovereignties under your dominion?"
The question hung in the air without answer.

It was a working theory that he held based on available evidence, but it felt very likely to be the truth as well. The methodology was too systematic, too deliberate to be anything less than a grand design.

But regardless of what the actual truth was, since he found himself here with access to these resources, he would obtain as much benefit as he possibly could alongside gathering critical information before departing.
Noah plucked and brought many Crystallized Fruits of Storms to his mouth and consumed it immediately without hesitation.
The moment the crystallized bundles authority entered his existence, a violent reaction erupted throughout his body.

The Sovereignty of Storms flooded through him like a tidal wave of condensed power. Purple lightning crackled across his skin as winds that could tear apart mountains manifested and then dissipated. The essence of tempests, of atmospheric fury refined to its absolute pinnacle, crashed against his Way of Mana and Hunger.
And his dual Sovereignty systematically broke down and integrated the Storm concepts with ruthless efficiency.

Mana was the foundation of all phenomena, the energy that powered atmospheric interactions. Hunger consumed the storm’s fury and made it fuel for growth. Together, they dismantled the Crystallized Fruit’s concentrated authority and claimed its understanding.
New prompts bloomed before his vision with detailed information.
|CRYSTALLIZED FRUIT OF STORMS CONSUMED|
|Grand Principle Fragments Acquired:|
|- Atmospheric Dominion|
|- Lightning Genesis|
|- Wind Supremacy|
|- Pressure Manipulation|
|- Storm Convergence|
|- Thunder Authority|
|Understanding of Storm-based Sovereignties has been cataloged.|
|Your Way of Mana has been confirmed to supersede storm-based concepts.|
|THE Organ of Civilizationis integrating Storm Authority framework.|
|Progress: 1.8%|
|Note: Fundamental understanding of THE-level Storm concepts achieved.|
Noah felt the knowledge settle into his existence with tangible weight. He comprehended how THE Storm Bringer had walked this path and what insights they had gained before their imprisonment.
And most importantly, hisTHE Organ of Civilizationhad grown measurably stronger from the integration.
Behind him, Lumivara watched with eyes wide with awe and growing understanding of just how terrifying the Master she had chosen to serve truly was as he threw some fruits over to to her.
"Come on. Remember that I need to fatten you up."
Lumivara blinked rapidly while Noah moved ahead cautiously.
Eight more trees remained in the Outer Periphery!

chapters.title: Chapter 4543: Existence Simply Is! II
paragraphs: The sensation was a unique one that Noah had not experienced before.

At times, existence was difficult and required genuine struggle. He had fought against enemies who sought his death, each battle forcing him to prove that his Way superseded theirs through brutal combat and tactical superiority.

And then other times, like now, he simply had to walk around and pluck fruits that contained multiple different Sovereignties. Accumulated essences of beings locked away in this unfathomable domain, refined over eons into perfect crystallizations of their power.
After the Crystallized Fruit of Storms, Noah had systematically harvested from the remaining trees with methodical efficiency.

The second tree bore Crystallized Fruits of Metal that gleamed with silver-chrome perfection. When consumed, they granted understanding of durability, sharpness, and the unyielding nature that defined metallic Sovereignty.
The third tree held Crystallized Fruits of Wood, vibrant green spheres that pulsed with growth authority and the concept of organic expansion refined to absolute limits.
From the fourth tree, he claimed Crystallized Fruits of Earth, dense brown crystals that contained the weight of mountains and the stability of foundations compressed into singular expressions.
The fifth tree provided Crystallized Fruits of Water, liquid-filled translucent orbs that held the concepts of flow, adaptation, and the patient erosion that could reshape continents given time.
Fire came from the sixth tree in the form of ever-burning red gems that contained conflagration refined to its purest essence, heat that could unmake matter itself.
The seventh tree bore Crystallized Fruits of Ice, blue crystals so cold that space itself froze in their proximity, holding authority over stasis and the cessation of molecular motion.

From the eighth tree, Noah harvested Crystallized Fruits of Wind, seemingly empty husks that howled when touched, containing the freedom of air and the cutting force of atmospheric movement perfected.
And now he stood before the ninth and final tree in the Outer Periphery.

Throughout this systematic harvest,THE Organ of Civilizationhad proven itself to be a thing of profound wonder that continued to exceed every expectation. After consuming fruits from eight of the nine trees, it had jumped rapidly past the five percent development threshold.
10%, which would mean Pre-THE, was actually not far away!

The speed was genuinely insane when he considered that each percentage point represented progress towardTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.What should have taken eons was being accomplished in hours.

Beside him, Lumivara had continued to absorb the concentrated light suffusing the environment like a glutton finally allowed to feast. Her own luminescence had grown more and more intense until she rivaled the atmospheric radiance itself.
Now they stood before the last tree, and Noah consumed the final offering: Crystallized Fruits of Rage.

The fruits were unique among all he had harvested, appearing as pulsing crimson orbs that seemed to beat like hearts. They emanated pure fury refined into Sovereignty, anger so concentrated it had become a fundamental force.
As the rage flooded through him and was systematically broken down by his Way, Noah feltTHE Organ of Civilizationsurge with completion of this initial harvest.
Lumivara could not keep her eyes off of him throughout the process. When he finished integrating the final fruit, she smiled with wry understanding while speaking with unusual depth.

"The Infinite Unfurling is a grand domain of existence filled with wonders beyond measure," she said with voice carrying accumulated experience. "And yet for those weak like me, all the years of my life have been spent moving around fearfully from one place to another."
Her expression became more serious.

"I am actually lucky to have survived for as long as I could. For the many years before meeting Master, I have been hunted by others more times than I can count. I have hidden from those stronger than me while trembling with terror, sometimes even closing my eyes while knowing aTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentity was passing nearby."
She looked down at her hands.

"I would hope desperately that they looked down on me enough to not do anything against someone so insignificant. It is an utterly distressing way to live, but I would not change anything about it. It is simply existence as it is. And existence simply is what it is."
Her eyes lifted to meet his.
"Sometimes filled with light, other times filled with darkness. I think The Master is a source of endless light that I never expected to find."
Her words carried weight that went beyond simple gratitude.
Noah looked at her with a smile before reaching over to pat her head gently. Her fox tail wagged behind her with unconscious pleasure at the gesture.
Existence simply was. Nothing more, nothing less.
And—
"What a unique perspective that is."
BOOM!
A voice echoed across the domain with unexpected presence.
Noah’s smile faded immediately as his expression became cold and analytical. His gaze turned sharply toward the source of the voice.

He had not sensed anything approaching. Had felt nothing until the moment the words were spoken. But how could he have detected it when it involved the power ofTHE? How could someone at his level perceive such things?
Beside him, Lumivara trembled fiercely with instinctive fear. But for the first time since swearing herself to his service, she did not hide behind him for protection.
Shockingly, she stepped in front of Noah protectively, raising her small fists as if ready to fight despite the overwhelming gap in power.
Because the voice had emanated from behind their position.
And there, when they turned their gazes to face the source, stood none other thanTHE Living Origin herself.

She appeared exactly as Noah had observed her before in that distant confrontation. A woman of otherworldly beauty with features so perfect they seemed almost unreal. Her hair flowed like liquid starlight, shining with white-gold brilliance that created its own illumination.
She wore flowing robes that seemed woven from light itself, and her eyes held depths that suggested she could perceive the origin points of all things.
At this moment, her body emanated powerful waves ofTHE Civilizational Authoritywithout restraint or concealment.

And yet shockingly, the surroundings that should have been immediately locking down and systematically devouring all her accumulated power did absolutely nothing against her. The domain that had stripped Stellara of her Pre-THE status seemed to not even acknowledgeTHE Living Origin’spresence.
Noah’s expression became unfathomably heavy as he processed this critical observation.

THE Living Originwalked toward them with unhurried grace, her steps making no sound against the grassland. She looked between Noah and Lumivara with analytical assessment before her gaze ultimately came to settle on him specifically.

Noah kept his mind clear and focused amidst this unprecedented situation. He could feel The Barrier of Hunger that Tor had placed upon his existence, ready to activate if lethal threat manifested. He prepared himself mentally for anything that might occur.
And yet this terrifying entity in front of him actually smiled with what seemed like genuine curiosity rather than hostility.

She walked over and even moved past their figures without aggression, approaching the blazing barrier of white light ahead of them that marked the boundary to the second ring. She reached out with one delicate finger to touch the luminous wall, causing ripples to spread across its surface.
As she did this, she turned her head to look back at Noah with that same curious smile.
"What do you think about the idea of Origin?"she asked.
Beside Noah, Lumivara continued trembling but maintained her protective stance with admirable courage.
Even Noah had to pause!
This...wasTHE Living Origin!

He had only ever heard stories about her in The Earliest Folds. about her interactions with THE Creature that he now questioned more and more as there seemed to be parts of this story that nobody else knew.
She actually stood before him and asked such a question.
Noah considered the question carefully before responding with measured words.

"Origin is the point from which all things emerge," he said with calm certainty. "It is the foundation upon which existence builds itself, the seed from which complexity grows. But Origin is not singular or fixed."
His eyes remained steady on hers.

"Every moment contains its own origin. Every decision becomes the origin of consequences that follow. Every existence carries within it the origin of what it will become. Origin is not merely the beginning but the continuous act of beginning that occurs with each breath, each thought, each choice."
He paused.
He did not day the rest of the words on his lips. He only continued them internally!

’And because I walk the Way of Mana and Hunger, I understand that all origins ultimately derive from the same source. Mana is the foundation of change, and Hunger is the force that drives that change forward. Together they form the origin of progression itself...’
Toward his answer,THE Living Originsmiled with what appeared to be genuine appreciation. She nodded slowly before offering her own perspective.

"Origin, to me, is the purest expression of potential," she said with voice carrying profound depth."It is the moment before manifestation, the instant where all possibilities exist simultaneously before collapsing into singular reality. Origin is not what has been but what could be."
Her white-gold eyes gleamed with intensity.

"I have walked the Way of Origin for longer than most civilizations have existed. I have witnessed countless beginnings and understood that each beginning contains infinite endings within it. Origin is the most fundamental authoritybecauseit precedes all others."
She turned fully to face him now, her expression becoming more serious.

"Which is why I find it truly curious that my Origin, which begins here with me in this time and place, can also be sensed within you. An anomaly not of this era and not of this location. Why do you think that is?"
Her question carried weight that went beyond simple curiosity.
"Is your Origin real, or is it false?"
The question hung in the air between them!

After consuming fruits from eight of the nine trees, it had jumped rapidly past the five percent development threshold.
10%, which would mean Pre-THE, was actually not far away!

The speed was genuinely insane when he considered that each percentage point represented progress towardTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.What should have taken eons was being accomplished in hours.
Beside him, Lumivara had continued to absorb the concentrated light suffusing the environment like a glutton finally allowed to feast.
Her own luminescence had grown more and more intense until she rivaled the atmospheric radiance itself.
Now they stood before the last tree, and Noah consumed the final offering: Crystallized Fruits of Rage.
The fruits were unique among all he had harvested, appearing as pulsing crimson orbs that seemed to beat like hearts.
They emanated pure fury refined into Sovereignty, anger so concentrated it had become a fundamental force.
As the rage flooded through him and was systematically broken down by his Way, Noah feltTHE Organ of Civilizationsurge with completion of this initial harvest.
Lumivara could not keep her eyes off of him throughout the process.
When he finished integrating the final fruit, she smiled with wry understanding while speaking with unusual depth.
"The Infinite Unfurling is a grand domain of existence filled with wonders beyond measure," she said with voice carrying accumulated experience.
"And yet for those weak like me, all the years of my life have been spent moving around fearfully from one place to another."
Her expression became more serious.
"I am actually lucky to have survived for as long as I could.
For the many years before meeting Master, I have been hunted by others more times than I can count.
I have hidden from those stronger than me while trembling with terror, sometimes even closing my eyes while knowing aTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentity was passing nearby."
She looked down at her hands.
"I would hope desperately that they looked down on me enough to not do anything against someone so insignificant.
It is an utterly distressing way to live, but I would not change anything about it.
It is simply existence as it is.
And existence simply is what it is."
Her eyes lifted to meet his.
"Sometimes filled with light, other times filled with darkness.
I think The Master is a source of endless light that I never expected to find."
Her words carried weight that went beyond simple gratitude.
Noah looked at her with a smile before reaching over to pat her head gently.
Her fox tail wagged behind her with unconscious pleasure at the gesture.
Existence simply was.
Nothing more, nothing less.
And—
"What a unique perspective that is."
BOOM!
A voice echoed across the domain with unexpected presence.
Noah’s smile faded immediately as his expression became cold and analytical.
His gaze turned sharply toward the source of the voice.
He had not sensed anything approaching.
Had felt nothing until the moment the words were spoken.
But how could he have detected it when it involved the power ofTHE?
How could someone at his level perceive such things?
Beside him, Lumivara trembled fiercely with instinctive fear.
But for the first time since swearing herself to his service, she did not hide behind him for protection.
Shockingly, she stepped in front of Noah protectively, raising her small fists as if ready to fight despite the overwhelming gap in power.
Because the voice had emanated from behind their position.
And there, when they turned their gazes to face the source, stood none other thanTHE Living Origin herself.
She appeared exactly as Noah had observed her before in that distant confrontation.
A woman of otherworldly beauty with features so perfect they seemed almost unreal.
Her hair flowed like liquid starlight, shining with white-gold brilliance that created its own illumination.
She wore flowing robes that seemed woven from light itself, and her eyes held depths that suggested she could perceive the origin points of all things.
At this moment, her body emanated powerful waves ofTHE Civilizational Authoritywithout restraint or concealment.
And yet shockingly, the surroundings that should have been immediately locking down and systematically devouring all her accumulated power did absolutely nothing against her.
The domain that had stripped Stellara of her Pre-THE status seemed to not even acknowledgeTHE Living Origin’spresence.
Noah’s expression became unfathomably heavy as he processed this critical observation.
THE Living Originwalked toward them with unhurried grace, her steps making no sound against the grassland.
She looked between Noah and Lumivara with analytical assessment before her gaze ultimately came to settle on him specifically.
Noah kept his mind clear and focused amidst this unprecedented situation.
He could feel The Barrier of Hunger that Tor had placed upon his existence, ready to activate if lethal threat manifested.
He prepared himself mentally for anything that might occur.
And yet this terrifying entity in front of him actually smiled with what seemed like genuine curiosity rather than hostility.
She walked over and even moved past their figures without aggression, approaching the blazing barrier of white light ahead of them that marked the boundary to the second ring.
She reached out with one delicate finger to touch the luminous wall, causing ripples to spread across its surface.
As she did this, she turned her head to look back at Noah with that same curious smile.
"What do you think about the idea of Origin?"she asked.
Beside Noah, Lumivara continued trembling but maintained her protective stance with admirable courage.
Even Noah had to pause!
This...wasTHE Living Origin!

He had only ever heard stories about her in The Earliest Folds. about her interactions with THE Creature that he now questioned more and more as there seemed to be parts of this story that nobody else knew.
She actually stood before him and asked such a question.
Noah considered the question carefully before responding with measured words.
"Origin is the point from which all things emerge," he said with calm certainty.
"It is the foundation upon which existence builds itself, the seed from which complexity grows.
But Origin is not singular or fixed."
His eyes remained steady on hers.
"Every moment contains its own origin.
Every decision becomes the origin of consequences that follow.
Every existence carries within it the origin of what it will become.
Origin is not merely the beginning but the continuous act of beginning that occurs with each breath, each thought, each choice."
He paused.
He did not day the rest of the words on his lips.
He only continued them internally!
’And because I walk the Way of Mana and Hunger, I understand that all origins ultimately derive from the same source.
Mana is the foundation of change, and Hunger is the force that drives that change forward.
Together they form the origin of progression itself...’
Toward his answer,THE Living Originsmiled with what appeared to be genuine appreciation.
She nodded slowly before offering her own perspective.

"Origin, to me, is the purest expression of potential," she said with voice carrying profound depth."It is the moment before manifestation, the instant where all possibilities exist simultaneously before collapsing into singular reality.
Origin is not what has been but what could be."
Her white-gold eyes gleamed with intensity.
"I have walked the Way of Origin for longer than most civilizations have existed.
I have witnessed countless beginnings and understood that each beginning contains infinite endings within it.
Origin is the most fundamental authoritybecauseit precedes all others."
She turned fully to face him now, her expression becoming more serious.
"Which is why I find it truly curious that my Origin, which begins here with me in this time and place, can also be sensed within you.
An anomaly not of this era and not of this location.
Why do you think that is?"
Her question carried weight that went beyond simple curiosity.
"Is your Origin real, or is it false?"
The question hung in the air between them!

chapters.title: Chapter 4544: Conviction! I
paragraphs: Was his Origin real or fake?

Such a terrifying question was posed to Noah as he looked at the entity who asked it. His eyes burned with rapid calculation of just how this ridiculous situation could unfold in the next few moments.
For now, he had to establish himself clearly.

And so Noah’s body pulsed with concentrated light before moments later, brilliance of white and gold erupted to surround him completely. The pure Civilizational Authority of Origin flowed across his figure in waves, manifesting through his command of Primus Mana.
It was simply the transformation of Living Existential Authority of Origin expressed through his foundational Way.
While burning with such brilliant light that rivaledTHE Living Origin’sown radiance, Noah replied with absolute certainty.
"I am unfathomably real," he said with voice carrying conviction.

The scene was striking in its visual intensity. Two figures blazing with the same white-gold authority, one a THE entity who had walked this path for eons, the other an anomaly from another time entirely.

THE Living Originlooked at the brilliant light surrounding Noah with an analytical assessment. She shook her head with a sense of calmness mixed with barely veiled amazement before eventually speaking her observations.

"Origin innately loves to be where it should be,"she said with measured thoughtfulness. "And yet you are demonstrably not where you should be. There are very few reasons why an entity would be displaced across existence to such a degree."
Her eyes gleamed with sharp intelligence.

"Either they are simply very bored with their current circumstances, or the weavings of existence where they originate from are not favorable to their continued survival. Someone weak like you relative to the powers here would not be so bored as to voluntarily come to a place where you could be crushed at any moment by passing entities."
She tilted her head with conclusion forming.
"So I can reasonably assume that Origin, or at least your specific Origin, considers the weavings of existence where you are from to not be favorable. Not good at all, in fact."
Her eyes shone with ingenuity and power as she arrived at this critical point with shocking rapidity.
Noah looked at her as this being seemingly waited for confirmation. He spoke calmly without elaboration.
"No," he said simply. "The Weavings of Existence are not favorable at this time."
The words carried weight that spoke to catastrophic futures.
THE Living Originsighed with something resembling weariness and frowned with visible concern. When she spoke again, her tone carried warning alongside curiosity.

"Do not tell me more than what is necessary,"she said with unusual firmness. "Or really, do not tell me anything at all beyond the absolute minimum. Origin exists here in this time, and Origin exists there in your time. If you were to say the wrong things, you could unravel Origin across existence itself and collapse things you cannot even begin to fathom."
Her expression became more serious.

"The violation of temporal causality would be the least of the issues such revelations could cause. But since you came all this way and endured so much to arrive here, what exactly are you looking for?"
What was he looking for?
Such a question was grand in its simplicity. Noah replied with equal directness and calm certainty.
"I am looking for the power ofTHE," he said without hesitation. "I need to attainTHE Civilizational Scale."
His goal was unfathomably clear and unambiguous.
When she heard this straightforward answer,THE Living Originactually smiled with something resembling amusement mixed with melancholy.

"In The Infinite Unfurling, there are many who have achieved THE," she said with philosophical observation. "And yet all of them have their own profound problems that power alone cannot solve. Do you really think your problems could be solved simply by obtaining the power of THE?"
The question cut to the heart of assumptions.
Could the problems that he faced be solved by achievingTHE? Could The Fallout be survived if he possessedTHE Civilizational Authority?

This was the only thought that had been driving him forward with relentless determination. To make absolutely certain that he and those he loved would not be collapsed into oblivion in the near future.
So he replied with decisive conviction.
"Yes," he said with absolute certainty. "What matters is the power ofTHE. That alone is a good starting point for addressing what must be faced."
At such a reply,THE Living Origin’sexpression shifted subtly. She began walking toward Noah with measured steps while speaking words that carried unexpected weight.

"Okay," she said with decision made. "Since you carry the light of Origin within you and since the weavings of existence are not favorable in the future you come from, I can help you achieve what you seek."
She paused directly in front of him.
"But before I commit to this, I need to see and verify the Conviction of your Origin. The strength of your determination. May I?"
As her words finished, she raised her hand and it began shining with concentrated white-gold brilliance. She was asking him to allow her power to wrap around his existence directly, to not defend?

Noah’s existence buzzed as he contemplated such an action.THE Organ of Civilizationspun rapidly in his mind, processing risk and potential. He felt The Barrier of Hunger that Tor had placed upon him ready to activate at the first sign of lethal threat.
His eyes pulsed with decisiveness as he made his choice.
He nodded with acceptance.

He could feel the terrifying potency of the white-gold light in front of him, saturated withTHE Civilizational Authority of Originat its absolute peak. He looked into the calm eyes ofTHE Living Originand breathed steadily.
In the next moment, the light descended onto him with overwhelming force.
He did not fight against it. His intuition, his very Primus Mana, was what he was listening to and nothing else at this critical juncture.

The moment the terrifying light of THESovereignty of Originwrapped completely around his existence, Noah’s eyes began to flutter with sudden exhaustion. They closed in the next instant as if he had lost consciousness and fallen into impossibly deep sleep.
His standing figure went completely limp as it began to fall forward.
Lumivara yelped with alarm as she reached over desperately to catch him, but she was not fast enough to prevent the collapse.
The figure ofTHE Living Originmoved with speed that defied perception. She appeared behind Noah’s falling form and gently caught him before he could hit the ground.
She lowered herself to sit upon the grass with careful motion, positioning Noah’s head to rest upon her lap with surprising gentleness.
She studied his sleeping face with analytical curiosity while her hands moved to stroke his hair in an almost maternal gesture, observing the faint light of Origin around him.
Beside her, Lumivara trembled with fear and confusion as she asked with voice barely controlled.
"What...did you do to him?" she demanded with as much authority as she could muster against such an overwhelming entity.
THE Living Origindid not look up from her examination of Noah’s peaceful expression. Her hands continued stroking his hair with steady rhythm as she spoke with calm explanation.

"He is simply facing a test of the Conviction of his Origin," she said with matter-of-fact tone. "As long as his conviction is strong enough and his determination genuine, he will wake in a few days. If his conviction proves weak or false, he may never wake again from this sleep, forever remaining here in The Infinite Unfurling."
She paused before adding.
"Such is existence. Such is life. Conviction is either real or it is not."

After such heavy words, white-gold clouds began materializing beneath her seated figure. They wrapped around her and Noah’s sleeping form with gentle support as they began to lift into the air and float forward.

THE Living Origintapped her finger once against the air itself, and the radiant white barrier of light that demarcated the boundary of the Outer Periphery responded to her command. A sizable opening appeared in the previously impenetrable wall.
She did not turn around as she spoke to Lumivara with a casual instruction.
"Come, Little Light," she said while floating through the opening. "If you wish to remain with him, you will follow."
With such words spoken, this terrifying entity holding Noah’s head protectively in her lap floated deeper into an equally terrifying domain beyond the Outer Periphery.
Lumivara stood frozen for only a moment before her decision crystallized. She followed behind with determination overcoming fear, entering the second ring ofTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence.
Waves of mystery and unanswered questions followed them into the unknown!
What test was Noah’s Origin facing in his unconscious state?
Would his conviction prove sufficient to wake again?
And what exactly did THE Living Origin intend to do while he slept helplessly in her care?

chapters.title: Chapter 4545: Conviction! II
paragraphs: Noah stretched as if he were waking up from an extremely long and peculiar dream.
He blinked several times as his vision readjusted to his surroundings, and he saw the innocent blue eyes of a young woman looking down at him with a gentle smile.
She had locks of radiant gold hair descending gracefully over her shoulders, and her voice carried soft warmth as she spoke.
"I could not bring myself to wake you," she said with affectionate amusement. "And now you have caused both of us to miss our next class."
Her words were light and teasing.
Noah sat up slowly and observed his surroundings with careful attention. He and the young woman were on a school rooftop, their backpacks laid casually against the side of a low wall.

As he looked around, he saw a radiant blue sky stretching endlessly overhead with the distant sound of birds moving through the air. In the far distance, the shape of an airplane moved rapidly in the opposite direction, leaving contrails behind. The entire scene felt calm and profoundly peaceful.

The young woman whose lap his head had been resting on was adorned in the same uniform he also wore. Their uniforms consisted of crisp white shirts with blue trim around the collars and cuffs, paired with blue slacks. Simple but elegant in their design.
And her name was...
"Elizabeth," he called out her name lightly with recognition.
She smiled and reached over to stroke his head with familiar affection as she spoke with playful curiosity.
"Did you sleep that deeply?" she asked with teasing tone. "Were you having one of your fantastical dreams again? What were you this time? A king? A peasant? An emperor ruling vast territories?"
Her eyes gleamed with interest.
"Ooh, what was I in this particular dream?"
As she said this, she leaned close to him and tilted his chin gently toward her. Her lips took his in a slow, tender kiss that lingered for several moments.
After she pulled back, she licked her lips with satisfied expression and spoke with reluctant practicality.

"I want to continue this and have more, but we really do need to go," she said with mild regret. "We missed the psychology class, but we absolutely cannot be late for another one. You cannot keep getting me in trouble like this, okay?"
She showed a pouting expression as she rose to her feet, clearly intending for them to head downstairs before they could be caught by faculty.
And yet Noah smiled with something unreadable in his expression as he did not follow her movement.
Elizabeth blinked with confusion before her pouting expression shifted to something that almost seemed to want to be angry but could not quite achieve it.
"Come on," she said with gentle insistence.
And yet Noah shook his head with calm certainty as he spoke words that carried weight beyond this moment.

"You and I never used to come to this roof together," he said with measured observation. "I would come to this roof alone whenever I did not want to attend classes or deal with... social situations. But I would always be alone here."
His eyes remained steady on her.

"I could not even bring myself to talk to you like a normal person because I did not have any sense of confidence in myself at that time. You were this wealthy girl who did everything correctly and studied harder than everybody else around us."
He paused before continuing.

"I somehow considered myself fundamentally less than you and never tried to approach you. As nice a dream as this scenario would have been for my younger self,I do not think it is nearly enough to shake the convictions of my Origin."
BOOM!
Instantly everything froze completely in the surroundings. The birds stopped mid-flight, the airplane hung motionless in the distant sky, even the wind ceased its movement.
The figure of Elizabeth showed a ridiculously shocked expression as she spoke with genuine disbelief.

"What the hell just happened?" she said with voice rising. "This is just the first few minutes of the test! The influence ofTHE Civilizational Authority of Originis most potent and effective in the first few days when subjects would not possibly know anything about their true selves even if they had reachedTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty!"
Her shock transformed into something resembling indignation.

"I had a whole elaborate storyline prepared for you with multiple narrative arcs and emotional hooks. How the hell did you already regain your complete senses within the first few minutes of exposure?"
At such a question, Noah shook his head with calm composure and asked directly.
"What are you?" he said with simple inquiry.
The figure of Elizabeth pouted with genuine sense of anger and frustration as she responded with explanation.

"I am your potential future," she said with voice carrying both reality and impossibility. "The place we currently exist in can be considered simultaneously real and not real. It is real in that it will never be broken or shattered by external force, and it exists precisely between the gaps of potential...what is and is not in Observable Existence."
She gestured around at the frozen environment.

"This existing between those gaps is part of the reason why it can never be destroyed. This is as much a reality as any other, and this is existence as valid as any other manifestation. I am here to convince you to choose this reality over anything else that you might remember or think you have elsewhere."
Her expression became more earnest.

"In this domain, you can have whatever you want without limitation. Even if all of Observable Existence is destroyed completely, this domain would not be destroyed because it exists in the potential between observable and unobservable. Here you can live your life in any way you desire."
She stepped closer with enthusiasm building.

"You can speed up time for us to graduate school in the next few minutes. We could get married in another few minutes after that. We could have children in a few days. You could start your own company or get involved in politics or pursue any dream you ever had. Your parents can be with us here..."
Elizabeth seemed ready to continue listing endless possibilities as Noah stood and shook his head at this moment.
His expression became serious as he spoke with grand and imposing weight.

"My father was often drunk and my mother worked extremely hard to support us," he said with simple honesty. "That was my actual life, and that is acceptable to me. I do not particularly like who I was when I was young and insecure, but that is also acceptable."
His eyes burned with conviction.

"I learned how to become a better person through those experiences, and I currently have far too many people depending on me now. As pleasant as it would be to stay here in this comfortable reality and not worry about anything threatening..."
He raised his hand with authority.
"I have far too much that must be accomplished. My conviction is something that you can never even begin to imagine."

As he said this, he raised his outstretched hand toward the sky. From the distant blue expanse above, blue Mana began to leak through as if the reality itself was cracking. Soon enough, rivers of gold flowed into that blue, forming into concentrated Primus Mana.
All of it began silently flowing into his outstretched hand as he stood looking utterly glorious in his certainty.
Behind him, Elizabeth shook her head with complete incredulity as she spoke with genuine shock.
"You absolute monster," she said with voice rising. "Even if you were at THE Surface Depth, you would need days to-"
BOOM!
Primus Mana flooded everything in the surroundings with overwhelming force. The carefully constructed weavings of this reality shattered like glass under impossible pressure.
Noah’s existence buzzed with recognition as he found himself suddenly in an endless sea of gold-blue mixed with white-gold authority.
The weavings of Origin were unfathomably potent as in this moment, he felt something spinning rapidly in his head with unprecedented intensity.
THE Organ of Civilizationwas activating with full force.
Prompts bloomed before his perception with extraordinary information.
|An extremely pure authority stemming fromTHE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyhas been overcome based on its most stringent conditions.|
|Highest possible result has been achieved:THE Civilizational Origin Chains of Convictionwere shattered in minutes rather than days.|
|Extremely PureTHE Civilizational Authority of Originis now being systematically devoured byTHE Organ of Civilization!|
|Rapid metabolization ongoing...|
|Processing concentratedTHEauthority...|
|Integration accelerating beyond predicted parameters...|
|Estimate: After complete metabolization of all sensed Authority, the development ofTHE Organ of Civilizationwill exceed 10% completion threshold!|
|Warning: 10% threshold opens the doorway to Pre-THE Existence classification!|
|The Conviction of your Origin has been tested and found to be ABSOLUTE.|
The words were simultaneously, unfathomably, and magisterially glorious and heavy with profound implication!
An instant later, Noah felt his eyes opening to actual reality.
And the scene that greeted him was nothing short of incredulous.
He was looking directly into the eyes ofTHE Living Origin,who stared down at him with an expression of complete disbelief. He could feel her thighs beneath his head where he still lay in her lap.
An immense silence of shock and incomprehension settled over the surroundings.
THE Living Origin’smouth opened slightly as if to speak but no words emerged.
Lumivara stood nearby with eyes wide, clearly sensing that something impossible had just occurred!
