"I could not bring myself to wake you," she said with affectionate amusement.
"And now you have caused both of us to miss our next class."
Her words were light and teasing.
Noah sat up slowly and observed his surroundings with careful attention.
He and the young woman were on a school rooftop, their backpacks laid casually against the side of a low wall.
As he looked around, he saw a radiant blue sky stretching endlessly overhead with the distant sound of birds moving through the air.
In the far distance, the shape of an airplane moved rapidly in the opposite direction, leaving contrails behind.
The entire scene felt calm and profoundly peaceful.
The young woman whose lap his head had been resting on was adorned in the same uniform he also wore.
Their uniforms consisted of crisp white shirts with blue trim around the collars and cuffs, paired with blue slacks.
Simple but elegant in their design.
And her name was...
"Elizabeth," he called out her name lightly with recognition.
She smiled and reached over to stroke his head with familiar affection as she spoke with playful curiosity.
"Did you sleep that deeply?" she asked with teasing tone.
"Were you having one of your fantastical dreams again?
What were you this time?
A king?
A peasant?
An emperor ruling vast territories?"
Her eyes gleamed with interest.
"Ooh, what was I in this particular dream?"
As she said this, she leaned close to him and tilted his chin gently toward her.
Her lips took his in a slow, tender kiss that lingered for several moments.
After she pulled back, she licked her lips with satisfied expression and spoke with reluctant practicality.
"I want to continue this and have more, but we really do need to go," she said with mild regret.
"We missed the psychology class, but we absolutely cannot be late for another one.
You cannot keep getting me in trouble like this, okay?"
She showed a pouting expression as she rose to her feet, clearly intending for them to head downstairs before they could be caught by faculty.
And yet Noah smiled with something unreadable in his expression as he did not follow her movement.
Elizabeth blinked with confusion before her pouting expression shifted to something that almost seemed to want to be angry but could not quite achieve it.
"Come on," she said with gentle insistence.
And yet Noah shook his head with calm certainty as he spoke words that carried weight beyond this moment.
"You and I never used to come to this roof together," he said with measured observation.
"I would come to this roof alone whenever I did not want to attend classes or deal with... social situations.
But I would always be alone here."
His eyes remained steady on her.
"I could not even bring myself to talk to you like a normal person because I did not have any sense of confidence in myself at that time.
You were this wealthy girl who did everything correctly and studied harder than everybody else around us."
He paused before continuing.
"I somehow considered myself fundamentally less than you and never tried to approach you.
As nice a dream as this scenario would have been for my younger self,I do not think it is nearly enough to shake the convictions of my Origin."
BOOM!
Instantly everything froze completely in the surroundings.
The birds stopped mid-flight, the airplane hung motionless in the distant sky, even the wind ceased its movement.
The figure of Elizabeth showed a ridiculously shocked expression as she spoke with genuine disbelief.
"What the hell just happened?" she said with voice rising.
"This is just the first few minutes of the test!

The influence ofTHE Civilizational Authority of Originis most potent and effective in the first few days when subjects would not possibly know anything about their true selves even if they had reachedTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty!"
Her shock transformed into something resembling indignation.
"I had a whole elaborate storyline prepared for you with multiple narrative arcs and emotional hooks.
How the hell did you already regain your complete senses within the first few minutes of exposure?"
At such a question, Noah shook his head with calm composure and asked directly.
"What are you?" he said with simple inquiry.
The figure of Elizabeth pouted with genuine sense of anger and frustration as she responded with explanation.
"I am your potential future," she said with voice carrying both reality and impossibility.
"The place we currently exist in can be considered simultaneously real and not real.
It is real in that it will never be broken or shattered by external force, and it exists precisely between the gaps of potential...what is and is not in Observable Existence."
She gestured around at the frozen environment.
"This existing between those gaps is part of the reason why it can never be destroyed.
This is as much a reality as any other, and this is existence as valid as any other manifestation.
I am here to convince you to choose this reality over anything else that you might remember or think you have elsewhere."
Her expression became more earnest.
"In this domain, you can have whatever you want without limitation.
Even if all of Observable Existence is destroyed completely, this domain would not be destroyed because it exists in the potential between observable and unobservable.
Here you can live your life in any way you desire."
She stepped closer with enthusiasm building.
"You can speed up time for us to graduate school in the next few minutes.
We could get married in another few minutes after that.
We could have children in a few days.
You could start your own company or get involved in politics or pursue any dream you ever had.
Your parents can be with us here..."
Elizabeth seemed ready to continue listing endless possibilities as Noah stood and shook his head at this moment.
His expression became serious as he spoke with grand and imposing weight.
"My father was often drunk and my mother worked extremely hard to support us," he said with simple honesty.
"That was my actual life, and that is acceptable to me.
I do not particularly like who I was when I was young and insecure, but that is also acceptable."
His eyes burned with conviction.
"I learned how to become a better person through those experiences, and I currently have far too many people depending on me now.
As pleasant as it would be to stay here in this comfortable reality and not worry about anything threatening..."
He raised his hand with authority.
"I have far too much that must be accomplished.
My conviction is something that you can never even begin to imagine."
As he said this, he raised his outstretched hand toward the sky.
From the distant blue expanse above, blue Mana began to leak through as if the reality itself was cracking.
Soon enough, rivers of gold flowed into that blue, forming into concentrated Primus Mana.
All of it began silently flowing into his outstretched hand as he stood looking utterly glorious in his certainty.
Behind him, Elizabeth shook her head with complete incredulity as she spoke with genuine shock.
"You absolute monster," she said with voice rising.
"Even if you were at THE Surface Depth, you would need days to-"
BOOM!
Primus Mana flooded everything in the surroundings with overwhelming force.
The carefully constructed weavings of this reality shattered like glass under impossible pressure.
Noah’s existence buzzed with recognition as he found himself suddenly in an endless sea of gold-blue mixed with white-gold authority.
The weavings of Origin were unfathomably potent as in this moment, he felt something spinning rapidly in his head with unprecedented intensity.
THE Organ of Civilizationwas activating with full force.
Prompts bloomed before his perception with extraordinary information.
|An extremely pure authority stemming fromTHE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyhas been overcome based on its most stringent conditions.|
|Highest possible result has been achieved:THE Civilizational Origin Chains of Convictionwere shattered in minutes rather than days.|
|Extremely PureTHE Civilizational Authority of Originis now being systematically devoured byTHE Organ of Civilization!|
|Rapid metabolization ongoing...|
|Processing concentratedTHEauthority...|
|Integration accelerating beyond predicted parameters...|
|Estimate: After complete metabolization of all sensed Authority, the development ofTHE Organ of Civilizationwill exceed 10% completion threshold!|
|Warning: 10% threshold opens the doorway to Pre-THE Existence classification!|
|The Conviction of your Origin has been tested and found to be ABSOLUTE.|
The words were simultaneously, unfathomably, and magisterially glorious and heavy with profound implication!
An instant later, Noah felt his eyes opening to actual reality.
And the scene that greeted him was nothing short of incredulous.
He was looking directly into the eyes ofTHE Living Origin,who stared down at him with an expression of complete disbelief.
He could feel her thighs beneath his head where he still lay in her lap.
An immense silence of shock and incomprehension settled over the surroundings.
THE Living Origin’smouth opened slightly as if to speak but no words emerged.
Lumivara stood nearby with eyes wide, clearly sensing that something impossible had just occurred!

chapters.title: Chapter 4546: Absolutely and Unequivocally! I
paragraphs: THE Living Existenceswere surreal beyond comprehension.
Legends that shaped reality itself through their mere presence.
So it was all the more ridiculous that at this moment, Noah found himself waking up on the thighs ofTHE Living Origin.

When he had first heard the stories ofTHE Living Originfrom Moiraine and Sigrid as he delved into the Transcendent Folds while barely developing his Early Veiled Shore, these entities had seemed larger than life itself. Grand and untouchable, beings who had begun entire Civilizations and whose interactions withTHE Creaturehad become the foundation of countless legends.
Now, experiencing this directly, all of those stories seemed to be mixtures of fabrication and modified truth. They had all known each other in The Infinite Unfurling!

So all the dramatic tales ofTHE CreaturemeetingTHE Living Origin and Concept, of him going against impossible odds and Inevitabilities, ofTHE Living Paradoxconstructing elaborate scenarios whereTHE Creatureeventually gave his Everythings to Existence...they all felt like variations mixing lies with fragments of truth.

He remained confident thatTHE Creaturehad genuinely given his Everythings to Existence as the legends claimed. But the actual story behind that sacrifice had to be entirely different from what was commonly believed.
Yet knowing all of this, and now physically lying on the lap ofTHE Living Originherself, created a surreal disconnect.
Noah shook his head at the bizarre reality of it all as he sat up carefully. He felt his existence buzzing with profound fervor as in his mind,THE Organ of Civilizationwas developing at rapid pace.
THE Living Originlooked him over from head to toe as if he were some alien specimen she had never encountered before. Her white-gold eyes studied him with analytical intensity.
"The conviction of your Origin is Absolute?"she asked with a voice holding genuine curiosity.
At such a direct question, Noah did not immediately reply. Instead he looked around at their surroundings with careful observation.
They should be in the domain past the Outer Periphery now.
Prompts bloomed before his vision with locational information.
|You have been transported to:THE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence of THE Creature - Second Ring (Intermediate Periphery)|
|Environmental Classification: Moderate Concentration Zone|
|THE Civilizational AuthorityDensity: 347% higher than Outer Periphery|
|Ambient pressure will continue increasing the longer you remain, but an authority is currently offsetting the pressure. |
After reading the prompts, Noah took in the visual details of this new region.

The environment was dramatically different from the Outer Periphery’s serene grasslands. Massive floating islands drifted in the distance, each one surrounded by potent waves of different Sovereignties that created visible distortions in space around them.

Everything else was surrounded by such intense, brilliant white light that very little could be clearly perceived unless one had attained at leastTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty. The radiance was almost blinding in its purity.

The specific area where they currently resided offered slight respite from the overwhelming illumination.THE Living Originwas seated inside a small temple structure with nine white marble pillars rising elegantly around them. Rivers of liquid Origin authority flowed through channels carved into the floor, creating a network of glowing pathways.
Lumivara came quickly to Noah’s side with a profoundly relieved expression, clearly grateful he had awakened.
Only now did Noah speak, addressingTHE Living Origindirectly.
"What is your relationship toTHE Creature?"he asked with calm directness.
THE Living Originsmiled with something resembling nostalgia and remained seated comfortably as she drew in a breath.

"Many entities across existence believe that knowing the Origin of all things will make everything clear and comprehensible,"she said with measured contemplation. "But sometimes, understanding origins makes things much murkier and harder to truly understand. Knowing where something began does not always explain what it became."
She looked at him with ancient eyes.

"In this particular case, it is best not to know the Origin of certain relationships. But since you have passed the test with Absolute Conviction of your Origin, then The Sovereignty of Origin itself approves of your existence and purpose."
Her expression became more serious.

"If you need the power of THE, I can guide you toward achieving it. But any more direct help from me beyond guidance would actually hinder your development. Your Sovereignty should be elevating right now as you metabolize what you gained as you may even attain Pre-THE status imminently."
She paused with emphasis.

"But any more free assistance from me would stifle your Way and corrupt your Foundation. A Sovereignty needs to be forged from genuine struggle, not handed as a gift. Existence itself requires struggle to achieve meaning. You struggled to prove your conviction in that test. You would need to struggle for anything else of value."
She leaned forward slightly.
"Perhaps through that continued struggle, you will eventually find what you are truly looking for."
Noah’s eyes became sharp.THE Living Originhad gone on an extended tangent without actually answering his question about her relationship toTHE Creature. But he decided not to press the issue.
Instead, he spoke with shining eyes.
"I may have already found what I am looking for," he said with quiet intensity.
THE Living Originraised her brows with genuine curiosity at this claim.
"Oh?" she said with interest. "And what might that be?"
Noah nodded before explaining his insight.

"In that test of the Conviction of Origin, I learned that the unique space existed precisely in between Observable and Unobservable Existence," he said. "That it occupied the potential between what is observable and what is not. You... said Origin represents potential itself."
His eyes gleamed with realization.

"But even Origin can potentially be collapsed under the right circumstances. So if I could establish my domain or Civilization to exist in that same space between Observable and Unobservable Existence..."
Even Origin could potentially be collapsed, but something existing between Observable and Unobservable might transcend that vulnerability.
He spoke such words with dawning comprehension. The eyes ofTHE Living Originflickered with recognition before she smiled.

"So you wish to design a domain to exist between Observable and Unobservable Existence," she said with calm assessment. "That would be something you could freely accomplish at THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty."
She paused to let that sink in.

"You would first have to surpass THE Surface Depth entirely, then advance through THE Intermediate Depth, before finally attaining Fundamental Depth. Do you genuinely think you can achieve all of that on whatever time you have set for yourself? It is an absolute solution, but I am sure there are others."
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4547: Absolutely and Unequivocally! II
paragraphs: Noah’s expression became considerably heavier at these words. His existence continued to buzz with developing power asTHE Organ of Civilizationhad just passed nine percent development and continued breaking down the concentrated authority he had gained.
The possibility he had just conceived was not immediately achievable. The gap between his current state and what would be required was vast.
He turned towardTHE Living Origin, almost as if he wanted to give additional information. And as if she sensed this...she shook her head firmly before he could voice out anything.

"Focus on assimilating the gains you have already made," she said. "Take in as much of the pure ambient authority in these surroundings as you can manage. After you properly solidify your existence at Pre-THE status, we will need to leave this domain."

At these words, Noah frowned. He had wanted to continue exploring deeper into the Node, to absorb more and more Sovereignties from the Imprisoned THE entities. The potential for growth here was extraordinary.
And yet...
THE Living Origin’sexpression became extremely serious as she delivered her reasoning.

"As beneficial as this place may appear for your advancement, you absolutely cannot remain here,"she said with weight. "Because you are currently trespassing in someone’s home. And this someone will be passing by very soon."
Her white-gold eyes locked onto his with intensity.
"THE Creature will pass by this location soon. And you absolutely and unequivocally cannot meet THE Creature. Not now. Not here."
BOOM!
The words alone carried enough weight to shake reality.
He was a trespasser, and the owner of this prison-home would be returning soon.
The implications were immediately terrifying. Lumivara began trembling violently and grabbed Noah’s hands with desperate grip, as if pleading silently that they should leave even now without delay!
But Noah kept his eyes locked on the unfathomable gaze of THE Living Origin as a critical question formed in his mind.
Why could he absolutely not meetTHE Creature?
What would happen if that encounter occurred?
The answers remained unspoken, but the urgency in her tone suggested the consequences would be catastrophic!
Some meetings were fortuitous, opening pathways to elevation and unforeseen opportunities.
Some meetings were deadly, leading directly to collapse and oblivion.
Often times, it was extraordinarily difficult to distinguish which type of meeting one was walking into until it was far too late to change course.
The difference between elevation and collapse could hinge on a single moment of decision.
Far from the Infinite Unfurling, separated by unfathomable distances of time and space, in the current era where threats mounted from multiple directions...
In The Early Veiled Shore, within the Cultivation Citadel that Noah had established as a foundation for growth...
A battle raged with intensity that shook the very foundations of the contained world.
Leonore Rureaux and Riya clashed with tremendous force, both adorned in the Civilizational Armors of their Hungering Maw Specialization. The armors gleamed with concentrated authority!

Leonore’s body was surrounded by an obsidian-blue light representing Paradox fueled by Mana, creating distortions in space around her movements. Her attacks bent probability itself, making strikes land from impossible angles.

Riya’s body seethed with pure Primus Mana shining blue-gold with overwhelming potency. Her movements were precise and devastatingly efficient, each strike backed by the foundational authority that Noah himself wielded.
And in this duel, Riya was absolutely dominating, even in the elevated pressure!

She moved like a force of nature given human form. Her fist filled with seas of mana connected with Leonore’s guard and sent her flying backwards through a pristine forest. Trees shattered like matchsticks as Leonore’s armored form carved a destructive path through the landscape.

Riya pursued without hesitation, appearing above Leonore’s trajectory and driving her down into a mountainside with a devastating flurry of chained flaming swords of Primus Mana. The mountain cracked and crumbled under the impact!
BOOM!

Leonore rolled to her feet and attempted a counterattack, manipulating paradox to make her strike exist in multiple timelines simultaneously. But Riya simply flooded the area with so much Primus Mana that probability itself became irrelevant under the weight of foundational authority.

Another exchange sent Leonore tumbling across a vast lake, her armored form skipping like a stone before crashing into the opposite shore. The water evaporated from the sheer heat of their clashing powers.
"Okay, okay! That is enough!" Leonore finally called out with breathless frustration, raising her hand in surrender while lying in a crater of her own making.
She looked up at Riya who descended calmly to stand nearby.
"Why the hell does it seem like you are venting out your frustrations by bullying me?" Leonore asked with confusion mixed with exasperation.

Riya’s Civilizational Armor melded back inside her small petite body with fluid motion, revealing her figure adorned in simple blue bloomers and a blue tank top. She breathed out slowly with visible effort to calm herself before nodding with acknowledgment.

"I am very frustrated," she said. "I have never hated anything more than I currently hateTHE Living Elemental. I just finally got together with the Ancestor, and that flaming fucker puts out a curse causing him excruciating pain every single second?"
Her voice carried genuine fury at the injustice.
Leonore Rureaux raised her brows while pushing herself into a sitting position. Her own expression became more understanding as she responded.

"My lover just rescued me from a prison in the Heart of Origin that I had been trapped in for years," she said, "And now we are actively hunting him down because it turned out he was the Vessel ofTHE Living Paradoxthis entire time. You really want to play the complaining game with me right now?"
The words hung between them with heavy implications!
Riya’s expression softened slightly before she replied.

"At least you had been with your lover for some substantial time before complications arose," she said. "I had been dreaming about the Ancestor for so long. He only just began giving me the love and attention I wanted, and that elemental fucker immediately goes and ruins everything."
She paused before adding with intensity.
"Ah, it makes me want to fight something until it collapses!"
Her eyes pulsed with challenge as she looked at Leonore before sighing with resignation.
"Hoo... come on, let us not wallow in self-pity," she said while adjusting her stance. "Let us go again and work out these frustrations productively."
Her eyes began pulsing with beams of concentrated blue-gold light as she prepared to resume their combat training.
Leonore smiled with wry amusement and was about to shake her head in polite refusal when something unexpected occurred.
Her eyes suddenly trembled as shock flooded across her features.
Riya’s playful demeanor vanished instantly as she turned completely serious.
"What?" she demanded with sharp focus. "What just happened?"
Leonore Rureaux’s voice emerged in a daze as she spoke words that seemed difficult to process.

"Schrodinger...just reached out to me," she said with disbelief coloring every syllable. "Schrodinger himself, notTHE Living Paradoxwearing his weavings. His actual intent. His genuine will. Him as an individual consciousness!"

"My lover just rescued me from a prison in the Heart of Origin that I had been trapped in for years," she said, "And now we are actively hunting him down because it turned out he was the Vessel ofTHE Living Paradoxthis entire time.
You really want to play the complaining game with me right now?"
The words hung between them with heavy implications!
Riya’s expression softened slightly before she replied.
"At least you had been with your lover for some substantial time before complications arose," she said.
"I had been dreaming about the Ancestor for so long.
He only just began giving me the love and attention I wanted, and that elemental fucker immediately goes and ruins everything."
She paused before adding with intensity.
"Ah, it makes me want to fight something until it collapses!"
Her eyes pulsed with challenge as she looked at Leonore before sighing with resignation.
"Hoo... come on, let us not wallow in self-pity," she said while adjusting her stance.
"Let us go again and work out these frustrations productively."
Her eyes began pulsing with beams of concentrated blue-gold light as she prepared to resume their combat training.
Leonore smiled with wry amusement and was about to shake her head in polite refusal when something unexpected occurred.
Her eyes suddenly trembled as shock flooded across her features.
Riya’s playful demeanor vanished instantly as she turned completely serious.
"What?" she demanded with sharp focus.
"What just happened?"
Leonore Rureaux’s voice emerged in a daze as she spoke words that seemed difficult to process.
"Schrodinger...just reached out to me," she said with disbelief coloring every syllable.
"Schrodinger himself, notTHE Living Paradoxwearing his weavings.
His actual intent.
His genuine will.
Him as an individual consciousness!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4548: One Life! I
paragraphs: The words carried extraordinary weight!
A few seconds later, space rippled as two powerful presences descended into the training area.
The figure of The Infiniverse made her appearance alongside Khor, both of them radiating authority that dwarfed even the impressive powers Leonore and Riya had been displaying.
The Infiniverse’s voice cut through the tension with cold precision.
"What was the message?" she demanded immediately.
Leonore Rureaux’s expression became difficult to read as she formulated her response carefully.
"He wanted to talk with Sir Osmont," she said with voice carrying complex emotion. "Just... Sir Osmont specifically. No one else."
Her expression almost seemed heavy and lost as she delivered this information, but then her features became firm with determination.

"I can put my entire existence on the line to say that he is currently in control of his own consciousness," she said with absolute conviction. "ThatTHE Living Paradoxis not currently in control of the body. Schrodinger would not reach out otherwise."
She looked toward The Infiniverse and Khor with eyes carrying hope mixed with desperation.
"THE Living Paradox would be suppressed by existence itself if he tried to manifest directly, correct? So this has to be Schrodinger acting independently."
With such words, she searched their faces for confirmation or denial.
The Infiniverse regarded her with analytical coldness before speaking with simple directness.
"Where?" she asked without preamble or emotional inflection.
Leonore Rureaux responded immediately.
"In the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds," she said with specific precision. "A location where only he and I knew the exact coordinates."
After such words were spoken, The Infiniverse nodded with calm acceptance of this information. She turned her head to look at Khor with command implicit in her gaze.
"Get ready," she said with finality.
Some meetings werefortuitous.
And some meetings weredeadly.
And they would not know which this was until they arrived.
In the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds.

In one particular region, the convergence of two seas created a spectacle of impossible beauty. One sea flowed with gold authority representing order and structure. The other churned with obsidian power representing entropy and dissolution.

Where these seas met, they formed waterfalls that fell in opposite directions simultaneously. One cascade flowed upward toward an invisible sky while its twin descended into bottomless depths. Both defied gravity and logic in equal measure.

The beggar-like figure of Schrodinger stood before this paradoxical phenomenon, stretching his hand out toward the converging waterfalls. His tattered robes hung loosely on his frame as he felt the contradictory nature of the flowing authority.
Gold and obsidian. Order and chaos. Rising and falling. All existing simultaneously without canceling each other.
Behind him, space began to distort with massive fluctuations of concentrated power.
Millions of auras bloomed into existence with coordinated precision.
The emergence was breathtaking in its scope and organization!
HUUM!
Thirty million Primus Inevitabilities materialized in perfect formation, each one adorned in gleaming Civilizational Armor.
Ten million wore armor of The Infinite Bulwark Specialization, their forms radiating defensive authority with an allure of unique auroras of gold!

Another ten million bore armor of The Hungering Maw Specialization, their forms wreathed in obsidian-crimson hunger that sought to devour all opposition. Their armor was dark and predatory, designed for overwhelming offensive capability.
The final ten million displayed armor of The Vital Chorus Specialization, their forms pulsing with emerald vitality that sustained and regenerated. Their armor was verdant and organic.
And leading this terrifying army stood several figures of extraordinary power.

The Infiniverse herself commanded the vanguard, her form composed of flowing Omniverses, folds, and verdant-gold light that made her appear simultaneously vast and intimate. Her presence dominated the space despite her humanoid scale.
Beside her floated Arch Lich Ra’Zan, an entity of death authority commanding a terrifying legion of undead beings that radiated necrotic power.
Khor was present in her small diminutive form, but the waves of Hunger emanating from her tiny body were increasingly terrifying in their intensity.
And finally stood the figures of Leonore Rureaux and Riya!
Not too many. Just these few!
The tense standoff settled over the region like a physical weight.
The regal and majestic Infiniverse gazed at Schrodinger with eyes that carried no warmth or mercy. When she spoke, her voice cut through the tension with cold precision.
"Why would you be calling for The Master?" she demanded without preamble.
Yet Schrodinger did not reply to her initially. His gaze moved past The Infiniverse to settle on Leonore Rureaux with visible fondness mixed with profound pain.
The two shared a long look weighted with unspoken history and complex emotion.

Then Schrodinger moved his head away to look at the cold gazes of Khor and The Infiniverse. His eyes swept across the terrifying army of millions standing arrayed against him in disciplined formation.
When he finally spoke, his words held depth born of recent realizations.

"In existence, there are those who control the course of events, and those who can only follow the paths laid before them," he said with measured cadence. "I genuinely thought I was among the controllers for the longest time. One of those who operated behind the scenes and manipulated circumstances to achieve desired outcomes."
His expression became bitter.

"Only to discover that I was merely a piece being played and positioned over an extremely long duration. And now I am simply being moved across the board as another piece in a game far grander than I comprehended. The ones truly in control of this game arecruelbeings beyond measure."
He paused before continuing with intensity.

"THE Living Existences and THE Creatureare cruel beings who operate at scales we cannot comprehend. They look at existence in an entirely different manner than all of us. For them, our greatest struggles and deepest pain do not carry much significance in the grand calculation."
His voice became heavier.

"And right now, I stand before you as a direct consequence of that cruel indifference. BecauseTHE Living Paradoxhas decided to play what he considers an amusing joke on our existence. It is a simple joke at that, elegant in its cruelty."
Schrodinger’s eyes gleamed with something resembling resignation.

"The Fallout, the eruption ofTHE Loomthat approaches inevitably... countless lives across Observable Existence would be lost completely due to its manifestation. Decillions upon Decillions of countless beings collapsed into nothingness."
He raised his hand toward them.

"THE Living Paradoxhas staked all of those lives on the fate of a single being. On... the life of Osmont specifically. One life. One...life. If Osmont perishes, and Osmont alone dies beforeTHE Loomerupts... his Civilization will be spared from collapse. And more importantly, the weak lifeforms scattered across all of Observable Existence will also be spared from The Fallout’s devastation."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4549: One Life! II
paragraphs: His words were unfathomably heavy!

"This is the cruel weaving of existence that has been established by a being operating atTHElevel. And I am here as both messenger delivering this information... and executioner tasked with implementing this solution."
The moment his words finished, the gaze of The Infiniverse turned even colder and more imperious than before.
He was the messenger and fucking executioner? Was that right?!
Before any reply could be formulated, she rose slightly and floated ahead of the army of millions arrayed behind her. Her voice rang out with commanding authority.
"What is your Duty?" she called out with immensity!
HUUM!

Behind her, the booming voices of millions of Primus Inevitabilities adorned in their specialized Civilizational Armors raised their fists in perfect synchronization. The coordinated movement and vocalization resembled the immensity of Existence at an unfathomable level!
"OUR DUTY IS TO MANA AND HUNGER!"they roared with voices that shook reality itself.
The sound was overwhelming in its unity and conviction. Thirty million voices declaring absolute loyalty to foundational principles.
The Infiniverse pointed directly toward the calm figure of Schrodinger with cold finality.
"Thatthingstands between you and your duty," she declared with a voice carrying absolute authority. "An obstacle blocking the path.Clear it for me."
HUUM!

The Primus Inevitabilities shone with their respective brilliance as the millions specialized in The Hungering Maw prepared to surge forward. Their obsidian-crimson armor blazed with anticipation of devouring their target.
Schrodinger looked at the approaching army with calm gaze before his eyes found the difficult expression of Leonore Rureaux in the distance. He shook his head with something resembling regret.

"I told youTHE Living Paradoxwas cruel beyond measure," he said with quiet intensity. "His cruelty at this specific moment was transforming me completely into something you cannot oppose. Because...you all cannot do anything against me now."
After such ominous words, the reveal came with terrifying suddenness.
Schrodinger’s body unleashed a silent burst of obsidian light that expanded outward in all directions. A terrifying Way, a terrifying Sovereignty was being unleashed at full power.
Everything froze in the next instant.
Everything.

The charging Primus Inevitabilities stopped mid-motion as if time itself had ceased. The Infiniverse’s floating form became motionless. Khor’s diminutive figure hung suspended. Even the paradoxical waterfalls stopped their impossible flow.
Schrodinger’s figure stood glorious at the center of this frozen tableau. He raised his right hand and showed it shining with concentrated obsidian light.

"Chaos is fundamentally the natural flow of existence itself," he said with philosophical depth. "It is entropy made manifest, the tendency of all ordered systems to eventually dissolve into randomness. Chaos is not evil or destructive...it simply is the underlying current of reality."
Then he raised his left hand as it flowed with golden light of paradox.
"Paradox complements chaos perfectly because paradox represents the contradictions that chaos creates," he continued.
"Where chaos dissolves order, paradox makes that dissolution exist simultaneously with creation. They are two sides of the same fundamental truth."
The lights spun around each other with a sense of ecstatic beauty!
His eyes gleamed with realization.

"In the end, all of existence is simply a series of chaotic paradoxes playing out across infinite scales. Order attempting to impose itself on chaos. Chaos dissolving that order. Paradoxes emerging from the contradiction. An eternal cycle."
BOOM!
After such words, his full aura erupted and was unleashed without restraint. The brilliance he emanated exceeded anything they had faced before in direct confrontation.
Even measurements of complexity and purity did not adequately capture what was manifesting.
The pure expression of dual Sovereignties from Schrodinger created an effect that transcended normal power scaling as in this light was also an array of unique Grand Principles of Existence!
Everybody present was frozen completely as the aura he radiated reached a classification many of those here did not know or understand. But the most important among them knew.
Pre-THE.
Oh.
Oh!
Pre-THE level authority was being wielded against them!
Schrodinger spoke with a voice carrying across the frozen space.

"I hold no offense or grudge with the rest of you," he said with genuine honesty. "I hold no offense with Osmont himself personally. But the death of one individual, as cruel as the means ofTHE Living Existencesmay be... the death of one for countless others is a weight that a true Leader can and should bear."
He paused with emphasis.
"Sometimes a genuine Leader has to give his life for his people. This is the burden of leadership at the highest level. So tell me plainly:where is Osmont?"
At such direct demand, the frozen figure of The Infiniverse maintained her cold allure despite being unable to move.
Shockingly, her eyes pulsed with terrifying light of concentrated power. In her pupils, a small particle that looked like a mobius strip bloomed into visibility and began spinning rapidly.
Then it burned with intensity.
The moment it ignited, something was expressed through her being.
A True Expression of Sovereignty!

Her body instantly began burning with terrifying allure of power that she projected outward behind her position. The authority bathed the frozen armies of Primus Inevitabilities in waves of foundational energy.
The Infiniverse’s voice rang out cold and commanding despite her frozen state.
"Fulfill. Your. Duty."
BOOM!
The glorious scene that followed defied expectations completely.

All those frozen by the Sovereignty of Chaos began breaking out of their bindings one after another. Cracks appeared in the obsidian authority holding them as their bodies burned wildly with Mana and Hunger amplified by The Infiniverse’s True Expression that he had pulled out from...somewhere! From someone!
Among all of them, Khor was the first to fully break free.
She looked toward Schrodinger with eyes blazing with Hunger refined to absolute peak.
And she took a bite.
WAP!

All of the surrounding existence within her range became systematically devoured. Space, time, the paradoxical authority, even the concept of being frozen...all of it was consumed by Hunger that superseded lesser Sovereignties!
Then millions of Primus Inevitabilities surged forward like an unstoppable flood, their duty clear and their determination absolute!

chapters.title: Chapter 4550: Pre-THE! I
paragraphs: In regions scattered across Observable Existence, tears began to manifest with increasing frequency.
Not tears of sorrow but literal ruptures in the fabric of reality itself. Cracks spreading through the fundamental structures that separated domains which should never touch.
The Veil was breaking down with systematic inevitability!

A veil that had separated The Lands of The Living from The Lands of The Dead since time immemorial. A barrier that kept death from freely walking among life and prevented the living from casually traversing into death’s domain.
That ancient separation was failing.
In the Wandering Territories, in a region of multicolored chaotic seas where fold remnants drifted like ash from dying stars, something unprecedented emerged.

A massive shattered fragment of an Early Veiled Shore floated through the collapse like a vessel navigating impossible waters. The fragment was enormous, easily spanning hundreds of kilometers across its broken surface. Golden sands with fading colors still clung to portions of its structure despite the devastation that had clearly occurred.

On this floating remnant, terrifying auras could be felt emanating with palpable intensity. The immense waves of authority belonged unmistakably to The Dead, carrying the distinct quality of existences that had crossed beyond life’s boundary.
Yet at the very forefront of this vessel stood a singular figure who drew attention immediately.

A man with shining white hair that fell past his shoulders in elegant disarray. His eyes were crimson red with an intensity of both ancient weariness and barely contained violence. He wore a long coat that seemed to be woven from shadows themselves, moving with wind that should not exist in this collapsed region.
His features were sharp and aristocratic with pale skin. When he moved, it was with predatory grace that suggested extreme danger beneath cultivated civility.

His expression was unfathomably forlorn and sad, as if he carried burdens that could crush lesser beings into nothingness. Yet beneath that melancholy lay something else: irritation bordering on genuine anger at his current circumstances!
This wasDamian, The Disciple of THE Creature.
Around his body burned a crimson-gold light of glorious Sovereignty that immediately marked his classification. The authority was not merely False THE, which would have been impressive enough.
It was actually Pre-THE level power.
Oh!
Pre-THE authority wielded by a Dead Existence created a combination that was genuinely terrifying to contemplate.

Behind him stood a small but potent legion of Dead Existences composed entirely of Guiders of Order. Many of them radiated Complexity and Purity measurements in the Septillions or Nonillions, marking them as extraordinarily powerful entities even among The Dead.
Damian himself held power in excess of the Decillions.
He seemed to be clutching his head with one hand and shaking it periodically, as if something was causing him significant discomfort or annoyance that would not cease.
Behind him, the figure of Forgemaster Vulcan appeared with a concerned expression. The massive craftsman moved forward carefully before speaking.
"O Disciple, are you experiencing difficulties?" he asked with genuine worry in his tone.
Damian’s crimson eyes snapped to look at Vulcan with an expression that mixed exasperation with barely controlled fury.

"Big guy, do I look okay to you?" he said with a voice carrying biting sarcasm. "I am being forced to work against my will by your master. I wake up after sleeping peacefully for all of these eons only to realize that I am now a Dead Existence rather than living. And I can barely establish a proper connection with my actual Master anymore."
He gestured broadly with frustration.

"How exactly do you think I feel about this entire situation? And to top it all off as some sort of existential joke, I am being put to work immediately upon waking as if no adjustment period is needed. This whole situation just fucking sucks beyond measure."

Toward such a vehement reply, Vulcan found he had no adequate response. He looked up at the other Guiders of Order arrayed behind them, but they all deliberately looked away to avoid being drawn into this conversation.
At this moment, Damian’s expression shifted to something more focused as he spoke with command.
"Fuck it. No matter, tell me everything about this Osmont individual," he said with tone indicating this was not a request.
Forgemaster Vulcan blinked with slight confusion before responding.

"We can... certainly tell you about Sigrid instead," he offered carefully. "The one that Ma’am has specifically tasked us to retrieve. She has indicated that Osmont is likely at death’s door from the curse afflicting him, so focusing on Sigrid may be more-"
Damian raised his brows and yawned with deliberate power before cutting him off.

"In the future, when I tell you to do something specific,do that certain thing without offering me alternative options," he said with cold precision. "I asked about Osmont specifically. Tell me everything abouthimwithout deviation or substitution."
The command left no room for negotiation or discussion!
In another area separated by vast distances, in what had once been the Transcendent Elemental Folds, a different force was gathering.
Well, calling it the Transcendent Elemental Folds was not truly accurate anymore. This was merely the domain where those folds used to exist before recent catastrophic events.
Right now it was simply a region of immense collapse and devastation.

Brilliant pillars of light began shining in such a region as concentrated Sovereignties of Paradox and Elemental made their descent together. These were not full beings arriving but rather Avatars manifesting through projection.
Avatars from THE Loom itself.

Entities that originated from a small subsection of that grand and unfathomable structure. They had been dispatched specifically because an entity had dared to encroach uponTHE Primordial Civilization of Elemental.
Such transgression could not go unanswered.
At the forefront of this descending force stood the glorious figure of Ambessa. She currently wore a distinctly sour expression on her features despite her impressive bearing.

Yet her power was undeniably radiant as it registered at the level of False THE. Which meant her Way had been fundamentally tainted through compromise, and her path forward toward genuine THE would be made exponentially harder than it should have been.
Behind her position, other False THE entities could be seen arrayed in formation. Many of them pulsed with pure Sovereignty of Elemental.
They materialized fully and began looking around their arrival point with visible confusion spreading across their features.
One of them spoke with genuine bewilderment.

"I thought this location was supposed to be the Elemental Folds existing outsideTHE Loom’sboundaries," they said while observing the devastation. "Why did we appear in a region of complete collapse instead?"
At such questioning words, Ambessa looked around at the destroyed landscape with assessment before responding calmly.

"It is obviously because Osmont has collapsed everything to do with Elemental weavings of existence in this region," she said with matter-of-fact tone. "Anything connected to Elemental authority has probably been thoroughly shat on, destroyed, and collapsed. Lets just get moving toward our objective."
WAA!

Her words were somewhat rude and lacking in diplomatic decorum. The moment she finished speaking, the others showed heavy expressions as several of them shook their heads, as if they knew arguing or correcting her demeanor was not worth the effort.

They all understood their current situation with clarity. Even as False THE entities whose path ahead toward genuineTHEhad been made significantly harder, if they accomplished their assigned missions and gained the favor of an entity at THE Civilizational Scale of Existence, then anything became possible.
WithTHElevel backing, absolutely anything was achievable!
They simply had to successfully collapse Osmont and his entire Civilization.
That was all.
The forces were converging from multiple directions now.
The Dead marching from one angle with Pre-THE power leading them. The Avatars from THE Loom approaching from another with False THE entities in formation.
And somewhere in the middle of these approaching threats, Noah remained in the past withinTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence!
The pieces were moving into position.
And the question of whether his Civilization could withstand what was coming...was unknown!

chapters.title: Chapter 4551: Pre-THE! II
paragraphs: In The Infinite Unfurling, withinTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence of THE Creature, Noah sat with his eyes closed as he sensed his existence continuing to elevate upwards along with some additional profound changes occurring.

One of these changes involved knowledge that actually related to a connection he maintained across impossible distances. His connection with The Infiniverse and the paired consciousness of RUIN/EDEN was something as unfathomable as his Early Atlas of the Folds and how that artifact had ever allowed him to traverse to the Earliest Folds in the first place.
Through this connection that defied temporal logic, he was able to keep track of exactly what was happening in his current era despite being separated by eons.

He knew that circumstances were gradually becoming more troubling with his absence. He might have felt compelled to rush back immediately if not for the remarkable connection that he shared with his Civilization’s core consciousness.

That connection, paired with the fundamental ridiculousness of hisTHE Organ of Civilization,actually allowed The Infiniverse to pull a Rudimentary Unit of Everything from him across time itself. To extract it from where he currently existed in the past and transfer it forward for her to utilize in the current era when threats manifested.

Of course, this was impossible without substantial cost. To transfer a single Rudimentary Unit forward through time, an entire Rudimentary Unit had to be spent as fuel to make such temporal transfer possible.
So it was extremely resource intensive, even though it allowed such a terrifying capability to unfold when needed.
But at this moment, he knew precisely the dire straits his Civilization faced. He understood what enemies and opportunistic vultures were circling his people while he remained absent.
Ruination had already sent him the latest critical information through their connection. He knew exactly what Schrodinger had just uttered to his forces.
His life in exchange for the lives of all others across Observable Existence?

This was the cruel game thatTHE Living Paradoxwanted to impose? Noah utterly detested how these beings atTHElevel continued again and again to play with the theme ofsacrifice. To reduce complex situations to binary choices presented as inevitability.

And he now held a level of disappointment regarding Schrodinger specifically. Did the vessel truly believe the words ofTHE Living Paradoxabout saving countless lives? Or was his cooperation simply existence without the option of choice right now?

Either way, there existed a genuine level of danger for his Civilization. Especially if and when more enemies appeared beyond just Schrodinger’s forces, the situation could escalate beyond manageable parameters.

Even though he was capable of sending Rudimentary Units of Everything to The Infiniverse across time, the resource cost might quickly become unbearable. Or the power transferred might simply not be enough against overwhelming opposition.

But all of this precarious balance was about to change dramatically right now.THE Organ of Civilizationwas currently stuck at exactly 9.99% development, with this unique wonder that was something brand new to Observable Existence about to reach another critical milestone.
A milestone that would transform the Organ entirely and allow him to breathe considerably easier regarding his Civilization’s defensive capabilities.
As his eyes remained closed while focusing intensely on his internal transformation, he could sense the gaze ofTHE Living Origincontinuing to remain fixed on him with analytical assessment.
He took the words of this being seriously when she had stated with absolute conviction that he could not encounterTHE Creatureright now under any circumstances.

And he could already perceive her authority surging and wrapping protectively around both him and Lumivara. The transformation of his Organ of Civilization was taking slightly longer than he had anticipated for such a profound change.
She seemed ready to have them all evacuate this place immediately once his advancement completed.

His body continued to passively draw in the surroundingTHE Civilizational Authoritywith ravenous efficiency. He did not know precisely how many entitiesTHE Creaturehad managed to successfully lock away in this place as imprisoned power sources, but the number had to be genuinely terrifying.

It was disappointing to leave such a resource-rich environment, but when circumstances presented such a high level of existential danger, no amount of potential loot was worth risking the collapse of his existence itself.
As for when it came toTHE Creaturethemselves as an entity...
Noah liked to play the game of probabilities with himself extensively. He would calculate all the potential outcomes that could occur in his future based on available information.

THE Creaturewas one such entity that he had contemplated many times. He had asked himself repeatedly: if he ever met such an existence face to face, given that he had already encountered legends likeKhor, Tor, Anaximander, and now THE Living Origin, how would a direct meeting withTHE Creatureactually unfold?

In the past, he had assessed this probability as roughly half and half. Things could either proceed really well and lead to mutual benefit, or they could go utterly catastrophic with apocalyptic consequences.

Because his Way was The Way of Mana, and he was actively seeking to claim its foundation and immensity across all of existence. AndTHE Creatureheld The Way of Existence itself as their fundamental Sovereignty.

If the two of them ever looked directly at each other with full awareness, the potential outcome of becoming allies or enemies was separated by a very faint line that could be crossed with minimal provocation.
But the sheer conceptual idea of havingTHE Creatureas an active enemy would be something that would cause most beings to feel a sense of insurmountable pressure they could not possibly overcome.

Noah did not feel this overwhelming sense of pressure when contemplating such a scenario. Either he genuinely did not fear the idea of havingTHE Creatureas an enemy, or perhaps some part of him did not believe this entity would ultimately become his adversary. Maybe. Maybe!

But the probabilities of ever having to face such a terrifically powerful entity as an enemy in the future seemed to be shifting dramatically afterTHE Living Originhad spoken her warning with such absolute conviction.
He breathed out calmly as while processing all of these considerations...
BOOM!
His existence released a profound aura that expanded outward with overwhelming force. The immensity that his power reached was something far grander than anything he had wielded before.
It touched upon the level of authority that entities like Stellara had possessed.
The aura...of Pre-THE Existence.
It was the precise moment that hisTHE Organ of Civilizationreached the critical 10% development threshold.

It was also the exact moment that THE Living Origin sensed this eruption of newfound power. A brilliant white-gold light erupted from her body with decisive action, covering both Noah and Lumivara completely alongside her own form.
And the three of them disappeared from the domain with sudden finality.
WAP!
All signs of their presence in this location faded away completely as if they had never existed there at all. Everything returned to its original equilibrium state with systematic precision.
The ambientTHE Civilizational Authoritythat Noah had been consuming refilled automatically from deeper reserves. The pressure normalized. The atmospheric balance was restored to perfect equilibrium.
The only sign left behind was a purposeful one: a lingering aura ofTHE Living Origin’swhite-gold Sovereignty that remained visible to any who might observe.
As if she was deliberately letting it be known that she was the one who had been present here.
And only her.
Not the temporal anomaly that should not exist in this era. Not the mount who had consumed forbidden fruits.
JustTHE Living Originherself, visiting a domain that she had every right to access.
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 4552: Pre-THE! III
paragraphs: The Way.
What was the Way truly?
Noah found himself asking such a fundamental question as a sense of profound euphoria passed across his entire existence.

He opened his eyes and spread out his senses with newfound clarity as he explored where they had appeared. Him, Lumivara, andTHE Living Originhad materialized inside a small pocket of stable existence that seemed to be surrounded by unfamiliarly terrifying storms of multicolored instability.

The region they occupied was remarkable in its stark beauty. They stood on the peak of a floating snowy mountain that drifted through space with no visible means of support. Snow fell upward as often as it fell down, defying natural laws.
The mountain itself was surrounded by concentrated waves ofTHE Civilizational Authority of Origin, creating a protective bubble of white-gold radiance that kept the environment stable and breathable.

But all around this sanctuary, multicolored environmental regions pulsed with visible instability of Existence itself. These zones shifted between states that should not coexist: solid becoming liquid becoming energy becoming concept without transition. Colors that had no names flickered across surfaces that might not actually exist.
Even entities like Stellara with their Pre-THE authority could be systematically shredded apart if they ventured into such regions of instability without adequate protection.
THE Living Origin’svoice cut through Noah’s observations with an explanation.

"This place is known as the Unstable Genesis Domains," she said. "It is where all the accumulated entropy of the Infinite Unfurling is gathered and concentrated. A region where the fundamental instability of Existence itself manifests in its purest and most dangerous form."
She gestured toward the chaotic zones surrounding their mountain peak.

"This is a location that even THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entities do not like to visit casually. The instability of Existence itself actively reduces the effectiveness of all Ways of Existence that enter these domains. If one is not careful enough, they could heavily injure their foundation and corrupt their Way permanently."
Her white-gold eyes focused on Noah specifically.

"The instability here could very well shake you to your core and test everything you believe about your Sovereignty. This will be the place of your continued struggle as you enter this new phase of your existence as Pre-THE."

Before his transformation could even fully settle and stabilize, he was already being told of the hardship he would immediately be facing. Noah shook his head with wry acknowledgment and closed his eyes to focus on himself for now.
His mind returned to track as he contemplated the question he had posed to himself.
What was the Way?
Even while sensing the terrifying instabilities pulsing in the far distance beyond their protective bubble, he opened his mouth and spoke his understanding aloud.

"The Way, My Way specifically, is how I am," he said with a voice carrying conviction. "It is what I am at the most fundamental level.My character, my presence, my words, my weavings, my deficiencies, my strengths, my very being in its totality."
He paused to let the words settle.

"When I walk my Way,I am finding myself. I am discovering what I truly am beneath all pretense and assumption. When I lay a claim on my Way, I lay a claim on who I am. I establish Sovereignty over my own existence."
His eyes opened with intensity burning in their depths.
"If I say I have Sovereignty over Mana, then I am Mana itself. If I lay my claim on Hunger, then I am Hunger made manifest. The Way is not something external that I wield. It is me."
He smiled as his existence vibrated and pulsed with an ever-increasing aura of immensity and grandness.
"I am My Way. I am Mana. I am Hunger."
BOOM!
This was his affirmation as he arrived at a new stage of his existence with complete understanding.
In the next moment, a glorious transformation occurred that defied normal expectations.
Noah’s entire body turned into pure Primus Mana with startling completeness. His physical form dissolved as it became a swirling cluster of Civilizational Authority that condensed and reformed.

The energy shaped itself into a Lemniscate symbol, an infinity sign that rotated slowly in three-dimensional space. The symbol pulsed with concentrated power before releasing a massive burst of blue-gold light.
HUUM!
The radiance spread outward for Gigaparsecs in all directions!
BOOM!

THE Living Origin’sexpression shifted dramatically as she witnessed this transformation. Her features became extremely grim, as if she had just observed something inherently impossible and extremely problematic occurring before her eyes as she saw the expression of his Way.
Yet this shocked expression faded rapidly as she forced herself to calm and regain composure.
Lumivara simply stared with wonder and awe at the magnificent display, her fox ears twitching with barely contained excitement.

At such a critical moment, Noah’s perception was grand enough to manage observing the brief flash of concern onTHE Living Origin’sfeatures. He noted it carefully but could not and did not address it right now.
Because his focus absolutely had to remain on himself and the ridiculous sense of euphoria his existence felt at achieving Pre-THE status.
Prompts bloomed before his vision with detailed information about his advancement.
|MAJOR MILESTONE ACHIEVED|
|THE Organ of Civilization Development: 10.00%|
|Classification Upgraded: PRE-THE EXISTENCE|
|You have taken the first genuine steps towardTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.|
|THE Civilizational Authority Resistance has been elevated to 10%.|
|THE Rudimentary Units of Everything:Maximum capacity increased from 24 to 81 units, and the usage of a single one now lasts 3 minutes|
|Current Status: 43/81 |
|THE Rudimentary Units of Everythinghave begun an active process.|
|Function: Passively transforming all forms of Authority within your existence.|
|Conversion Target: Pre-THE Civilizational Authority of Existence|
|Progress: Ongoing and irreversible.|
|Effect: Your baseline power will continuously elevate until transformation completes.|
|THE True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hungerare now seamless with your existence.|
|Note: Your Way and your existence have become indistinguishable.|
Noah’s form of vibrant pure energy vibrated with satisfaction as the information he was receiving so far was already grand beyond his expectations.
But he knew from experience that the best revelations were always reserved for last in these systematic updates.
And this intuition turned out to be absolutely correct as in the next moment, new prompts materialized with extraordinary implications.
|After extensive exposure to the authorities and mechanisms ofTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence of THE Creature, THE Organ of Civilizationhas comprehended a unique methodology of existence.|
|New Construction Initiated:THE Infinite Desmoterion|
|Classification: Sovereign Prison Domain|
|Primary Function: Irreversible imprisonment of entities who have laid claim on a Sovereignty.|
|Secondary Function: Perpetual refinement and exploitation of imprisoned Sovereignties.|
|Mechanism: Conquered enemies are placed withinTHE Infinite Desmoterionwhere they exist in a state of enforced cultivation under dilated temporal flow.|
|CORE FEATURES|
|Temporal Dilation: Time flows 1,000x faster within the prison relative to external reality.|
|Mana Influence: All imprisoned entities become gradually influenced by Mana as the foundational authority.|
|Forced Refinement: Prisoners are compelled to continue refining their Ways and advancing their Sovereignties.|
|Advancement Reflection: Any progress made by prisoners reflects as direct boons to your own Way of Existence.|
|Authority Extraction: Refined Sovereignty essence can be harvested periodically as Crystallized Fragments.|
|Escape Prevention: Domain is anchored toTHE Organ of Civilizationitself, making escape impossible as the process itself is irreversible|
|Current Maximum Prisoners: 9 entities with established Sovereignties|
|Capacity increases withTHE Organ of Civilizationdevelopment.|
|Can only imprison entities you have personally defeated in combat.|
|Prisoners retain consciousness and awareness of their imprisonment.|
|Extremely powerful entities may resist Mana influence.|
|Creating and maintaining the domain requires continuous expenditure of 10 Rudimentary Units of Everything every 24 hours.|
|Prisoner Slots Unlocked: 9/9|
|Active Prisoners: 0/9|
|Maintenance Cost: Inactive (no prisoners currently held)|
|Domain Stability: Absolute|

After Noah looked at the absolutely ridiculous prompts outliningTHE Infinite Desmoterionand all its implications, he could only focus on reading them again just to be completely certain of what he was seeing.
Sometimes, things seemed so ridiculously advantageous that one had to verify their understanding multiple times.
He was essentially being given his own personal prison-cultivation-farm where defeated enemies would be forced to eternally refine their Ways while he harvested the benefits of their progress.
It... was horrifying in its efficiency.
And absolutely perfect for someone walking the path of Mana and Hunger!
