But all around this sanctuary, multicolored environmental regions pulsed with visible instability of Existence itself.
These zones shifted between states that should not coexist: solid becoming liquid becoming energy becoming concept without transition.
Colors that had no names flickered across surfaces that might not actually exist.
Even entities like Stellara with their Pre-THE authority could be systematically shredded apart if they ventured into such regions of instability without adequate protection.
THE Living Origin’svoice cut through Noah’s observations with an explanation.
"This place is known as the Unstable Genesis Domains," she said.
"It is where all the accumulated entropy of the Infinite Unfurling is gathered and concentrated.
A region where the fundamental instability of Existence itself manifests in its purest and most dangerous form."
She gestured toward the chaotic zones surrounding their mountain peak.
"This is a location that even THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entities do not like to visit casually.
The instability of Existence itself actively reduces the effectiveness of all Ways of Existence that enter these domains.
If one is not careful enough, they could heavily injure their foundation and corrupt their Way permanently."
Her white-gold eyes focused on Noah specifically.
"The instability here could very well shake you to your core and test everything you believe about your Sovereignty.
This will be the place of your continued struggle as you enter this new phase of your existence as Pre-THE."
Before his transformation could even fully settle and stabilize, he was already being told of the hardship he would immediately be facing.
Noah shook his head with wry acknowledgment and closed his eyes to focus on himself for now.
His mind returned to track as he contemplated the question he had posed to himself.
What was the Way?
Even while sensing the terrifying instabilities pulsing in the far distance beyond their protective bubble, he opened his mouth and spoke his understanding aloud.
"The Way, My Way specifically, is how I am," he said with a voice carrying conviction.
"It is what I am at the most fundamental level.My character, my presence, my words, my weavings, my deficiencies, my strengths, my very being in its totality."
He paused to let the words settle.
"When I walk my Way,I am finding myself.
I am discovering what I truly am beneath all pretense and assumption.
When I lay a claim on my Way, I lay a claim on who I am.
I establish Sovereignty over my own existence."
His eyes opened with intensity burning in their depths.
"If I say I have Sovereignty over Mana, then I am Mana itself.
If I lay my claim on Hunger, then I am Hunger made manifest.
The Way is not something external that I wield.
It is me."
He smiled as his existence vibrated and pulsed with an ever-increasing aura of immensity and grandness.
"I am My Way.
I am Mana.
I am Hunger."
BOOM!
This was his affirmation as he arrived at a new stage of his existence with complete understanding.
In the next moment, a glorious transformation occurred that defied normal expectations.
Noah’s entire body turned into pure Primus Mana with startling completeness.
His physical form dissolved as it became a swirling cluster of Civilizational Authority that condensed and reformed.
The energy shaped itself into a Lemniscate symbol, an infinity sign that rotated slowly in three-dimensional space.
The symbol pulsed with concentrated power before releasing a massive burst of blue-gold light.
HUUM!
The radiance spread outward for Gigaparsecs in all directions!
BOOM!
THE Living Origin’sexpression shifted dramatically as she witnessed this transformation.
Her features became extremely grim, as if she had just observed something inherently impossible and extremely problematic occurring before her eyes as she saw the expression of his Way.
Yet this shocked expression faded rapidly as she forced herself to calm and regain composure.
Lumivara simply stared with wonder and awe at the magnificent display, her fox ears twitching with barely contained excitement.
At such a critical moment, Noah’s perception was grand enough to manage observing the brief flash of concern onTHE Living Origin’sfeatures.
He noted it carefully but could not and did not address it right now.
Because his focus absolutely had to remain on himself and the ridiculous sense of euphoria his existence felt at achieving Pre-THE status.
Prompts bloomed before his vision with detailed information about his advancement.
|MAJOR MILESTONE ACHIEVED|
|THE Organ of Civilization Development: 10.00%|
|Classification Upgraded: PRE-THE EXISTENCE|
|You have taken the first genuine steps towardTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.|
|THE Civilizational Authority Resistance has been elevated to 10%.|
|THE Rudimentary Units of Everything:Maximum capacity increased from 24 to 81 units, and the usage of a single one now lasts 3 minutes|
|Current Status: 43/81 |
|THE Rudimentary Units of Everythinghave begun an active process.|
|Function: Passively transforming all forms of Authority within your existence.|
|Conversion Target: Pre-THE Civilizational Authority of Existence|
|Progress: Ongoing and irreversible.|
|Effect: Your baseline power will continuously elevate until transformation completes.|
|THE True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hungerare now seamless with your existence.|
|Note: Your Way and your existence have become indistinguishable.|
Noah’s form of vibrant pure energy vibrated with satisfaction as the information he was receiving so far was already grand beyond his expectations.
But he knew from experience that the best revelations were always reserved for last in these systematic updates.
And this intuition turned out to be absolutely correct as in the next moment, new prompts materialized with extraordinary implications.
|After extensive exposure to the authorities and mechanisms ofTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence of THE Creature, THE Organ of Civilizationhas comprehended a unique methodology of existence.|
|New Construction Initiated:THE Infinite Desmoterion|
|Classification: Sovereign Prison Domain|
|Primary Function: Irreversible imprisonment of entities who have laid claim on a Sovereignty.|
|Secondary Function: Perpetual refinement and exploitation of imprisoned Sovereignties.|
|Mechanism: Conquered enemies are placed withinTHE Infinite Desmoterionwhere they exist in a state of enforced cultivation under dilated temporal flow.|
|CORE FEATURES|
|Temporal Dilation: Time flows 1,000x faster within the prison relative to external reality.|
|Mana Influence: All imprisoned entities become gradually influenced by Mana as the foundational authority.|
|Forced Refinement: Prisoners are compelled to continue refining their Ways and advancing their Sovereignties.|
|Advancement Reflection: Any progress made by prisoners reflects as direct boons to your own Way of Existence.|
|Authority Extraction: Refined Sovereignty essence can be harvested periodically as Crystallized Fragments.|
|Escape Prevention: Domain is anchored toTHE Organ of Civilizationitself, making escape impossible as the process itself is irreversible|
|Current Maximum Prisoners: 9 entities with established Sovereignties|
|Capacity increases withTHE Organ of Civilizationdevelopment.|
|Can only imprison entities you have personally defeated in combat.|
|Prisoners retain consciousness and awareness of their imprisonment.|
|Extremely powerful entities may resist Mana influence.|
|Creating and maintaining the domain requires continuous expenditure of 10 Rudimentary Units of Everything every 24 hours.|
|Prisoner Slots Unlocked: 9/9|
|Active Prisoners: 0/9|
|Maintenance Cost: Inactive (no prisoners currently held)|
|Domain Stability: Absolute|

After Noah looked at the absolutely ridiculous prompts outliningTHE Infinite Desmoterionand all its implications, he could only focus on reading them again just to be completely certain of what he was seeing.
Sometimes, things seemed so ridiculously advantageous that one had to verify their understanding multiple times.
He was essentially being given his own personal prison-cultivation-farm where defeated enemies would be forced to eternally refine their Ways while he harvested the benefits of their progress.
It... was horrifying in its efficiency.
And absolutely perfect for someone walking the path of Mana and Hunger!

chapters.title: Chapter 4553: Pre-THE! IV
paragraphs: The new changes were utterly terrifying in their scope as they began simply by increasing the maximum number of Rudimentary Units of Everything from twenty four to eighty-one.
The duration of their usage had also expanded from one minute of sustained effect to three full minutes of continuous power.
This alone would have greatly expanded his combat capabilities, especially when combined with the more concentrated authority of his elevated Sovereignty.

But then his Organ of Civilization went even further beyond reasonable expectations. It proceeded to add a feature that only came about because of understanding and existing withinTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence of THE Creature.
Based on observing that construct’s methodology, his Organ had created its own version that frankly seemed obscene and terrifying in nature.
The ability to irreversibly bind and imprison existences inside ofTHE Infinite Desmoterion. A literal prison contained within his Organ of Civilization itself.
Those bound within could not escape ever. All of their time would be spent refining their Ways of Existence and making themselves stronger for the sole purpose of making him stronger in turn.
Whatever gains they achieved in developing their Sovereignty, he would be the one feeding off and benefiting from their progress.

And while the idea itself carried undeniable cruelty, Noah was not of the mindset to hesitate or feel undue guilt. He was already thinking and planning what entities he could potentially be imprisoning as his first captives.
He was not overly cruel or sadistic in contemplating this. This was simply how existence operated at its most fundamental level.

When a farmer cultivated chickens or raised cows for the sole purpose of eventual slaughter so that he could feed his family, no one looked at him as cruel or evil. It was simply the law of nature playing out. The survival of the fittest in action.
At this moment, Noah simply needed to find his metaphorical chickens to place in his own cultivation coop so they could endlessly and perpetually produce benefits for him.

He shook his head internally while processing such a pragmatic thought. Well, he attempted to shake his head even though he was currently still manifesting as a pulsing infinity symbol of pure energy.

His current form of concentrated authority shone brilliantly with blue-gold radiance as it began the process of reforming into his humanoid body. The energy condensed and shaped itself with purposeful intent.

He simply took a moment to breathe in and feel the profound immensity of his existence. Truly, the weight and presence of his Way of Existence now exceeded any of the entities that he had previously defeated and superseded.
Frankly, he could actually say with confidence that the weight and immensity he currently emanated even exceeded someone like Stellara at her peak. May her soul rest peacefully in his light.
She would have made for an excellent first prisoner to enter his cultivation facility. But for now, he had to actively seek opportunities to encounter hostile entities of her caliber or higher.

If he could manage to leave the Infinite Unfurling with nine Pre-THE Existences irreversibly imprisoned in his Organ of Civilization, he could consider this temporal journey one of his greatest successes.
THE Living Origin’svoice cut through his contemplation with pointed commentary.
"Are you done congratulating yourself?" she asked with expression that suggested mild exasperation.
Noah blinked at these direct words as his transformation completed fully. His current form had reformed completely from the pure energy state.

His hair now shone with pure gold-blue brilliance that seemed to contain entire folds within each strand. His fair skin gleamed like an ancient treasure excavated from before the Earliest Folds, possessing quality that suggested fundamental perfection.

Even the clothing wrapped around his body appeared as archaic wonders rather than mundane fabric. Loose blue-gold pants hung comfortably on his frame while a shirt wrapped his upper body with similar casual elegance.

These garments were formed directly from the Sovereignty of his Way of Existence itself. Occasionally, portions would flicker into pure rivers of flowing energy before reforming back into cloth with seamless transition.
In such a grand state of elevated existence, he looked atTHE Living Originwho had made such a pointed comment. He proceeded to respond with a measured philosophy.

"In existence, one absolutely has to enjoy the small victories along the path," he said with calm conviction. "If you cannot even take a moment to pause and appreciate the progress that you have made, then what is it all fundamentally for?"
THE Living Originlooked at him with analytical assessment at these words before she shook her head with something resembling reluctant agreement.

"From here onward, I will leave you on your own to navigate these dangers," she said with finality. "If you can make it out of this place alive through your own capabilities, it will further cement the absolute conviction of your Origin. If you cannot manage survival, then that is simply how things unfold."
Noah looked around at the terrifically hostile environment surrounding their protective bubble before frowning with visible concern. He turned back to her and spoke with directness.
"Why do you wish to leave me so quickly after bringing me here?" he asked with genuine curiosity about her reasoning.
THE Living Origin’sresponse carried a heavy depth as she explained her departure.

"I told you before that existence fundamentally is struggle,"she said with measured cadence."I can already sense my Origin beginning to impose itself on your developing foundation. Before I accidentally ruin your growth by leading you too smoothly along any further, I will abandon you in this place filled with genuine difficulty."
She paused before continuing with weight.

"And I will leave you with one final piece of critical advice before departing. One can approach existence in countless different ways. There are those who stake their very livelihood on going against existence itself, struggling against the natural flow of reality."
Her white-gold eyes gleamed with ancient understanding.

"But existence is vast beyond measure and unfathomably more complex than you can even imagine at your current level. If you constantly try to force your way against existence’s natural currents, you may simply find yourself being collapsed before you even realize what went wrong."

chapters.title: Chapter 4554: Pre-THE! V
paragraphs: She gestured broadly at the chaotic environment around them.

"However, if you can learn how to properly manipulate existence, if you can comprehend its fundamental code and understand how everything moves together in concert, how all forces flow together in patterns, you would have a considerably easier time navigating challenges."
Her voice became more intense.

"When everything seems completely blocked off and impossible to overcome, you will find pathways revealing themselves if you know how to look properly. These opportunities will not simply manifest automatically. You will have to actively unlock all of this for yourself through effort and understanding."
She raised one hand with emphasis.

"You simply need to learn the natural flow of existence and then develop the skill to steer that flow toward outcomes favorable to you. Principles of Existence will significantly help you with this process. You are essentially being given access to the underlying structure of existence laid out in comprehensible codes that you can invest your Civilizational Authority into."
Her expression became more serious.

"This will allow you to directly find functional paths forward when it seems like there are no other viable options remaining. You will never truly know with certainty what will happen in existence ahead of time. But that fundamental uncertainty is part of the mystery and challenge."
She looked directly into his eyes.

"I do not know what will ultimately happen. Even THE Creature does not know with absolute certainty what will unfold. But eventually existence will sort itself out through natural processes. Eventually everything reaches some form of equilibrium or resolution."
BOOM!
After such heavy words,THE Living Originshook her head and looked at Noah with something resembling approval mixed with concern.

"Good luck," she said simply. "Our Origins have now shared a path in existence. This connection can never be completely broken. If our Origins should meet again in circumstances that are not detrimental to your survival, you will see me again. If you do not..."
She did not finish articulating her last conditional statement. Noah looked at her and realized with sudden understanding that she was already half-faded from this reality.

She had not asked him which specific time period he originated from. Nor had she inquired about what happened in the future timeline he came from. As if to her perspective, none of those details mattered or would change whatever her current plans and objectives were.
He thought briefly of the Collapsed Civilization of Origin that existed in his current era. He looked at her fading figure and spoke words carefully chosen.
"Your Origin always shone brilliantly," he said with measured sincerity. "Even now, your Origin shines with undimmed radiance."
The words did not reveal excessive information. They simply let her know that her Origin’s brilliance continued forward through time.

After all, had he not obtained the Living Existential Authority of Origin in his own era? Even after this entity standing before him would be collapsed in the future, her fundamental brilliance would not completely fade into nothing.

And since Primordial Civilizations were unfathomably difficult to permanently collapse, there always existed possibility to eventually restore this entity. He just had to ensure that he survived The Fallout himself first, and subsequently whatever additional horrors would arrive thereafter.

Because even as he accomplished all of this temporal travel and growth, he understood and realized with clarity that The Fallout was merely the first of many catastrophic challenges he would eventually have to navigate.

Surviving The Fallout meant then existing in a drastically altered landscape where all of the terrifying Civilizations currently contained withinTHE Loomwould suddenly be free to act without restraint.
This possibility in itself represented another terrifying thought and future to contemplate. But he would simply approach it one step at a time with methodical planning.
If he was not successful in surviving The Fallout, then future complications would not even become relevant concerns.

These thoughts came and went rapidly as after he spoke his carefully measured words, he actually observed the figure ofTHE Living Originsmile lightly with what appeared to be genuine appreciation before she nodded with acknowledgment.
And then she disappeared completely in the next moment.
She had departed after abandoning them in one of the most dangerous places in the entire Infinite Unfurling.
All for the explicit purpose and sake of forcing them to struggle and grow through adversity.
Lumivara immediately came toward Noah and hugged his arm protectively as she looked around their environment with visible caution and concern.
As for Noah himself, his existence was still acclimating to the new state of Pre-THE. But the cascade of benefits was far from completely finished manifesting.
Because his Way and his Civilization were fundamentally one and the same entity. With his Way having advanced so tremendously, his Civilization had also necessarily advanced tremendously in parallel.
But when it came to manifestations of his Civilization’s growth, there remained only the question of precisely when he wished to receive and process this accumulated advancement.
Which was why at this particular moment, a new prompt appeared before his vision with critical timing.
|Quintessential waves of Effort and Harvest have been kept carefully restrained before flooding the foundations of your Civilization.|
|Your advancement to the distinction of a Pre-THE Existence has exponentially multiplied the potency of accumulated Harvest.|
| Would you like to receive all accumulated and amplified Harvest immediately, or delay reception until the end of the Temporal Traversal?|
|Warning: Immediate reception will cause dramatic power escalation across your entire Civilization.|
|Current Harvest Multiplier: 847x baseline due to Pre-THE elevation.|
A straightforward question came regarding the timing of harvests.
And when it came to making this decision, the answer was unfathomably clear to Noah without hesitation.
His people were actively struggling in the current era. His Civilization was under coordinated attack from multiple hostile forces.
So let it advance without further delay. Let the harvest flow immediately to those who needed it most.
BOOM!
The moment his intention crystallized with absolute conviction, reality itself responded to accommodate his will.
The dams holding back accumulated power shattered completely.
And the harvest began flowing forward through time itself toward his Civilization.

chapters.title: Chapter 4555: When Fortune Falters! I
paragraphs: His Civilization was fundamentally unique in how it operated and manifested power.
And its advancement was represented most clearly in its Walls of Civilization and its overall Designation.

It currently held The Architect’s Bulwarks as the structure for its Walls of Civilization. All accumulated harvest would flow directly into these walls that representedThe Designation of The Cathedral of Order.

The next evolutionary stage for the Walls of Civilization would be The Civilization Aegis. This representedThe Designation of The Sovereign Dominion,a stage that was deemed the absolute prerequisite before one could even begin to dream of attainingTHE Civilizational Scale.

At this critical moment, would his accumulated harvest be sufficient to make the dramatic jump from the second designation directly to the third designation? The multiplier was so obscenely high to begin with that it seemed theoretically possible.

Even though such a question existed, Noah instinctively felt like it would absolutely be the case. And if somehow circumstances proved that it was not quite sufficient, he would find some method to cheat reality and make it happen regardless.

So he closed his eyes once more and focused his awareness inward. He felt the unfathomable influx of green-gold harvest surging from all around him, crashing into his existence before flowing directly into that manifestation of his Civilization.
Into the Walls of his Civilization specifically.

The process was simultaneously quick and slow, creating a strange temporal perception. He watched as the stone walls of his Civilization changed rapidly, enlarging and becoming dramatically fortified.
Their fundamental makeup gained a terrifying quality of supernatural sturdiness as they began to shine with pure plasmic light of blue-gold radiance. The transformation was visible and profound!
As this occurred, new prompts bloomed before his vision with detailed explanation.
|The Effort of countless actions across your Civilization has accumulated into an unprecedented Harvest.|
|This concentrated Harvest flows into your Civilization simultaneously with the advancement of your Way of Existence to Pre-THE.|
|With both of these extraordinary factors converging together, The Walls of your Civilization have achieved their largest single instantaneous increase in recorded history.|
|Status: The Walls are beginning their transformation from The Architect’s Bulwarks to The Civilization Aegis.|
|Accordingly, the Designation of your Civilization is advancing from The Cathedral of Order to The Sovereign Dominion.|
|Progress: Bringing your Civilization one major step closer towardThe Level One Scale of Existence.|
|Transformation Progress towards The Sovereign Dominion: 47% and accelerating...|
BOOM!
These prompts materialized alongside an overwhelming influx of brilliance that caused his manifested Civilization to become completely drenched in glorious green-gold harvest.
Noah could not help but smile with genuine satisfaction as he felt the unprecedented changes that were beginning to unfold systematically across his entire existence.

With how profound and fundamental these transformations were, the process was taking considerable time to complete properly. But he could distinctly feel his Complexity and Purity surging upwards at terrifying rates.

Alongside this core advancement came elevation of his Early Atlas of the Folds, his Sovereign Spires of Osmont, his accumulated Principles, and everything else that fundamentally composed his Way and his Civilization as integrated concepts.
Another prompt bloomed with extraordinary information.

|You have achieved baseline immunity to an entire category of opponents.|
|The Boon of Major Mana and Hunger Bulwark has undergone complete metamorphosis.|
|New Classification: The Veritarch Blessings of Mana and Hunger|
|Maximum Recipients: 6,561 members of the Civilization can be bestowed this evolved Blessing.|
|Blessing Effects:|
|- Grants 500 Octillion Complexity|
|- Grants 500 Octillion Purity|
|- Imparts the complete teachings of relevant Grand Principles from The Cheating Architect. Provides access to fragments of Principles obtained from all Superseded Ways of Existence|

|Special Amplification: For any recipients who have undergone Civilization Specialization, the effective Complexity and Purity they will hold after receiving the Blessing averages 25 Nonillion baseline.|
|Additional Scaling: Those possessing higher Civilization Specialization Potential will gain exponentially more benefit.|

|PRINCIPLE ENHANCEMENT UNLOCKED|

chapters.title: Chapter 4556: When Fortune Falters! II
paragraphs: Misunderstandings.
They were phenomena that were incredibly easy to prevent with minimal effort, and yet they were also some of the most frustrating events in existence.

If someone simply uttered a few additional words and made a slightly different choice in how they communicated, there would absolutely be no misunderstandings. Communication would be immensely easy and clear.
And yet misunderstandings almost always occurred in existence regardless. And they remained infuriatingly persistent despite their preventable nature.
In a region of the Infinite Unfurling where space folded in complex patterns,THE Living Originwas moving through existence with purposeful direction.
The way she viewed and observed the surrounding atmosphere was fundamentally different from how entities of lesser power perceived reality.
An entity weaker than her would see the vibrant landscape of the Infinite Unfurling normally. The colors of mountains, the textures of unique regions, the spatial relationships between objects.
But in her eyes, and in the perception of many entities atTHElevel, all of existence appeared as endlessly interacting wavelengths and strings of fundamental Civilizational energy.

They saw reality differently than others. Space itself, mountains, entire landscapes...all of them simply held different variations of vibrating strings and oscillating wavelengths of Civilizational Authority that they could seamlessly and easily manipulate with their elevated power.

They could interact with these wavelengths and strings through an innate ability that only entities ofTHE Civilizational Scalepossessed. This capability made manipulating existence unfathomably easier than for those operating at lower levels.

They could meld with the surrounding existence so seamlessly that weaker entities could pass directly by them without even knowing they were present. Or they could alter and control every aspect of countless Gigaparsecs worth of wavelengths to fall under their absolute dominion.
It was power that defied conventional understanding.

AtTHElevel, fundamental particles were no longer perceived as zero-dimensional points but as one-dimensional strings and waves that vibrated with specific frequencies. Different vibration patterns corresponded to different manifestations of authority and matter!

These entities could perceive and manipulate the extra spatial dimensions that were curled up at scales too small for normal observation. They could interact with reality at thePlanck lengthwhere conventional weavings ceased to apply!

They understood that what appeared as distinct forces and concepts were actually unified expressions of the same underlying weavings vibrating in different patterns. Gravity, elemental authority, temporal manipulation...all of it was simply variations in how fundamental strings of Civilizational Authority moved and interacted.
This was the true power ofTHE, or at least aglimpseof what such beings could accomplish.
But asTHE Living Originmoved across existence in this elevated manner of perception, her thoughts returned to the temporal anomaly she had recently left behind in the Unstable Genesis Domains.

Her mind drifted back to her failed plans of studying the Origin of Time throughTHE Time Surfer. She had hoped to better understand and prepare countermeasures forTHE Living Temporalthrough such research.
She shook her head at this reflection. Sometimes one succeeded in their carefully laid plans, and other times circumstances caused them to fail despite best efforts.
She wondered idly howTHE Time Surferhad fared while facing the savage weavings of Hunger that had been moving with the anomaly when she departed.

In the next moment as she was contemplating these matters, her expression changed dramatically. Her gaze snapped to focus toward a certain direction where she felt a significant burst in the flow of countless waves and strings.
POP!
Existence itself flickered and squeezed as space compressed violently. The figure of none other than Tor appeared nearTHE Living Origin’sposition with sudden dramatic entrance.
Tor,THE First Hungerhimself!
THE Living Originlooked at this being with immediate heightened awareness. His gaze was currently filled with a light of vibrant brutality and barely contained violence.

In his hands, the half-eaten corpse ofTHE Time Surfercould be clearly seen. Endless streams of purple rivers of temporal authority were leaking from her body and being systematically devoured into Tor’s existence.

And even though she was categorized as a corpse, her eyes and core existence continued to flicker with her terrifying Sovereignty. Time itself was continuously trying to reverse and restore her to the state she had been before her defeat.

And yet Tor continued to devour everything about her Sovereignty with relentless efficiency. The corpse felt more like a perpetual battery that was feeding him endless power rather than a defeated enemy.
With such a terrifying entrance and the power radiating from Tor feeling grander than ever before, he opened his jaws wide to take another savage bite ofTHE Time Surfer’sremaining essence.
He looked atTHE Living Originwith wild intensity burning in his eyes and spoke with directness.

"I did not expect for one of the followers of this time bitch to actually be a monster veiled in disguise," he said while chewing. "I almost missed detecting you entirely. But I was following the weavings of my junior’s path, since I had to hurry in taking care of a few persistent pests."
He paused to take another bite.
"Because I sensed another Sovereignty wrap around my junior and even veil their presence completely. I now cannot sense where they are located. So tell me plainly: what did you do with my junior?"
As soon as he finished speaking his question, he continued to brutally bite and devour what remained ofTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentity in his hands.
And here came a critical inflection point in their interaction.
He had asked a simple and straightforward question.THE Living Origincould have given a simple and complete answer.
And yet at this moment,THE Living Originthought carefully about the terrifying temporal anomaly who had far too many complex issues and connections already attached to his existence.

She first needed to further understand his relationship to this brutal entity before revealing sensitive information. The anomaly held a semblance of her Origin within him, and he also held a semblance of this savage entity’s Hunger?
She wanted to comprehend how all of these connections fit together properly. So at this critical moment, she simply made the choice to say minimal information.
"He is fine and safe," she said with deliberate vagueness.
And toward such insufficient words, Tor’s expression shifted.
"That is not what I fucking asked for though,"he said with irritation building in his tone. "Where specifically is my junior located?"
An exchange of just a few words between two powerful beings.
If different words had been chosen, if additional clarifying information had been given, then perhaps what happened next would not have occurred at all.
And yetTHE Living Originsimply shook her head with refusal. She did not wish to reveal where she had left the anomaly, viewing that information as sensitive.
In consequence of this withholding, Tor laughed with dark amusement before shaking his head with resigned acceptance.
"Guess another bitch needs to be collapsed today," he said with casual finality. "Alrighty then."

With such declaration of intent, he opened his jaws impossibly wide and completely devoured the remaining body ofTHE Time Surferin a single bite. The corpse that had been spilling out seas of temporal Sovereignty vanished entirely into his Hunger.
His power began radiating a terrifically concentrated obsidian-crimson glow as he looked directly atTHE Living Originand spoke with predatory anticipation.
"Scrawny thing, are you ready?" he asked with savage smile.
Choices.
Both entities had made the choice to say certain words while deliberately not saying other words. What it led to was a fundamental misunderstanding between two beings who operated atTHElevel.
An infuriating outcome that could have been easily prevented, and yet it occurred nonetheless despite their intelligence.
And from this miscommunication born of incomplete information and deliberate withholding, a terrifying battle between twoTHEentities was about to bloom.
All because a few additional words were not spoken!

chapters.title: Chapter 4557 - Capítulo 4557: When Fortune Falters! III
paragraphs: Capítulo 4557: When Fortune Falters! III
The Unstable Genesis Domains were vast beyond measure, containing many regions filled with dangerous environments that held clusters of unstable Civilizational Authority.
Noah had been traversing across them carefully for some time now with methodical exploration.
He was a simple farmer in mindset as he searched for suitable chickens to place into his prison coop. And yet he could not find a single qualifying entity anywhere in this domain so far!
He was simply left acclimating to his terrifying new power level as he felt the radiant expression of his Way of Existence flowing through him constantly.

When it came to keeping his power active through THE True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger, the mathematics worked out favorably. He could currently produce a single Rudimentary Unit of Everything every three minutes of standard time.

So he was actually capable of maintaining this constant state of elevated power indefinitely. By the time the duration of one Rudimentary Unit finished its three-minute cycle, he would already have another unit produced at exactly the same moment.

The constant state of empowerment left him feeling extremely exuberant about his capabilities while he continued forging the Civilizational Primus Mana Glyphs of his Principles amongst other elevated aspects of his existence.

An additional elevation worth noting was the progress of attainment of a Principle past the level of Singularity soon. This achievement left him remembering Elyndra and thinking about his many missed dual cultivation sessions with various partners.

He was an imperfect man as dual cultivation with his partners was the one activity he never denied himself under normal circumstances. And the sheer audacity of THE Living Elemental to curse him with contagious flames that made him stop all these intimate activities was enough for him to consider that entity a worse enemy than even THE Living Paradox.

A sworn enemy in fact. Out of all entities that had to eventually be eliminated, THE Living Elemental was now at the very top of his list purely because those actions had taken something he considered precious away, however temporarily.
He had a light smile as he shook his head at this vindictive thought when suddenly...
“Be careful, Master!” Lumivara’s voice called out with urgency.

She pulsed with concentrated light to oppose an incoming blast of blue unstable Civilizational Authority of Lightning. They were currently moving across an unstable region which pulsed chaotically with lightning authority all around them.
Each strike was capable of decimating anything below the level of Pre-THE in a single direct hit.

The environment stretched for Gigaparsecs in all directions around them. Blue lightning coiled around floating shattered landmasses that had been crystallized from constant battering by electrical strikes over eons.
The landscape appeared frozen in time, with jagged crystal formations jutting at impossible angles. The air itself crackled with residual charge that created visible distortions in space.

Toward the incoming strike that Lumivara had warned about, her defensive light was not able to meaningfully oppose or deflect the chaotic lightning. The attack continued its trajectory directly toward Noah.
Noah looked up calmly and simply let the massive lightning strike smash directly into his body without attempting to dodge or defend.

His form absorbed the electrical devastation that would have decimated even entities possessing a few Decillions of Complexity and Purity. To him, it felt like mere sparks hitting his elevated existence, causing no actual damage.
Lumivara looked at this casual display with genuine amazement written across her features.
“Master, how can I become strong like you so quickly?” she asked with voice carrying sincere curiosity.
Noah replied calmly as they continued moving through the dangerous region without pause.
“You would have to possess a really strong foundation paired with a unique disposition of existence,” he said with measured explanation.
Lumivara tilted her head with visible confusion.
“Disposition?” she asked. “What specific disposition do you mean?”
Noah considered how to explain this concept clearly.

“A disposition where even if someone authoritatively tells you that one plus one equals two, you question that assertion and consider that maybe it actually equals infinity,” he said with philosophical weight.
Lumivara blinked with even more confusion as she processed this statement.
“But Master, one plus one does equal two though?” she said with genuine uncertainty. “So Master simply makes up his own reality based on preference?”
Noah smiled at these words as he formulated his response carefully.

“Yes, in a fundamental sense,” he said with conviction. “Existence has its established rules and conventions that most follow without question. But you have to cultivate the disposition to make your own rules when necessary. To question what seems absolute.”
He gestured broadly at the chaotic environment around them.

“Then you can gradually manage to violate existence’s normal constraints. More and more over time until the advancements that you make in power, which would normally require millions of years or even eons of cultivation, could potentially happen in a matter of hours or days instead.”
Lumivara nodded her head with reverence as if she was receiving sacred gospel directly from an enlightened master.

The two of them continued to move across the Unstable Genesis Domains. Noah was deliberately using the tough and ridiculously dangerous surrounding environments to further develop a practical grasp of his new power level.
With some limits and caution, of course.

One of these limits was a region that had such unstable weavings of Existence that even he did not get near, with the breakdown of Existence itself seeming like a constant state that could even injure entities at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.

Another one of those limits became apparent after they had crossed the dangerous region of chaotic lightning for some time. They came upon a distant area that appeared even more hazardous than what they had traversed so far.

Extremely concentrated rivers of purple-blue tachyons swirled and spun around each other at such rapid speed that they resembled existential freight trains. Each river felt like it could smash directly into even Pre-THE Existences with enough force to heavily injure them, continuing to batter them until eventual collapse.
Even Noah had to come to a complete stop as he squinted and looked more closely at this phenomenon. He activated his Lens of Civilization to gather detailed information.
A radiant set of analytical prompts bloomed in front of his vision.
|Location: Concentrated Lightning Convergence Zone|
|Classification: Extreme Hazard – Pre-THE entities advised extreme caution|
|Civilizational Authority Density: 947% above baseline Unstable Genesis Domain levels|
|Primary Phenomenon: Rapidly accelerating tachyon rivers of pure Lightning authority|
|Danger Assessment: Each tachyon river possesses kinetic force equivalent to 10,000 Decillion Complexity and Purity strikes|
|Continuous exposure will cause cumulative damage even to Pre-THE entities|
|Analysis indicates increasingly concentrated levels of Civilizational Authority of Lightning.|
|Projection: These concentrated energies likely surround a naturally forming treasure.|
|Estimated Value: Beneficial even for THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entities|
|Formation Stage: Approximately 73% complete – treasure still maturing|
|Note: Waiting for complete maturation would increase value|
|Recommendation: Assess risk versus reward carefully before proceeding|
Noah raised his brows with genuine interest at this information.
“It looks like we have to struggle a little bit to see if we can successfully get our hands on some genuinely valuable treasure,” he said with anticipation evident in his tone.
Lumivara looked toward the distant convergence zone and nodded with visible caution.
“I will follow the lead of Master,” she said with loyalty overriding her fear.

They began moving closer and closer to this terrifically dangerous domain. As they approached, whenever streams of purple-blue lightning shining with chaotic Civilizational Authority surged toward them, Noah simply raised his hand.

He acted like a living conduit that systematically swallowed everything that came into contact with his elevated existence. The chaotic authority was absorbed and integrated rather than causing damage.

His existence continued to feel a profound sense of exuberance at processing such concentrated power. By the time they managed to get significantly closer to the terrifying rivers of accelerating tachyons...
The scene they finally observed was breathtaking in its dangerous beauty.
Multiple crystalline purple-blue jagged mountains could be seen rotating slowly around a central area. The mountains themselves appeared to be formed from compressed lightning given solid form.
And in the protected space between these rotating mountains, radiant purple-blue jewels pulsed with terrifically concentrated light of extremely pure Civilizational Authority of Lightning.
The purity was extraordinary, clearly reaching a level of refinement that touched upon THE Civilizational Scale itself.

The treasure seemed to be actively building up and increasing in concentration based on how rapidly the surrounding rivers of tachyons continued to surge and feed energy into the formation. As if the longer one waited patiently, the more concentrated and valuable the pure THE Civilizational Authority contained in those jewels would ultimately become.

Noah looked at this natural formation with eyes shining with clear desire. If he could successfully navigate past the rapid rivers of dangerous tachyons and claim that treasure, this would be a significant boon that would propel him considerably upward in power.
It would allow THE Organ of Civilization to develop even faster toward the next critical threshold.
As he carefully looked around the environment and prepared tactical plans for how to proceed forward safely...
HUUM!
A profoundly stifling aura bloomed from a distance away with sudden presence.
“Little thing, do you not know that more often than not, valuable treasures have someone watching and waiting patiently over them?” a voice called out with amused condescension.
The words bloomed from the exact area where the stifling aura had manifested. Noah’s expression changed rapidly as his entire existence began to buzz with warning signals.
One of the few potential possibilities that he had specifically not wanted to readily encounter in the Infinite Unfurling seemed to manifest with absolute certainty at this critical moment.

An entity that had not even been perceivable through their complete mastery of existence’s weavings revealed themselves at a distance. The aura and brilliance emanating from them was undoubtedly at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
A genuine THE entity had been waiting here all along.
Fuck.
Fuck!

III
The Unstable Genesis Domains were vast beyond measure, containing many regions filled with dangerous environments that held clusters of unstable Civilizational Authority.
Noah had been traversing across them carefully for some time now with methodical exploration.
He was a simple farmer in mindset as he searched for suitable chickens to place into his prison coop.
And yet he could not find a single qualifying entity anywhere in this domain so far!
He was simply left acclimating to his terrifying new power level as he felt the radiant expression of his Way of Existence flowing through him constantly.
When it came to keeping his power active through THE True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger, the mathematics worked out favorably.
He could currently produce a single Rudimentary Unit of Everything every three minutes of standard time.
So he was actually capable of maintaining this constant state of elevated power indefinitely.
By the time the duration of one Rudimentary Unit finished its three-minute cycle, he would already have another unit produced at exactly the same moment.

The constant state of empowerment left him feeling extremely exuberant about his capabilities while he continued forging the Civilizational Primus Mana Glyphs of his Principles amongst other elevated aspects of his existence.
An additional elevation worth noting was the progress of attainment of a Principle past the level of Singularity soon.
This achievement left him remembering Elyndra and thinking about his many missed dual cultivation sessions with various partners.
He was an imperfect man as dual cultivation with his partners was the one activity he never denied himself under normal circumstances.

And the sheer audacity of THE Living Elemental to curse him with contagious flames that made him stop all these intimate activities was enough for him to consider that entity a worse enemy than even THE Living Paradox.
A sworn enemy in fact.

Out of all entities that had to eventually be eliminated, THE Living Elemental was now at the very top of his list purely because those actions had taken something he considered precious away, however temporarily.
He had a light smile as he shook his head at this vindictive thought when suddenly...
“Be careful, Master!” Lumivara’s voice called out with urgency.
She pulsed with concentrated light to oppose an incoming blast of blue unstable Civilizational Authority of Lightning.
They were currently moving across an unstable region which pulsed chaotically with lightning authority all around them.
Each strike was capable of decimating anything below the level of Pre-THE in a single direct hit.
The environment stretched for Gigaparsecs in all directions around them.
Blue lightning coiled around floating shattered landmasses that had been crystallized from constant battering by electrical strikes over eons.
The landscape appeared frozen in time, with jagged crystal formations jutting at impossible angles.
The air itself crackled with residual charge that created visible distortions in space.
Toward the incoming strike that Lumivara had warned about, her defensive light was not able to meaningfully oppose or deflect the chaotic lightning.
The attack continued its trajectory directly toward Noah.
Noah looked up calmly and simply let the massive lightning strike smash directly into his body without attempting to dodge or defend.
His form absorbed the electrical devastation that would have decimated even entities possessing a few Decillions of Complexity and Purity.
To him, it felt like mere sparks hitting his elevated existence, causing no actual damage.
Lumivara looked at this casual display with genuine amazement written across her features.
“Master, how can I become strong like you so quickly?” she asked with voice carrying sincere curiosity.
Noah replied calmly as they continued moving through the dangerous region without pause.
“You would have to possess a really strong foundation paired with a unique disposition of existence,” he said with measured explanation.
Lumivara tilted her head with visible confusion.
“Disposition?” she asked.
“What specific disposition do you mean?”
Noah considered how to explain this concept clearly.

“A disposition where even if someone authoritatively tells you that one plus one equals two, you question that assertion and consider that maybe it actually equals infinity,” he said with philosophical weight.
Lumivara blinked with even more confusion as she processed this statement.
“But Master, one plus one does equal two though?” she said with genuine uncertainty.
“So Master simply makes up his own reality based on preference?”
Noah smiled at these words as he formulated his response carefully.
“Yes, in a fundamental sense,” he said with conviction.
“Existence has its established rules and conventions that most follow without question.
But you have to cultivate the disposition to make your own rules when necessary.
To question what seems absolute.”
He gestured broadly at the chaotic environment around them.
“Then you can gradually manage to violate existence’s normal constraints.

More and more over time until the advancements that you make in power, which would normally require millions of years or even eons of cultivation, could potentially happen in a matter of hours or days instead.”
Lumivara nodded her head with reverence as if she was receiving sacred gospel directly from an enlightened master.
The two of them continued to move across the Unstable Genesis Domains.
Noah was deliberately using the tough and ridiculously dangerous surrounding environments to further develop a practical grasp of his new power level.
With some limits and caution, of course.

One of these limits was a region that had such unstable weavings of Existence that even he did not get near, with the breakdown of Existence itself seeming like a constant state that could even injure entities at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
Another one of those limits became apparent after they had crossed the dangerous region of chaotic lightning for some time.
They came upon a distant area that appeared even more hazardous than what they had traversed so far.
Extremely concentrated rivers of purple-blue tachyons swirled and spun around each other at such rapid speed that they resembled existential freight trains.
Each river felt like it could smash directly into even Pre-THE Existences with enough force to heavily injure them, continuing to batter them until eventual collapse.
Even Noah had to come to a complete stop as he squinted and looked more closely at this phenomenon.
He activated his Lens of Civilization to gather detailed information.
A radiant set of analytical prompts bloomed in front of his vision.
|Location: Concentrated Lightning Convergence Zone|
|Classification: Extreme Hazard – Pre-THE entities advised extreme caution|
|Civilizational Authority Density: 947% above baseline Unstable Genesis Domain levels|
|Primary Phenomenon: Rapidly accelerating tachyon rivers of pure Lightning authority|
|Danger Assessment: Each tachyon river possesses kinetic force equivalent to 10,000 Decillion Complexity and Purity strikes|
|Continuous exposure will cause cumulative damage even to Pre-THE entities|
|Analysis indicates increasingly concentrated levels of Civilizational Authority of Lightning.|
|Projection: These concentrated energies likely surround a naturally forming treasure.|
|Estimated Value: Beneficial even for THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entities|
|Formation Stage: Approximately 73% complete – treasure still maturing|
|Note: Waiting for complete maturation would increase value|
|Recommendation: Assess risk versus reward carefully before proceeding|
Noah raised his brows with genuine interest at this information.
“It looks like we have to struggle a little bit to see if we can successfully get our hands on some genuinely valuable treasure,” he said with anticipation evident in his tone.
Lumivara looked toward the distant convergence zone and nodded with visible caution.
“I will follow the lead of Master,” she said with loyalty overriding her fear.
They began moving closer and closer to this terrifically dangerous domain.
As they approached, whenever streams of purple-blue lightning shining with chaotic Civilizational Authority surged toward them, Noah simply raised his hand.
He acted like a living conduit that systematically swallowed everything that came into contact with his elevated existence.
The chaotic authority was absorbed and integrated rather than causing damage.
His existence continued to feel a profound sense of exuberance at processing such concentrated power.
By the time they managed to get significantly closer to the terrifying rivers of accelerating tachyons...
The scene they finally observed was breathtaking in its dangerous beauty.
Multiple crystalline purple-blue jagged mountains could be seen rotating slowly around a central area.
The mountains themselves appeared to be formed from compressed lightning given solid form.
And in the protected space between these rotating mountains, radiant purple-blue jewels pulsed with terrifically concentrated light of extremely pure Civilizational Authority of Lightning.
The purity was extraordinary, clearly reaching a level of refinement that touched upon THE Civilizational Scale itself.
The treasure seemed to be actively building up and increasing in concentration based on how rapidly the surrounding rivers of tachyons continued to surge and feed energy into the formation.
As if the longer one waited patiently, the more concentrated and valuable the pure THE Civilizational Authority contained in those jewels would ultimately become.
Noah looked at this natural formation with eyes shining with clear desire.
If he could successfully navigate past the rapid rivers of dangerous tachyons and claim that treasure, this would be a significant boon that would propel him considerably upward in power.
It would allow THE Organ of Civilization to develop even faster toward the next critical threshold.
As he carefully looked around the environment and prepared tactical plans for how to proceed forward safely...
HUUM!
A profoundly stifling aura bloomed from a distance away with sudden presence.
“Little thing, do you not know that more often than not, valuable treasures have someone watching and waiting patiently over them?” a voice called out with amused condescension.
The words bloomed from the exact area where the stifling aura had manifested.
Noah’s expression changed rapidly as his entire existence began to buzz with warning signals.
One of the few potential possibilities that he had specifically not wanted to readily encounter in the Infinite Unfurling seemed to manifest with absolute certainty at this critical moment.
An entity that had not even been perceivable through their complete mastery of existence’s weavings revealed themselves at a distance.
The aura and brilliance emanating from them was undoubtedly at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
A genuine THE entity had been waiting here all along.
Fuck.
Fuck!

chapters.title: Chapter 4558 - Capítulo 4558: When Fortune Falters! IV
paragraphs: Capítulo 4558: When Fortune Falters! IV
One must always be really, truly suspicious when circumstances seem to be proceeding a bit too well, and a chosen path feels a bit too easy to traverse.
There exists an old parable about such things, told across countless civilizations with slight variations but always carrying the same fundamental warning.
Once there lived a peasant whose entire miserable life was transformed dramatically in a single day through what appeared to be extraordinary fortune.
He stumbled upon a basket of quality food near his ramshackle home, appearing as if delivered by providence itself. This gave him sustenance he had not experienced in years of poverty and hunger.

Later that same remarkable day, he managed to witness a noble woman walking through the markets carelessly lose her expensive satchel filled with coins and valuables. Instead of stealing it and fleeing as any sensible desperate man would, he felt an unusual compulsion to do good.
He actually returned the satchel to her with humble courtesy.
She looked upon this honest action with visible favor and spoke words that would change everything.

“A lesser man would have taken this wealth and disappeared immediately,” she said with approving smile. “And for demonstrating such rare character, I find myself liking you. I would like to invite you to join my personal guards.”

The peasant was utterly astonished as it felt like one extraordinary thing after another was happening on this blessed day. He never stopped to question the sequence of events. He was not suspicious of such rapid elevation from his station.

He simply followed the noble woman and her well-armed guards with mind already racing ahead. He was already imagining his completely transformed life in vivid detail. He even began planning ambitious goals like potentially striking up a romantic relationship with another noble woman after establishing himself.

He followed the noble woman and her guards as they entered an impressive castle. While he waited eagerly for his new life to officially begin with some ceremony, he found himself guided to a private chamber.

Soon he was strapped onto a ceremonial table against his confused protests. The noble woman and her guards surrounded him while wearing cult-like robes that had been hidden beneath their normal clothing.
They began to systematically gut him as a ritual sacrifice to their dark patron.
Things had been proceeding far too well for a lowly peasant like him. He should have been deeply suspicious from the very beginning when fortune smiled so readily.
But by the time he realized the trap, it was far too late to escape!
Now, Noah was not a peasant, and he was considerably more experienced with how existence operated.
He knew that many extremely fortuitous events had occurred as he crossed into the Infinite Unfurling through temporal traversal.

After the excruciating and immense pain brought about by THE Living Elemental’s curse, this entire journey through time had been proceeding remarkably well for him. Meeting Tor and establishing that connection, then encountering THE Living Origin who actually helped rather than hindered him...well, maybe until now.

He had genuinely enjoyed all of those beneficial events while simultaneously maintaining an undercurrent of suspicion. As if existence itself could shatter catastrophically in the next moment without warning.
Because existence was fundamentally struggle. Existence was inherently unfair and did not distribute fortune equally or consistently.
Things would never remain so consistently easy for extended periods. And at this critical moment, a foreign and unknown THE entity appeared directly before him to prove that principle.

The being that manifested was striking in appearance and terrifically dangerous in disposition. He possessed wild white hair that seemed to crackle with residual electricity, standing up in spikes that defied gravity.

His physique was powerfully built, and his expression carried casual arrogance mixed with predatory interest. He wore minimal clothing that revealed muscular form covered in glowing circuit-like patterns of pure lightning.

Tendrils of extremely explosive and pure THE Civilizational Authority of Fulmination wrapped continuously around his body. The lightning was not chaotic but perfectly controlled, each tendril moving with purposeful intent.
His aura radiated confidence bordering on sadistic amusement, as if he found genuine entertainment in the fear of lesser beings.

The body of Lumivara began trembling with instinctive terror at sensing this overwhelming presence. But remarkably, she still forced herself to float forward and position herself defensively in front of Noah despite her fear.
Noah looked at this being with analytical focus as he immediately utilized his Lens of Civilization to gather critical information.
A status sheet bloomed before his vision with frustratingly limited data.
|ENTITY ANALYSIS|
|Name: Astrape, THE Maelstrom Thundermane|
|Classification: ???|
|Complexity: ???|
|Purity: ???|
|Depth of THE: ???|
|Way of Existence: The Way of Fulmination|
|Threat Assessment: EXTREME|
|Note: Analysis capabilities insufficient for complete evaluation of THE entities.|
Astrape.
THE Maelstrom Thundermane!

Noah’s expression remained heavy as he processed this encounter. When he had previously deliberated about this possibility occurring, there were theoretically a few approaches for how he could potentially navigate past such a confrontation without circumstances utterly deteriorating.
But when situations actually reached this point in practice, outcomes more often than not leaned heavily toward disaster rather than resolution.
Still, he looked at this terrifically powerful being with forced sense of calm as he spoke with measured diplomacy.

“It seems we have inadvertently come across your claimed domain and your designated treasure,” he said. “Since that is the case, my companion and I will simply leave without causing any further intrusion.”

His eyes maintained their calm tyranny as he watched the terrifying entity ahead of them. Astrape was looking at both Noah and Lumivara with analytical gaze, examining them as if one was observing a pair of strange animals discovered in the wilderness.
A moment passed after Noah’s diplomatic words had echoed across the space between them.
Then Astrape smiled with casual cruelty and spoke with finality.
“Nah,” he said with dismissive tone. “Since you have already arrived here, you should definitely stay.”
BOOM!
The voice was heavy and filled with an undeniable brilliance.
Undeniable!

chapters.title: Chapter 4559 - Capítulo 4559: When Fortune Falters! V
paragraphs: Capítulo 4559: When Fortune Falters! V
Noah’s eyes pulsed with recognition of how this would unfold.
Right. Deterioration toward catastrophe. That was more often than not how existence operated when confronting those with overwhelming power.
Astrape looked Noah up and down with assessing gaze before he continued speaking with a philosophical observation.

“Any common Pre-THE Existence would have immediately gotten on their knees right now upon sensing my presence,” he said with voice carrying superiority. “They would be bowing their heads down submissively and being as obedient as possible just to be allowed to remain in my presence without being obliterated.”
He tilted his head with interest.
“And yet you, little anomaly, are looking directly at me as if we are somehow equals. You do not even show an appropriate sense of fear or deference. That behavior in itself is quite unnatural.”
His smile widened with predatory amusement.

“Either you genuinely believe you could actually survive a direct encounter against someone at my level, or you are one of those weak followers who serve an entity that has already formed their Dominion and achieved THE Civilizational Scale.”
He gestured casually.

“Perhaps this powerful patron is nearby protecting you, or you believe that simply mentioning their name would grant you different standing. As if speaking their identity to me would make me reconsider and let you leave peacefully.”
His eyes gleamed with challenge.

“So do you want to skip past all the tedious pleasantries and simply declare the name of the entity that you follow? We will see together if that name carries enough weight to make me refrain from doing anything harmful against you.”
The expression and eyes of Astrape shined with concentrated sense of brutality and casual cruelty after he finished speaking these words.
Noah’s expression became progressively more grim as he processed this inevitable trajectory. He sighed with resignation and shook his head slowly while looking toward this being.
When he spoke, his voice carried calm tyranny that refused to be diminished.
“Regardless of what name I might give you, it ultimately will not matter to the outcome,” he said with absolute certainty.
Astrape laughed at this response, his Sovereignty causing the surrounding environment to buzz and distort with electrical charge. He nodded with appreciation for the honest assessment.

“Haha, a weak thing with some actual sense of reality,” he said with genuine amusement. “You are correct. Even if you claimed it was THE Creature himself that you followed, it would not change my intentions.”
His expression became more serious and analytical.

“Because I can see you, little anomaly. Really see you with the vision granted by THE. Apart from your disposition and bearing, your fundamental existence looks and feels distinctly different from all other entities I have encountered.”
He leaned forward with intensity.

“You may not even fully understand what I am describing since you have not yet attained THE yourself. But the elevated vision I possess makes it so I can perceive you as the temporal anomaly that you clearly are. Something that does not carry the natural colors and frequencies of the Infinite Unfurling.”
His smile became predatory.

“Which is precisely why no, I absolutely will not be permitting you to leave this location. I must study your existence systematically and break it down to its fundamental particles to understand exactly why you are so different from what should be possible.”
He spread his hands as if explaining something reasonable.
“It is nothing particularly major, and certainly nothing personal against you specifically. Are you ready to cooperate?”
Was he ready.

Noah could not help but sigh heavily at these words. He thought about how sometimes, choice truly was nothing more than comfortable illusion. There was no genuine choice to make in this situation apart from accepting a forced outcome.
But regardless of inevitability, he stretched his neck as if preparing for a truly dangerous and exhausting exercise. He placed his hand on Lumivara with gentle firmness.
She disappeared instantly, her entire existence placed protectively inside his own internal space before she could even voice a word of protest.

THE Maelstrom Thundermane looked at Noah with an amused smile, as if an adult was watching a child raise their small fists with determination. As if such gesture would actually accomplish anything meaningful against overwhelming power.

And yet at the same time, Astrape recognized that any entity who could remain this outwardly calm even when facing certain death would inevitably have a few unexpected tricks available. Even if they were fundamentally weaker.
So Astrape did not waste time with further conversation. His existence instantly erupted with concentrated power as he prepared to capture this anomaly.
The moment he manifested his authority fully, Noah also erupted with his own power in response.
“Keep up, you ugly fucker,” Noah said lightly with voice carrying absolute defiance.
BOOM!
His Way exploded with brilliant radiance as his body transformed into pure concentrated Primus Mana. The blue-gold energy that composed his fundamental existence blazed with intensity.
And yet the terrifying influence of Astrape still thundered down toward him far faster than Noah could fully react to with his own power alone.
But then...
BZZT!
Terrifying seas of THE Civilizational Authority of Hunger bloomed into existence with overwhelming presence. THE Barrier of Hunger that Tor had placed upon Noah activated!

Decillions upon Decillions of enraged obsidian-crimson jaws erupted from the barrier, systematically devouring all nearby influence of Astrape’s lightning. They formed a brilliantly dense barrier of obsidian-crimson light that shot outward into the distance.
The protective phenomenon was genuinely shocking in its potency and scope.
Astrape looked at this unexpected defensive capability with visible incredulity before he laughed with raucous appreciation for the surprise.
Of course, it would not be easy!
How could anything be easy in existence, especially when it involved such a unique being?!

Another version of himself instantly bloomed from his current physical form through Fulmination authority, creating a perfect duplicate. This second Astrape shot forward at impossible speed toward the slippery anomaly attempting to escape his grasp!

chapters.title: Chapter 4560 - Capítulo 4560: There's Bad, Then There's BAD I
paragraphs: Capítulo 4560: There’s Bad, Then There’s BAD I
Mistakes were inevitable in existence, woven into the very fabric of how beings learned and grew.

It was perfectly acceptable for one to make mistakes along their path. But it only transformed into grievous sin if they failed to learn from such errors, or worse, if they deliberately refused to steer away from committing the same mistake repeatedly.
The true measure of wisdom was not in never falling, but in rising differently each time.

In the Infinite Unfurling, in a region that had become a battlefield between two incomprehensible forces, the ongoing clashes of THE Civilizational Authority of Hunger and THE Civilizational Authority of Origin continued to reshape reality itself.

The surroundings had been transformed into a war zone of conceptual forces. Massive white-gold glyphs perfectly aligned with Origin floated and rotated through collapsed space. Each glyph was the size of small moons, radiating concentrated authority.
Opposite them, obsidian-crimson glyphs aligned with Hunger raged with equal intensity. They devoured space around them while simultaneously creating it, forming paradoxical voids.

All of these glyphs radiated the unmistakable light of Singularity-level Principles being actively expressed, with a light of other Principles that seemed...even more disastrous than Singularity-level!

The Principles of Existence were fundamentally the equations that described how reality operated at its deepest levels. They procedurally outlined how existence functioned, providing the underlying code.
And THE entities were the ones who could utilize such Principles with the greatest freedom and masterful precision.

Even at this moment of intense confrontation, the actual physical bodies of THE First Hunger and THE Living Origin could not even be directly observed by normal perception. Everything around them for tens of Gigaparsecs was composed of twisting expressions of existence itself.
Their Ways of Existence were being expressed in pure opposition against each other, warping reality through sheer authority.

If any weak entity appeared in these Gigaparsecs where their Ways were actively exerting themselves, they would be crushed to fundamental dust in less than a picosecond. And weak here was defined as anything below THE Civilizational Scale.
Even Pre-THE entities would be obliterated instantly.

And yet, in the midst of this terrifying battle of them expressing their Sovereignties and utilizing Principles to defy and manipulate surrounding existence to their tactical advantage, both of these overwhelming entities suddenly came to an abrupt stop.
The storm of authority ceased its escalation.
Tor and THE Living Origin reappeared in visible form amidst the terrifying maelstrom of their exerted Ways. They looked at each other with eyes shining with sudden realization.
Tor spoke first with voice carrying urgency mixed with anger.

“The Barrier of protection I placed around my junior has just been activated,” he said with tension building in his tone. “Meaning another THE fucker has found and engaged him, which happened as a direct consequence of your actions.”
His expression darkened considerably.

“Before I get supremely serious and genuinely pissed off beyond reason, where exactly is my junior? Because for me to still not be able to sense his general location, there would have to be some form of environmental instability creating interference...”
His eyes widened with dawning comprehension.
“Oh you fucking bitch,” he said with disbelief coloring his words.
As if he had suddenly figured out exactly what she had done, Tor shook his head with incredulous anger.
“You left him in the Unstable Genesis Domains?” he said with voice rising. “You dumb-”
“I know the direct route and the quickest path to reach his location,” THE Living Origin’s voice echoed out with unusual urgency, cutting off his insult. “Just follow me immediately.”
At this critical moment, these two terrifying entities who had been locked in combat began to sort out the miscommunication they had put themselves into. They began actively correcting their mistake.
It was always acceptable to make a mistake in the flow of existence. But one simply had to take responsibility and rectify it before consequences became irreversible.

The figure of THE First Hunger snorted with frustrated acknowledgment. But when THE Living Origin transformed into a streak of white-gold light and shot toward a specific direction with desperate speed, he simply followed without further argument.
As the two entities moved in the same direction at incomprehensible velocity, the voice of THE First Hunger could still be heard echoing across space.
“If he dies because of you, I am definitely skinning you alive slowly and eating you piece by piece over an extended time,” he said with voice carrying absolute conviction in the threat.
A heavy promise of retribution was made.

THE Living Origin did not pay any attention to the threat and only accelerated faster. Existence itself peeled away from them like endless waves and strings being systematically manipulated as they moved at speeds that lesser entities could not even begin to comprehend.
Entities that had obtained THE distinction were faster than anyone without that classification could understand through experience.
Noah knew this fundamental truth firsthand from observation. He knew with absolute certainty that he could not outrun the entity that was currently pursuing him with predatory intent.

It was not even truly a chase in the traditional sense. Because a chase required one party to be actively pursuing another with some possibility of escape. And he knew he would be getting caught unfathomably soon without intervention.

So at the very moment that he had prepared for the activation of THE Barrier of Hunger, he had already begun moving deliberately toward a specific direction where he was hatching a desperate plan for survival.

There were already multiple calculated possibilities forming in his mind of how this dire situation could potentially be navigated. And even though there existed the comfortable possibility of being rescued by Tor or THE Living Origin arriving to intervene, those were not outcomes he could reasonably entertain or depend upon.

Because at the end of existence, one ultimately had to struggle for themselves. One had to fight for their own survival first and foremost. One could not simply sit around passively hoping that others would consistently come to their defense and save them from every threat.

So he had formulated a plan and was already surging with maximum speed toward the destination he had selected. And when he received the first devastating strike from THE Maelstrom Thundermane, he strategically used the terrifying force that did not even belong to his own power.
Force from an entity far stronger than himself, redirected through THE Barrier of Hunger.
He used that momentum to cross untold distances and nearly arrive at the specific region he desperately needed to reach.
It was a region that he had crossed not too long ago during his exploration. A place he had deliberately steered clear of because of the immense sense of existential danger that it projected.

A region where even entities possessing the power of THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty would think carefully twice before delving into its depths. It truly felt that catastrophically dangerous!
