chapters.title: Chapter 4561 - Capítulo 4561: There's Bad, Then There's BAD II
paragraphs: Capítulo 4561: There’s Bad, Then There’s BAD II

It was dangerous, but that region was an environmental hazard rather than a conscious entity. And Noah would rather take his chances with an environment that could kill him than face an entity that definitely would kill him.

The region appeared before him with horrifying clarity. It looked like fundamentally distorted space and existence that was actively twisting and systematically mutilating any Civilizational Authority that came near its influence.
There were a few narrow channels visible here and there that appeared as obsidian rivers cutting through the chaos. These pathways held a semblance of stability and safety.

But if one’s trajectory veered off by even an atom’s worth of distance to one side or another from these safe channels, they would immediately enter the mutilated and distorted regions of existence surrounding the paths.
These distorted zones would unravel a Pre-THE entity instantly upon contact. Or they would severely injure THE Way of Existence of even a THE entity if exposed for any duration.
Behind Noah came the furious and genuinely shocked roar of the previously laid-back THE Maelstrom Thundermane as Astrape realized immediately what Noah was planning to attempt.

“You absolute dumbfuck!” his voice boomed with mixture of anger and concern. “You may actually have some chance of surviving against me if I capture you carefully! But you will most definitely die horribly over there! Get back here immediately!”
His voice created sonic booms that shook reality. The surroundings began to feel like a massive quagmire that was drawing everything backwards through spatial manipulation.

But THE Barrier of Hunger around Noah’s existence withstood this terrifying attractive power, though its luminescence dimmed noticeably from the strain. Noah’s forward speed remained unaffected as he shot directly toward one of the narrow obsidian river passageways.
He entered the region of utterly distorted and lethally dangerous weavings of existence without hesitation.
New prompts bloomed before his vision with critical information.
|THE Barrier of Hunger Status: 30% power remaining|
|Recommendation: Extreme caution advised|
|LOCATION UPDATED|
|You have entered: THE Unstable Infinite Unfurling Ginnungagap|
|Classification: Infinite Ginnungagap Zone – Existence Unraveling Region|
|Survival Probability for Pre-THE: 0.001%|
|Survival Probability for THE Surface Depth: 23% with extreme caution|
|This region predates stable existence|
HUUM!
Then one final foreboding prompt materialized with weighted implication.
|Based on current threat level and barrier depletion rate...|
|It may be optimal to terminate this Temporal Traversal early and return to original timeline.|
|Continuing forward risks permanent existence collapse.|
Noah’s expression remained grimly determined as he navigated the impossibly narrow obsidian pathway.
Retreat was not an option he would accept.
Not when he had come this far!

Across the endless weavings of the Infinite Unfurling, through dimensions that folded upon themselves in impossible geometries, Tor followed calmly behind THE Living Origin as they crossed existence at unfathomable speeds.
And yet despite the velocity that would shred lesser beings into fundamental particles, it appeared as though he was merely taking a casual stroll with a few light steps through a pleasant garden.
He was carefully observing the woman in front of him with analytical focus, and his nose scrunched with recognition of a familiar scent.

“I can smell the brutal and overpowering allure of THE Creature clinging to you,” he said with measured curiosity. “Are you among those entities that follow him as subordinates? Because I know from that any others who come across THE Creature tend to disappear mysteriously, as if he is systematically collecting them as valuable trophies.”
He paused before continuing with pointed question.
“For you to be running around freely with such concentrated traces of his authority, are you perhaps his compatriot rather than his follower?”
THE First Hunger asked such a direct question with genuine interest coloring his tone.
In front of him, the gaze of THE Living Origin did not even flicker or change in response.

She continued forward as if she heard absolutely nothing at all, her focus entirely on their destination. Their trajectories through existence’s weavings were getting ever closer to the location where a certain temporal anomaly should theoretically be located.
Tor shook his head at the deliberate silence as moments later, they arrived at the boundary of the Unstable Genesis Domains.

THE Living Origin paused momentarily upon arrival and looked around the chaotic environment with searching perception. But Tor simply sniffed the air with his more direct method of tracking, and his expression immediately transformed into a frown.
He took a single step and disappeared from visible perception entirely.
Moments later, Tor’s figure reappeared near the region where Noah and THE Maelstrom Thundermane had been engaged just recently.
He materialized directly before the entry point of THE Unstable Infinite Unfurling Ginnungagap.
THE Living Origin appeared right after through her own method of instantaneous travel. Both their expressions became extremely heavy as they recognized what had occurred.
Tor sighed with frustration mixed with genuine concern as he looked at THE Living Origin. He raised his hand as if he wanted to physically smack her for the situation she had created.
But he controlled the impulse with visible effort and spoke with a tense explanation instead.

“Entry at one specific point of Ginnungagap sends you across countless random distances into its depths,” he said with voice carrying weight. “It is virtually impossible to find someone inside it unless you enter within the exact same instant together through synchronized timing.”
THE Living Origin’s expression became immensely serious. She nodded with acknowledgment and added her own knowledge.

“Yet even attempting to find anything in THE Ginnungagap is almost impossible under normal circumstances,” she said with measured assessment. “And THE Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms that inhabit it are extraordinarily dangerous to deal with.”
They both knew of Ginnungagap’s terrible reputation. They understood that their efforts to locate Noah would likely yield no practical results.
And yet despite this logical assessment...
In the next moment, Tor looked toward the obsidian river-like channels that served as semi-stable pathways into the chaos. He took a decisive step forward and disappeared into the distorted space.
In that same exact instant, THE Living Origin stared silently at the passageway before she also took a step and disappeared into the same obsidian river entrance.
Both risking themselves to attempt the impossible!

chapters.title: Chapter 4562 - Capítulo 4562: There's Bad, Then There's BAD III
paragraphs: Capítulo 4562: There’s Bad, Then There’s BAD III
Limitation.
A limitation was not a cage from which existence must desperately escape, but rather the very mold that gave reality its fundamental shape and definition.

To rage against perceived boundaries was to rage against one’s own existence in futility. It was only within the finitude of a single wave that one could discover the infinite endlessness of the ocean of possibilities.
So truly, one should rage against their perceived limits with full conviction. Find that endless ocean of possibilities beyond assumed constraints.
Far from the Infinite Unfurling, separated by eons of temporal distance, in the current era where multiple threats converged...
In the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds, a battle of extraordinary scale was unfolding with devastating consequences for the surrounding space.

Schrodinger floated above the battlefield with expression mixing determination and regret. The Sovereignty of Chaos and Paradox had formed into a massive obsidian-gold sea above his position, stretching for countless Gigaparsecs.
He was channeling all of its concentrated weight and authority downward with focused intent. All of its crushing immensity was being directed onto a single target.
The Infiniverse herself.
And remarkably, she was withstanding the impossible pressure through sheer determination and conviction!
Behind her position, members of The Vital Chorus Specialization all had blinding green-gold light surging continuously into her existence, providing regenerative support.

Simultaneously, The Infinite Bulwark Specialization was actively withstanding and systematically spreading all the damage she was taking across their collective existence. Millions of Primus Inevitabilities sharing the burden of authority that should have collapsed her instantly.

But even with The True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger actively supporting The Infiniverse through the connection she maintained with Noah across temporal barriers, it was just barely enough to hold defensive ground against Schrodinger.
And he did not even seem entirely serious in his assault.
Schrodinger’s voice echoed across the battlefield with philosophical weight.

“I have nothing personal against you truly,” he said with voice carrying genuine honesty. “I have nothing against Osmont either as an individual. Even now at this moment, I am not unleashing everything that I possess. Because I still believe there could potentially be a functional relationship between us moving forward.”
His expression showed conflict.

“I know that these are the cruel games of entities possessing unfathomably more complexity and purity than we can comprehend. I understand this reality. But sometimes those of us who are comparatively weak can do nothing but play along with the game we are given.”

As he spoke these words, Schrodinger’s expression was actually forlorn and even looked slightly disappointed in himself. As if he knew fundamentally that this was not who he truly was or wanted to be.
But at this point in circumstances, what else was there to do but continue?

So The Infiniverse struggled desperately to hold back the crushing weight of the sea of Sovereignty above her. Beside her position, Khor released countless crimson jaws of Hunger to systematically devour as much of the oppressive authority as she possibly could.
But their overall situation was not changing for the better despite their efforts.
And at such a critically desperate time, new variables entered the equation.
“Now then, you all seem to be having a whole lot more fun over here than expected,” a radiant but frustrated voice echoed out across space.

Reality folded and tore apart violently as new entrances were forcibly created. With a visibly frustrated Ambessa in the lead, the small legion of Avatars composed of False THE entities from THE Loom made their appearance off to the side.
They looked around at everything occurring with analytical assessment.
Ambessa blinked rapidly when she observed the figure of Schrodinger floating above. Her frustrated expression faded away rapidly as recognition dawned.
The gazes of The Infiniverse and Khor flickered with concern as this new threat manifested. Schrodinger also turned his attention toward Ambessa and the others with interest.
Ambessa knew his face extremely well. She had personally moved the unconscious vessels to hide them in various secure locations not too long ago during her service.
So at this moment, she frowned with genuine hesitation before speaking carefully.
“Esteemed Paradox, is that truly you in control?” she asked with uncertainty evident in her tone.
Schrodinger looked toward her and frowned before responding with calm clarity.

“If you are referring to THE Living Paradox consciousness, then no, he is not currently in control,” he said with measured explanation. “Though I have come to certain terms with him. Your direct assistance is not required here. I will personally collect Osmont as planned.”
The False THE entities arrayed behind Ambessa blinked and looked at each other with silent communication. One of them stepped forward and voiced out with grand authoritative tone.

“Our assigned goal here involves the one known as Osmont, yes,” they said with voice carrying weight. “But alongside eliminating him, we are tasked with ensuring his entire Civilization also collapses completely. We are here to guarantee that no trace of his Civilization’s foundation remains intact.”
The False THE Avatar looked directly at The Infiniverse, Khor, and the millions of Primus Inevitabilities with dismissive contempt before finishing his statement.
“So all of these insignificant dredges of life gathered here...” he said with casual cruelty. “All these weak things must also collapse into nothingness.”
BOOM!
Enemies had converged from multiple directions simultaneously.
And at such a time when circumstances already appeared catastrophically bad for Noah’s forces, existence itself began to buzz and shake with new disturbance.
In the next instant from yet another unexpected direction, a terrifying aura of Pre-THE authority bloomed and raged outward wildly across the battlefield.
And this particular aura was saturated completely with the unmistakable weavings of Death itself.

Space tore open with force as a massive shattered fragment of an Early Veiled Shore emerged like a vessel. Standing prominently at its forefront was a figure that radiated casual menace mixed with ancient power.
Damian, The Disciple of THE Creature, had arrived.

His white hair seemed to absorb light rather than reflect it, and his crimson eyes gleamed with predatory interest as he surveyed the chaotic battlefield. His long coat moved with wind that carried the scent of graves and endings.

Behind him stood the impressive but small legion of Guiders of Order, each one radiating authority in the Septillions or Nonillions of Complexity. They formed perfect ranks as if prepared for systematic warfare.

The arrival created an immediate and complex standoff between multiple factions. The Infiniverse and her forces all stood against...Schrodinger acting under compulsion, The False THE Avatars from THE Loom seeking complete annihilation, and now the Dead Existences led by a Pre-THE entity.
The one to break the tense silence was Damian himself.

He looked around at all the various powers arrayed against each other with expression mixing amusement and boredom. His crimson eyes scanned the faces systematically as if searching for something specific.
Then he yawned with deliberate casualness that suggested supreme confidence in his own capabilities, completely unconcerned by the gathered powers.
“There would not happen to be a lady called Sigrid here, would there?” he asked with voice carrying both politeness and underlying threat!

“I know that these are the cruel games of entities possessing unfathomably more complexity and purity than we can comprehend.
I understand this reality.
But sometimes those of us who are comparatively weak can do nothing but play along with the game we are given.”
As he spoke these words, Schrodinger’s expression was actually forlorn and even looked slightly disappointed in himself.
As if he knew fundamentally that this was not who he truly was or wanted to be.
But at this point in circumstances, what else was there to do but continue?
So The Infiniverse struggled desperately to hold back the crushing weight of the sea of Sovereignty above her.
Beside her position, Khor released countless crimson jaws of Hunger to systematically devour as much of the oppressive authority as she possibly could.
But their overall situation was not changing for the better despite their efforts.
And at such a critically desperate time, new variables entered the equation.
“Now then, you all seem to be having a whole lot more fun over here than expected,” a radiant but frustrated voice echoed out across space.
Reality folded and tore apart violently as new entrances were forcibly created.
With a visibly frustrated Ambessa in the lead, the small legion of Avatars composed of False THE entities from THE Loom made their appearance off to the side.
They looked around at everything occurring with analytical assessment.
Ambessa blinked rapidly when she observed the figure of Schrodinger floating above.
Her frustrated expression faded away rapidly as recognition dawned.
The gazes of The Infiniverse and Khor flickered with concern as this new threat manifested.
Schrodinger also turned his attention toward Ambessa and the others with interest.
Ambessa knew his face extremely well.
She had personally moved the unconscious vessels to hide them in various secure locations not too long ago during her service.
So at this moment, she frowned with genuine hesitation before speaking carefully.
“Esteemed Paradox, is that truly you in control?” she asked with uncertainty evident in her tone.
Schrodinger looked toward her and frowned before responding with calm clarity.
“If you are referring to THE Living Paradox consciousness, then no, he is not currently in control,” he said with measured explanation.
“Though I have come to certain terms with him.
Your direct assistance is not required here.
I will personally collect Osmont as planned.”
The False THE entities arrayed behind Ambessa blinked and looked at each other with silent communication.
One of them stepped forward and voiced out with grand authoritative tone.
“Our assigned goal here involves the one known as Osmont, yes,” they said with voice carrying weight.
“But alongside eliminating him, we are tasked with ensuring his entire Civilization also collapses completely.
We are here to guarantee that no trace of his Civilization’s foundation remains intact.”
The False THE Avatar looked directly at The Infiniverse, Khor, and the millions of Primus Inevitabilities with dismissive contempt before finishing his statement.
“So all of these insignificant dredges of life gathered here...” he said with casual cruelty.
“All these weak things must also collapse into nothingness.”
BOOM!
Enemies had converged from multiple directions simultaneously.
And at such a time when circumstances already appeared catastrophically bad for Noah’s forces, existence itself began to buzz and shake with new disturbance.
In the next instant from yet another unexpected direction, a terrifying aura of Pre-THE authority bloomed and raged outward wildly across the battlefield.
And this particular aura was saturated completely with the unmistakable weavings of Death itself.
Space tore open with force as a massive shattered fragment of an Early Veiled Shore emerged like a vessel.
Standing prominently at its forefront was a figure that radiated casual menace mixed with ancient power.
Damian, The Disciple of THE Creature, had arrived.
His white hair seemed to absorb light rather than reflect it, and his crimson eyes gleamed with predatory interest as he surveyed the chaotic battlefield.
His long coat moved with wind that carried the scent of graves and endings.
Behind him stood the impressive but small legion of Guiders of Order, each one radiating authority in the Septillions or Nonillions of Complexity.
They formed perfect ranks as if prepared for systematic warfare.
The arrival created an immediate and complex standoff between multiple factions.

The Infiniverse and her forces all stood against...Schrodinger acting under compulsion, The False THE Avatars from THE Loom seeking complete annihilation, and now the Dead Existences led by a Pre-THE entity.
The one to break the tense silence was Damian himself.
He looked around at all the various powers arrayed against each other with expression mixing amusement and boredom.
His crimson eyes scanned the faces systematically as if searching for something specific.
Then he yawned with deliberate casualness that suggested supreme confidence in his own capabilities, completely unconcerned by the gathered powers.
“There would not happen to be a lady called Sigrid here, would there?” he asked with voice carrying both politeness and underlying threat!

chapters.title: Chapter 4563 - Capítulo 4563: There's Bad, Then There's BAD IV
paragraphs: Capítulo 4563: There’s Bad, Then There’s BAD IV
In existence, circumstances could be unfavorable and then they could escalate to become truly catastrophic.
At this moment for Noah’s Civilization, they seemed to have left the roadmap of merely catastrophic and ventured toward utterly apocalyptic territory.
Two Pre-THE Existences had now appeared alongside multiple False THE entities from THE Loom itself. The convergence of such overwhelming power in one location was unprecedented.
And all Noah’s forces had to oppose this was themselves. All they possessed was The Infiniverse, Khor, Sigrid, and the millions of Primus Inevitabilities who had sworn themselves to Mana and Hunger.

At this critical point in time, the figure of The Infiniverse remained silent as she looked systematically at all the various forces that were now pitted against her Civilization. Against his Civilization that she represented in his absence.
And yet she retained her fundamental calmness and composure. Her eyes blazed with concentrated lividity and absolute determination as at this moment, a communication reached her.
|Sis, the influx representing the advancement of the Civilization to the Third Designation, The Sovereign Dominion, is arriving now,| the voice of RUIN/EDEN echoed directly in her mind.

The Infiniverse nodded with acknowledgment and looked around at her surroundings with assessment. At the frowning Schrodinger who carried genuine regret. At the multiple Avatars from THE Loom radiating False THE authority. At the distant Dead Existence who possessed a level of concentrated power that seemed even more terrifying than Schrodinger’s.

She observed all of this with analytical precision as in the next moment, her body and the bodies of the millions of Primus Inevitabilities and other forces arrayed around her began to pulse with unique aura.
The aura of systematic advancement was manifesting.
As this transformation began to occur, The Infiniverse looked over to the diminutive figure of Khor standing nearby.
Khor looked back at her as if she could clearly perceive the unspoken request in that gaze. She spoke with direct simplicity.
“What?” she asked with tone suggesting she already knew what would be asked.
The Infiniverse’s voice carried calm authority as she formulated her request with clarity.

“We will need you to do some extremely heavy lifting here,” she said with measured intensity. “Master is fighting and struggling for us even in the distant past. He has elevated the Civilization of Mana and Hunger to the designated stage right before THE itself.”
She paused with emphasis.

“So The Way of Existence can be considered to have arrived at the threshold right before THE Civilizational Scale. You hold Hunger as your fundamental authority. You held the power of THE before in your previous existence. Master has cleanly paved the road forward for you.”
Her eyes gleamed with conviction.

“Unlike the rest of us who do not yet possess the adequate foundation, you should already remember and know your foundation unfathomably clearly. You comprehend the power right before THE. You have wielded this authority previously. The one you call Outsider is not coming to save us. The Master is not arriving as reinforcement. It is just us here.”
She leaned forward slightly.
“Can we at least witness a glimpse of the true grandeur of The First Hunger? Of the legitimate Successor of Tor?”
BOOM!
The figure of Khor smiled with something resembling nostalgic recognition and shook her head before responding with her own determination.

“You do not need to deliver a whole inspirational speech to me,” she said with voice carrying weight. “I understand the situation perfectly. If The Way of Hunger has advanced toward Pre-THE status, which I held long ago in my previous existence, and I am unable to break even more of my seals to properly utilize it...”
Her expression became fierce.
“Then I do not deserve the distinction of The First Hunger. I do not deserve the mantle and authority that I inherited from my predecessor.”

As she spoke these words with conviction, her existence began to pulse with a heart-shaking crimson aura. As if all the way from the distant past where Noah was currently struggling, the progression and advancement he had achieved there was now arriving in this timeline.

The Infiniverse looked at this manifestation calmly before she waved her hand with decisive motion and went even further in her support. She pulled out a radiant and terrifically powerful spinning mobius strip that glowed with concentrated authority.

“This is THE Rudimentary Unit of Everything from Master,” she said with voice carrying weight. “It cost an extraordinary amount of resources to bring THE actual unit forward through time and not just a lesser Rudimentary Unit of Everything.”
She held it toward Khor.
“In it, there exists THE True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger in complete form. With this amplification, there can be absolutely no excuse for failure.”

Khor felt the radiant product of THE Organ of Civilization flow directly toward her position. Her expression became extremely heavy with the responsibility as in the next instant, the unit flowed into her existence and integrated.
BOOM!

Her body began radiating a heart-shaking aura that blazed powerfully around the entire battlefield. The concentrated authority caused their gathered enemies to immediately look over in her direction with stern eyes!
The power emanating from her small form was genuinely terrifying in its intensity.
As this dramatic transformation was occurring, space rippled nearby as another figure made their appearance.

Alexander Asmodeus materialized on the battlefield with purposeful timing. He appeared alongside the bodies of Riya and Kael who had personally escorted him here after he received news of the dire situation from them while in the Injunction Sanctuary of Law.
He made his entrance while looking directly toward The Infiniverse with eyes blazing with resolve.
He spoke in a voice only she could hear.
“The Shattered Part of THE Heart of Law that I integrated into my existence was still fundamentally a power and authority belonging to THE Living Law himself.”
His eyes gleamed with dangerous light.

“I can burn through a semblance of its accumulated brilliance to temporarily lay down a unique manifestation of THE Living Law’s authority. It will not last long, but when deployed, it could shift the tide of battle.”
The Infiniverse listened to this offer before replying with calm authority that accepted the resource.
“I will tell you precisely when to make that move” she said with measured assessment. “Be ready to act on my signal.”
WAA!
Alexander nodded with acknowledgment and took his position among the defensive formation.
His eyes held a unique light as while he found himself in this terrifying environment of war, he wondered about peace. How could one establish absolute peace?
There was no answer.
Around this same time, another unexpected presence made itself known on the battlefield.
A presence filled with an overabundance of effort!

chapters.title: Chapter 4564 - Capítulo 4564: There's Bad, Then There's BAD V
paragraphs: Capítulo 4564: There’s Bad, Then There’s BAD V
He arrived with endlessly burning waves of effort.
Effort that felt natural and grand and immense in a way that nobody else could truly understand.
The First Farmer arrived!

He appeared with Elyndra positioned respectfully behind him, both emerging behind the rear lines of the Primus Inevitabilities defensive formation. His appearance was striking in its deliberate simplicity and contrast to the powers arrayed.

He currently wore a green straw hat that seemed almost comically out of place in this apocalyptic confrontation. His body was adorned in what appeared to be archaic farmer’s attire, complete with worn but clean work clothes.
And in his weathered hands, he carried a simple farmer’s hoe as if he had just walked in from tending crops.
But the aura emanating from his seemingly humble form told an entirely different story.

His entrance was glorious despite the mundane appearance. His existence blazed with concentrated authority as he rose upward to survey the battlefield. Many hostile gazes immediately landed on him with reassessment as they sensed the profound power he represented.
He looked around at all the gathered forces with eyes that had witnessed eons of struggle and perseverance. His body burned with visible manifestation of Effort itself made tangible.
When he spoke, his voice carried across the entire battlefield with weight that demanded attention.

“It looks like a whole lot of youngsters are gathering here for conflict,” he said with tone mixing amusement and stern assessment. “The lot of you were not even conceived as possibilities when I first began to truly struggle and put in genuine effort toward cultivation.”
His eyes swept across the enemy forces.

“The effort you have all accumulated and invested across your respective existences throughout time...” he said with voice building intensity. “Let me take that concentrated effort from you and put it to proper use. Let me show you what can really be accomplished when effort is refined to its absolute pinnacle.”
BOOM!

The seemingly harmless First Farmer stood tall as his Way of Effort burned unfathomably bright with concentrated authority. His existence was sensing and reaching toward the stage he had already achieved before THE Living Emotive had brutally crushed him down.
He could almost tangibly feel Pre-THE Existence within his grasp again. At this critical moment, he was pitting his accumulated effort against others to grasp that power once more.
Either he would reclaim it through this battle, or he did not deserve all the effort and harvest he had invested across those countless eons of struggle.

The First Farmer rose to stand proudly alongside the same defensive line as The Infiniverse, Khor, Alexander Asmodeus, and other key figures. Behind them, millions of Primus Inevitabilities began to move with synchronized coordination.
They raised their fists toward the sky in perfect unison while beginning to chant with voices that shook reality.
“MANA!” they roared with conviction.
“HUNGER!” they answered with equal fervor.
The chant repeated with building intensity. “MANA!” “HUNGER!” “MANA!” “HUNGER!”

The rhythmic declaration of their fundamental Sovereignties created visible waves of authority that rippled across the battlefield. The light of Civilizational Authority surrounding all of them reached an unprecedented level of concentration!
The scene was genuinely glorious in its defiant determination against overwhelming odds.
As such a dramatic display was manifesting among Noah’s forces, the figure of Damian, The Disciple of THE Creature, rose upward while looking at everyone gathered with analytical interest.
His white hair moved with wind that carried the scent of endings. His crimson eyes gleamed with predatory anticipation mixed with dark amusement.
“Haha, it is like watching different sized ants gather together and raise their little limbs as if this would change the titanic foot about to step on all of them...”
When he spoke, his voice carried imposing weight that demanded attention from all present.

“What a genuinely warm welcome this is so soon after I wake from extended slumber,” he said with tone mixing sarcasm and genuine appreciation for the conflict. “My goal arriving here was singular and straightforward. A particularly annoying Dead entity of Order wants The Living Order to be secured for purposes I was not made privy to.”
His smile widened with dangerous edge.
“But what do I observe upon arrival? Do I see the Sinners of Paradox gathered here as well? The corrupted Sinners of Elemental manifesting as Avatars sent from THE Loom itself?”
He laughed with genuine dark amusement.

“Haha, you all understand that if and when I do systematically shatter your Avatar forms here, I will also be shattering your true existences protected within your supposedly safe confines of THE Loom, correct? The connection works both ways for those who truly know how to exploit it.”
His expression became more serious and dangerous.
“It appears I will be extremely busy so soon after waking from my rest. But I must thank you all sincerely for this reception and opportunity.”
His terrifying demeanor and imposing nature radiated outward as he raised his hand with deliberate motion. In his grip now appeared a weapon that had not been there moments before.
A clear white sword materialized, its blade seeming to be formed from crystallized concept rather than physical matter.
And this sword was surrounded by unmistakable light of a Principle of Existence that was immediately recognizable to those with adequate perception.
The Principle exceeded Singularity-level classification entirely.
It was something beyond what most present had ever witnessed directly.
His eyes flashed with concentrated crimson light as he spoke with imposing authority.

“Who shall be collapsed first by my hand?” he asked with voice carrying across the battlefield. “Will this Sigrid step forward voluntarily and save countless deaths among her people through sacrifice? Or will the obedient dogs of THE Loom hurry forward eagerly to feel my blade cutting across their existence?”
He tilted his head with mock consideration.
“Choices, choices, choices. So many potential victims to select from.”

The expressions of many present changed dramatically at witnessing the wildness and terrible concentrated power that Damian represented. His aura and bearing suggested clearly that he was the most individually powerful entity present on this battlefield!
But yes!
Some among those gathered may have temporarily forgotten a critical detail in the chaos of convergence.
This was The Disciple of THE Creature himself. Trained directly by that incomprehensible entity.
And Paradox and those serving THE Loom...were they not sworn enemies of THE Creature across eons of conflict?
5/5 Next chapter titles: Ginnungagap! I-IV

chapters.title: Chapter 4565 - Capítulo 4565: Ginnungagap! I
paragraphs: Capítulo 4565: Ginnungagap! I
Power.
Khor knew power intimately. Khor understood power at its most fundamental level.
In the Earliest Folds, she had held a tremendous amount of concentrated authority and influence.

One could always pose the philosophical question and ask: if one’s Civilization was systematically collapsed, and the very Heart of their Way of Existence was violently taken from them, and they somehow found themselves returned to existence years later through extraordinary circumstances, could they ever truly reclaim their original power?
In Khor’s mind, such a question was profoundly stupid and revealed fundamental misunderstanding.
If the sun lost a portion of its mass and light, was it no longer the sun? Did it cease to be what it fundamentally was?
Khor had lost her Heart of Hunger to THE Living Paradox’s brutal assault.
Since she emerged from the Seed of Inevitability that had been planted by The Outsider, she had begun systematically cultivating her Heart of Hunger again from foundational principles.
Her Way of Hunger remained fundamentally the same. Her existence at its core was still identical. She had simply lost a critical segment of herself that needed reconstruction.
But she was an Existence who had achieved THE Civilizational Scale. Since she had been THE once, she would always carry that fundamental classification within her being.
So right now, at this critical moment...
“Thank you, Outsider,” she whispered to herself with eyes closed, feeling the profound weavings of Hunger flowing through her existence with increasing clarity.

THE True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger held capital THE classification within its structure. For her specifically, it functioned as a unique catalytic tool because it acted like an enzyme in biological processes.

It dramatically accelerated her return toward THE by providing the exact foundational pattern she needed to rebuild around. The expression served as a template that her own Hunger could recognize and align with, speeding up reconstruction exponentially.

She already possessed the complete blueprints of THE within her existence. They had been obscured and darkened before by her diminished state, but The Outsider had shone a brilliantly bright light directly on them through his advancement.

It now made everything unfathomably easier and more accessible. If she could not successfully leverage things from this advantageous position, she truly did not deserve the tremendous power that she had wielded before her fall.
She opened her eyes with sudden clarity and spoke with absolute conviction.
“Merely Pre-THE?” she said with voice carrying weight. “I have been at this threshold before. I know this power intimately.”
BOOM!
The moment she declared this understanding, a terrifying pillar of obsidian-crimson light erupted from her small form and shot upward into the collapsed sky above.
Her power emanated terrifically intense waves of pressure that caused all the powerful entities gathered on this battlefield to immediately turn their collective gaze toward her position.

The False THE Avatars from THE Loom looked over with expressions shifting from dismissiveness to genuine concern as they reassessed the threat she represented. Their forms pulsed with defensive authority instinctively.

The Pre-THE entities, Damian and Schrodinger both turned their full attention toward her with analytical focus. Damian’s crimson eyes gleamed with interest mixed with recognition. Schrodinger’s expression showed surprise at the rapid transformation.
At such a pivotal moment, the visage of The First Hunger turned her head to look directly at The Infiniverse’s position.
She spoke with a voice carrying gratitude and determination.

“Give my sincere thanks to The Outsider,” she said with measured intensity. “Tell him that I am genuinely sorry that I have not been properly acting according to my true stature this entire time. He has had a THE entity by his side throughout his struggles, and yet she had not been contributing adequately to deserve that distinction.”
Her eyes gleamed with renewed purpose.

“Tell him not to worry about what is currently playing out right now in this present era, and for him to focus completely on whatever critical tasks he is accomplishing in the Earliest Folds. I am admittedly upset that he was not able to bring me along with him this time around on his Temporal Traversal, as who knows which specific time period that entity appeared in...”
She shook her head with resignation.
“But it simply was not meant to be in this instance. However, he can relax completely regarding this situation. I will take care of everything here with absolute certainty.”
She spoke such words with profound confidence radiating from her being.

The Infiniverse did not correct Khor’s assumption about Noah being in the Earliest Folds. She chose not to reveal that he was actually meeting with Tor in the Infinite Unfurling, as this information might be too much for Khor to process right now.
So The Infiniverse simply nodded with acceptance of the message.
And thereafter, the transformation continued with accelerating intensity.

Rivers of extremely concentrated crimson and obsidian waves of light began systematically wrapping around Khor’s small form. The unmistakable aura of Pre-THE Existence bloomed from her with maddening allure and terrible beauty.
Her eyes became immeasurably cold while she looked at all those gathered on this battlefield with analytical assessment.
In the next moment, she opened her mouth as if to consume something and spoke with terrifying authority.
“I hunger for these Folds that everybody currently occupies,” she declared with voice that resonated across reality itself.
A single simple statement.
And yet in the next moment, everything changed catastrophically.
BOOM!
The surroundings disappeared instantly and transformed into a region of pure collapse and devastation. The Transcendent Paradoxical Folds that had contained this confrontation simply ceased to exist.

|All constituent Folds within this domain have been consumed.|

|Environmental Status: Complete Collapse|

chapters.title: Chapter 4566 - Capítulo 4566: Ginnungagap! II
paragraphs: Capítulo 4566: Ginnungagap! II
Khor did not seem to be finished with her systematic dismantling!
Her mouth remained open as she spoke once more with same terrifying authority.
“I hunger for the very flow of time in this region,” she declared with voice carrying finality.
The fundamental concept of temporal progression itself in this collapsed region became devoured by her existence. Time stopped flowing entirely, creating a frozen moment that extended infinitely.

For those experiencing this effect, it manifested as complete cessation of change. Thoughts that should have progressed became stuck in single instants. Energy that should have moved became locked in static positions. Even the natural decay of particles halted completely.
In this unprecedented and terrifying situation, Khor did not pause or hesitate!
Once more she opened her mouth to take another conceptual bite as she spoke with same devastating simplicity.
“I hunger for the very concept of perception in these surroundings,” she said with cold precision. “Let us turn the lights off completely.”

In the next instant, immense darkness settled over everything like a suffocating blanket. Every entity present, regardless of their power level, could only barely perceive anything within a few inches immediately around their own position.
Even THE level perception was suppressed to nearly nothing.
And yet this terrifying being showed no signs of stopping her systematic dismantling of fundamental concepts.
She opened her mouth once again to take another bite while speaking with philosophical depth!

“In existence, nothing is truly at rest and everything is constantly in motion at some level,” she said with voice carrying ancient understanding. “I used perceive existence as countless malleable waves and strings vibrating at different frequencies. All matter, all energy, all Mana, everything possesses its own unique vibrational signature.”
Her eyes gleamed in the darkness.
“I hunger for these very vibrations of existence itself. Let me have them. Let me feel them. Let me consume them.”
BOOM!

Shockingly, in the immense darkness she had imposed, she began sensing the unique vibrational signatures of all the entities present with perfect clarity. Each one’s distinct frequency became visible to her perception like beacons in the void.
And her own vibrational signature disappeared completely from detection as if she had ceased to exist entirely.
No False THE entities could sense her. No Pre-THE beings could detect her presence. Well, unless they were genuinely exceptional enough to perceive beyond normal limitations!
HUUM!
But she felt a slight strain on her existence from maintaining all these conceptual devourings simultaneously. She stopped her terrifying actions for now and consolidated her position.
She turned her head toward the direction where the Avatars from THE Loom and Schrodinger were positioned based on their vibrations.
The weapons of THE Living Paradox who had mutilated countless Inevitabilities stood gathered there.

She smiled with utterly deadly light as she observed how they were desperately trying to acclimate to the region of her terrifying making. She breathed in deeply with satisfaction and took a single step.

She appeared instantly right above a False THE Avatar who was not even able to perceive or sense her presence despite their frantic attempts. They pulsed with their Civilizational Authority trying to protect their existence from unknown threats.
Khor floated mere inches away above this entity’s head as she opened her mouth and took a deliberate bite.
Instantly, half the body of the False THE was systematically eaten and consumed. The other half remained suspended, showing radiant teeth marks where her conceptual bite had severed their existence.
Khor licked her lips with visible satisfaction as the consumed essence integrated into her being.
Her eyes shone with terrifically intense red light of Hunger made manifest as she spoke with quiet confidence.

“Truly, do not worry about circumstances here, Outsider,” she said with voice carrying across the suppressed space. “You have given me more than what I needed to reclaim myself. Let me show these people a genuine glimpse of why THE Living Paradox had to hunt me down personally to eliminate the threat I represented.”
She said such words openly and clearly, but nobody within inches of her position could hear her voice. The concept of sound had been suppressed along with everything else.
And none of the other Avatars even knew that one of their number had already been half-eaten by an invisible predator.
They could not perceive her. They could not see her. They could not hear her.
Among the few entities on this entire battlefield who could accomplish any of these suppressed sensory functions...

The terrifying figure of Damian stood looking directly at Khor’s exact position with eyes shining with genuine surprise mixed with appreciation. A terrifically concentrated light of a Principle exceeding Singularity-level classification was shining in his eyes, granting him perception that transcended her suppression.
He could see her perfectly.
And his smile widened with dark amusement and wonder!
In The Infinite Unfurling, within a domain that predated conventional existence itself, a fundamental question arose.
To be or not to be.
This was currently not the philosophical question occupying Noah’s mind as he was doing everything within his power simply to remain alive.

The moment he crossed into the obsidian river passageway of THE Unstable Infinite Unfurling Ginnungagap, he felt an irresistible pulling force as if he was being dragged into a place from which one could never leave.

All normal perception and sound faded completely as the furious roars of THE Maelstrom Thundermane disappeared into absolute silence. All Noah had remaining was the constant and immense feeling of existential danger pressing against his consciousness.

He had to focus entirely on following the rapid twists and turns of a violently winding current of obsidian light. This sludge-like flow was the only visible sign of stability in an environment of chaos.

His surroundings were filled with murky THE Civilizational Authorities that shifted and mutated constantly. These unstable energies would systematically unravel Pre-THE Existence with terrifying rapidity upon contact.

Noah steered himself through this nightmare like a small boat navigating grand rapids of churning water. The obsidian current twisted left, then sharply right, then spiraled downward in a dizzying corkscrew that defied spatial logic!

chapters.title: Chapter 4567 - Capítulo 4567: Ginnungagap III
paragraphs: Capítulo 4567: Ginnungagap III
The speed accelerated dramatically as he progressed deeper. What had started as manageable velocity increased exponentially until the environment became a blur of motion.
His Sovereignty could barely keep pace with the required reactions. He pushed his perception to its absolute limits just to anticipate the next deadly turn.
Then disaster struck. A particularly violent twist came too quickly for him to fully compensate. His trajectory veered slightly off course by mere inches.
But inches were catastrophic in this environment! His existence briefly exited the stable zone and made contact with the murky instability surrounding the pathway.

Immediately, his THE Barrier of Hunger buzzed with maximum intensity to protect him. The protective field flared brilliantly as it intercepted the unraveling force that would have collapsed his existence instantly.
New prompts appeared with critical urgency.
|BARRIER INTEGRITY CRITICAL|
|THE Barrier of Hunger Status: Less than 10% power remaining|
Only after this terrifying near-collapse did Noah finally perceive a change ahead. A brilliant obsidian light grew larger as he approached what appeared to be an exit!
HUUM!
He escaped the obsidian river passageway and found himself emerging into open space above a vast landscape.
The moment he arrived in the skies of this new region, he immediately felt an immense gravitational pull toward the ground below that he could not deny or resist.
His body barreled downward with accelerating force as he smashed violently into an obsidian stretch of jagged land. The impact created a crater as his form collided with the ancient surface.

His eyes remained vibrant and alert despite the collision as he felt a terrifically intense sense of pressure constantly exerting itself on his very Sovereignty again and again. The environment itself was hostile to his existence.
New prompts materialized with detailed information about this unprecedented location.
|Welcome to THE Unstable Infinite Unfurling Ginnungagap|
|Classification: Primordial Genesis Domain|
|The right to remain airborne has been systematically stripped away.|
|Cause: Insufficient THE Civilizational Authority classification|
|Effect: All entities below THE Surface Depth are bound to surface travel|
|The Light of Ginnungagap shines upon everything within this domain.|
|For none native lifeforms, All Ways of Existence face 90% suppression of normal capabilities|
|Progression on The Way accelerates by 900% to compensate for difficulty|
|9% chance of spontaneous Existential Unraveling occurs continuously every second|
|Condition: If the foundation of your Way is insufficiently stable, collapse is inevitable|
|Time dilation: 9 seconds external equals 81 seconds internal|
|Spatial compression: Distances are 9 times greater than they appear|
|Authority concentration: THE Civilizational Authority is 99 times more potent here|
|Regeneration suppression: Natural recovery occurs at 9% normal rate|
|Sensory limitation: Perception range reduced to 900 Meters, 90 Light Years, or 9 Gigaparsecs maximum depending on power|
|Conceptual weight: All actions require 99 times normal effort to execute|
|Evolutionary pressure: Entities adapt 9 times faster or collapse|
|Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms: Native inhabitants possess 9 specialized adaptations minimum|
After Noah observed these absolutely ridiculous prompts with their systematic restrictions, he began experiencing their effects directly and immediately.
The 99 times more effort felt like trying to move through liquid concrete. Every action required extraordinary effort. His normally fluid command of Mana became slightly sluggish and resistant.
Slightly!
The constant 9% chance of Existential Unraveling manifested as periodic jolts of destabilization that shook his foundation. But his foundation was grand and undeniable!
The accelerated progression felt like his understanding was being forcibly expanded whether he was ready or not. Knowledge tried to force itself into his consciousness with uncomfortable intensity.
He felt as if he had entered a place where he genuinely should not be present. A domain meant for beings far beyond his current classification.
And yet, critically, he did not feel the overpowering aura of THE Maelstrom Thundermane anywhere nearby. This was still positive progression compared to the alternative.
The other choice had been to terminate the temporal traversal early and return to his own era empty-handed. That was unacceptable.
So he began looking around at his new environment to assess the situation when...
“Oh, come on,” he muttered with disbelief as he prepared.

In this place that was already overbearing and stifling simply to exist within, after his Way and his own vision finally acclimated to the suppression, he began observing his surroundings more clearly.
The first thing he saw was a pair of massive crimson eyes staring directly at him.
Crimson eyes that were attached to a truly massive woolly beast of incomprehensible proportions.

The creature resembled a woolly mammoth expanded to titanic scale. Its coat shone with full obsidian radiance that pulsed with concentrated authority. But there was something fundamentally wrong about its form.

Its tusks spiraled in impossible geometries that defied euclidean space, curving through dimensions that should not exist. Where normal tusks would be ivory, these were crystallized void that leaked darkness.
The creature’s body crackled continuously with obsidian light that was unmistakably THE Civilizational Authority at full potency.
THE level power.
Mere seconds after his arrival in this domain, he was already staring at another THE entity!

And yet this massive creature had its enormous eyes locked onto Noah’s position for only a brief few seconds. Moments later, it blinked slowly as if it had discerned or recognized something about him.
Then it proceeded to look away with apparent disinterest before continuing to walk calmly in the distance!

Noah was utterly astonished as he witnessed this interaction. He watched the massive entity that clearly possessed power at THE Surface or Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty simply gaze at him briefly and then begin wandering away without aggression.

Its titanic body passed between two obsidian mountains with casual ease. These peaks were surrounded by multiple obsidian river-like passageways which represented some of the few safe routes to traverse the domain.

The overall environment was filled with regions that appeared as patches of space saturated with instability. Storms of collapsing existence raged constantly in these areas with force that could systematically decimate even Pre-THE Existences.
The landscape conveyed profound ancientness, untamed wildness, and omnipresent danger. Multiple regions of constantly collapsing THE Civilizational Authority created a patchwork of lethal zones.

Interconnecting obsidian river-like passageways wound between these zones of collapse. Weaker entities would be forced to carefully navigate only these stable paths if they could not withstand the terrifying environment surrounding them.
Noah had arrived in such a primordial place as he kept his analytical eyes locked on the sauntering massive mammoth walking away. He utilized his Lens of Civilization to gather information!

|Name: Void-Tusk Colossus (Ancient designation: Ul’gathon THE Undying)|
|Classification: Malformed Ginnu Lifeform, Primordial Genesis Lifeform|
|Age: Predates conventional temporal measurement|
|Depth: THE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Complexity: Undefined (exceeds measurement parameters)|
|Purity: Undefined (incompatible with standard metrics)|
|WAY OF EXISTENCE|
|The Way of Enduring Void|
|Singularity Principle 1: Principle of Perpetual Mass|
|Singularity Principle 2: Principle of Dimensional Displacement|
|Singularity Principle 3: Principle of Conceptual Heaviness...|
|Note: This entity’s Way revolves around existing as an immovable object that displaces reality around it|
|Entity exhibits no protective veiling – does not perceive need for defense or hiding its power, this is why any of its information is showing.|
|Seemingly Non-aggressive towards you, or just doesn’t care.|
|Feeds primarily on regions of collapsing existence|
A status sheet that was not filled with question marks!
And yet Noah knew it was not out of the reality that he got more powerful, but simply this creature did not even feel the need to hide anything!
After Noah continued observing this massive creature walking away into the distance, he heard a different roar echoing from above his position.
He raised his head upward to investigate the source.
Another glorious Malformed Ginnu Lifeform came into view as this one was actively flying across the unstable regions of existence with apparent ease.
The creature resembled a massive arthropod expanded to impossibly large proportions. Its segmented body stretched for what appeared to be several kilometers in length.

It possessed characteristics of ancient Myriapods, with countless legs extending from its elongated form. But its body was covered in crystallized obsidian plates that gleamed with concentrated authority.

The malformed feature that marked it as wrong was immediately apparent. Its segments did not connect properly in conventional space. Each section existed partially in different dimensional layers, creating a horrifying visual of a creature that was simultaneously present and absent.
Noah looked up at this flying creature as its multiple crimson eyes also came to focus and lock onto his position. It circled above him as if examining potential prey with predatory interest.
But a moment later, it also blinked slowly similar to the massive mammoth. As if it too had ascertained or recognized something specific when observing him.
Then it continued flying calmly across this vast and endless landscape without attacking, apparently losing interest.
Noah observed all of this with his eyes shining brilliantly with mixture of confusion and caution.
He had to ask himself a critical question: just where exactly had he landed?

And why did he simultaneously feel a sense of stifling danger as if he could be eradicated at any moment by this environment, and yet at the same time, his existence was buzzing with unusual excitement?
His weavings of Loot, Cheats, and The Protagonist were resonating powerfully. Their associated Sovereign Spires of Osmont seemed to be vibrating with anticipation and enthusiasm.
As if this terrifying place held something extraordinary!
“I fucking hate Ginnungagap.”
The visage of Tor spoke such words with genuine vehemence as he stood in a newly arrived region of this primordial domain alongside THE Living Origin.
This particular section of Ginnungagap was filled with waves of obsidian plasma and concentrated dark matter flowing in chaotic patterns. The environment churned with primal forces!

Fragments of Decillions of landmasses spun rapidly through the space around them, each one moving at velocities that defied normal comprehension. The shattered continents created a deadly obstacle field.

A single one of these massive fragments smashing into a Pre-THE Existence would likely collapse their entire Way of Existence instantly through sheer kinetic devastation combined with the concentrated authority each piece carried.
THE Living Origin had a deeply frowning expression as she observed all of this environmental hostility while speaking with measured assessment.
“Survival for any entity below the level of THE is extraordinarily unlikely in this place,” she said with voice carrying weight. “The environmental pressure alone should be...”
“And yet he still lives,” THE First Hunger interrupted with annoyed eyes as he looked at her with accusatory gaze. “I can feel it through our connection. He persists.”
THE Living Origin nodded with acknowledgment before she continued with alternative possibility.

“Perhaps he has already returned to his own time period,” she suggested with reasonable tone. “I would logically assume that in a moment of immense existential danger, temporal retreat would serve as his final safeguard mechanism.”
Tor replied with calm certainty.

“Maybe that is what occurred,” he said with measured cadence. “But my Barrier around him has not yet shattered completely. And even though I cannot sense anything specific in this suppressive place apart from the nearby few Gigaparsecs immediately around my position, I will still continue searching.”
His expression became more stern.
“You, as the dumb bitch you demonstrably are for having contributed significantly in causing all of this catastrophic situation, will also be continuing to search alongside me.”
THE Living Origin’s expression shifted subtly as she barely turned her head toward THE First Hunger. Her voice carried cold and measured authority.
“I would genuinely appreciate if you refrained from using such unsavory vocabulary and ceased referring to me with that particular term,” she said with controlled precision.
THE First Hunger’s reply was nonchalant and carried tyrannical dismissiveness.
“A lot of entities across existence would appreciate a great many things,” he said with casual cruelty. “And yet they do not receive them, do they? Appreciation means nothing.”
THE Living Origin’s eyes sharpened dramatically as she responded with edge entering her tone.

“You do understand that I could force behavioral compliance if necessary?” she said with a voice carrying threat. “I possess the capability to rewrite the very Origins of how you utilize your unsavory vocabulary. To alter the fundamental concepts underlying your speech.”
The eyes of THE First Hunger became equally sharp and dangerous as the two powerful entities stared each other down with mounting tension.
“I would like to see you fucking try such a thing,” he said with challenge radiating from every word.
Their surrounding existence pulsed dangerously with concentrated manifestations of their respective powers. Authority crackled in the space between them as conflict seemed inevitable.
But in the next critical moment, everything changed.
Their expressions shifted simultaneously as both turned their attention sharply toward one specific direction. They had sensed something approaching with predatory intent.
A massive creature had materialized nearby with its terrifying crimson eyes set directly upon them with unmistakable hunger!

chapters.title: Chapter 4569 - Capítulo 4569: Ginnungagap! V
paragraphs: Capítulo 4569: Ginnungagap! V
The entity resembled an archaic hippopotamus expanded to absolutely monstrous proportions. Its body was covered in obsidian plates that gleamed with concentrated authority.
But this creature possessed radiant obsidian wings extending from its back, each one spanning what appeared to be several Gigaparsecs when fully extended. The wings shimmered with dark energy.

Its malformed distinctive feature was immediately apparent and deeply unsettling. The creature’s mouth extended far beyond where a normal jaw should end, stretching back along its entire body in a grotesque spiral that seemed to contain infinite depth.
Such a terrifying creature’s crimson eyes locked onto both THE entities with single-minded predatory focus.
It flapped its massive obsidian wings with tremendous force. In the next instant, its body had crossed the distance between them at impossible speed.

Its massive jaws were already wide open and attempting to snap shut directly on top of the bodies of THE First Hunger and THE Living Origin simultaneously. The mouth contained rows upon rows of crystallized void teeth!
HUUM!
THE First Hunger reacted with explosive speed and power. He raised both hands and caused them to enlarge dramatically as they shone with concentrated obsidian light of Hunger.
He grabbed both ends of the massive jaws that were trying to snap shut around them, his fingers digging into the creature’s flesh with devastating force.
His Way of Hunger fought directly against the terrifying Way of Dissolution that this creature possessed. The two Sovereignties clashed with reality-warping intensity as neither gave ground.

In such a terrifying pivotal moment with his arms straining against incomprehensible force, Tor turned his head toward the calm figure of THE Living Origin who merely stood beside him without apparent concern.

“So,” he said with voice tight from slight exertion. “With multiple monstrous things like this creature actively running around throughout Ginnungagap, we have to operate under the assumption that even if my junior comes across them, he can either successfully outrun them or he will simply be eaten without trace.”
THE Living Origin maintained her calm analytical gaze as she responded with measured reasoning.

“I remain calm specifically because I have not yet sensed his Origin ending or collapsing,” she said with voice carrying certainty. “So somehow he is managing to survive in this domain. Either he has not been spotted by these creatures yet and remains concealed, or perhaps he did not show us the full extent of his capabilities.”
She paused before continuing.
“He may possess the capability to successfully flee from THE level entities through methods we did not witness. Or again as I suggested, he has already departed and returned to his own time period.”
There existed many distinct possibilities as to what exactly could have occurred or could currently be happening to the temporal anomaly.
Tor flexed his enlarged arms with explosive force and physically threw back the massive creature that had attacked them. The entity was launched across Gigaparsecs of distance before stabilizing.
His eyes remained cold as he nodded with acknowledgment and spoke with determination.

“Until we know definitively what occurred, we will continue searching” he said with voice carrying absolute conviction. “I do not like this oppressive place because of the severe suppression imposed on our Ways. A suppression that is not applicable to the native Ginnu Lifeforms that attack anything foreign on sight with extreme prejudice.”
His expression darkened further.
“I really, truly do not like this primordial domain.”
They both knew intimately the terrifying nature of the place they currently occupied.
Very few entities throughout the entire Infinite Unfurling possessed knowledge like them about this domain’s true significance. They were aware of the persistent rumor regarding this location.
The musings suggested that this was potentially the birthplace of THE Creature himself.

That this primordial domain was where all THE level entities could ultimately trace their ancestry toward if one went back far enough through time and evolution. Maybe this was absolute truth. Or maybe it was all complete fabrication and mythology. Who could know with certainty?

In an entirely different section of Ginnungagap separated by unfathomable distances, Noah gazed upward as he watched the disappearing flying creature that represented the second THE level Lifeform to have encountered him.
He prepared to cautiously begin moving and exploring this dangerous place more thoroughly while maintaining maximum vigilance.

Of course, one of the persistent questions that continued buzzing in his analytical mind was why these two overwhelmingly powerful THE entities had seemingly looked directly at him, analyzed him carefully, and then proceeded to completely ignore his presence.
What had they perceived or recognized that caused them to dismiss him as non-threatening or perhaps not even as food?

As he ran his own unique internal diagnostics on himself to try and understand this phenomenon, he blinked with sudden realization as he came across a particular finding that seemed obvious once noticed.

He felt clearly the terrifying suppression of The Light of Ginnungagap pressing constantly against The Way of Hunger burning inside his existence. The 90% reduction in capability was unmistakable and severely limiting.
He felt this suppression intensely in this aspect of his dual Sovereignty.
But remarkably, he did not feel any corresponding suppression whatsoever on The Way of Mana.
Mana flowed through him completely unimpeded and unrestricted.
Mana was not being suppressed by this primordial domain.
Mana was not suppressed!
Oh!
His mind raced with the implications of this discovery as understanding began to dawn!
Belonging.
It was one of the most fundamental drives that pushed entities across all of existence to seek connection and recognition.

Some beings spent entire lifetimes searching desperately for a place where they truly fit. Where their nature was understood and accepted rather than feared or rejected. They wandered from civilization to civilization, from fold to fold, constantly seeking but never finding that elusive sense of home.

They would try to adapt themselves, to suppress their true nature, to become what others expected them to be. And yet the feeling of being fundamentally out of place would persist like a constant ache in their core existence.
The cruel irony was that belonging could not be forced or manufactured through effort alone. One could not simply decide to fit in somewhere and make it so through determination.
And then sometimes, in the most unlikely and unexpected of circumstances, a sense of belonging would emerge from absolutely nowhere.
In the most hostile environment imaginable, where survival itself seemed impossible, an entity might suddenly discover they were exactly where they were meant to be all along.
Not because they had changed themselves to fit the place, but because the place recognized something fundamental within them that resonated with its own ancient nature.
Sometimes belonging came not from finding those exactly like oneself, but from being in a place that accepted what one truly was at the deepest level.
Belonging!

Perhaps that was the ultimate paradox of belonging...it could not be found by those who sought it desperately, but it would appear unexpectedly to those who had stopped looking and simply remained true to their fundamental nature!
5/5 Keep the Magic Castles and Golden Tickets coming!

chapters.title: Chapter 4570 - Capítulo 4570: The First Tongue I
paragraphs: Capítulo 4570: The First Tongue I
All existence viewed themselves as the protagonists of their own story.

The things happening around them naturally revolved around their perspective and their journey. If they found themselves in a world of cultivation, they would believe themselves to be heaven-defying geniuses destined to develop the highest tier dao bone and stand triumphantly above everyone else.
But more often than not, realistically speaking, they would likely become mere sacrifices for pill refining. Fuel for someone else’s advancement.

If another entity found themselves in a grand epic filled with intricate musings of order and chaos, they might genuinely believe themselves to be the chosen one prophesied to lead countless others out of darkness and into salvation.

Often times even this heartfelt belief was fundamentally untrue. There was no chosen one selected by fate or destiny. There was only existence itself flowing according to its own incomprehensible patterns.
And existence did not choose anyone to be grander or more significant than another. One had to make this choice for themselves through deliberate action and unwavering will.
Noah knew with absolute clarity that he was originally a nobody.

So he had systematically forged his own concepts and actively altered existence to transform himself into somebody worth acknowledging. He had purposefully given himself the distinction of The Weaver of Existence and The Weaver of Extremity through deliberate cultivation.
And he had cultivated the concepts of Cheats and Protagonist so he could actively forge himself into whatever entity he needed to become to survive and thrive.

Because of his weavings of The Protagonist, he had inadvertently positioned himself at the center of unfolding flows of existence. Not because he was inherently some chosen being blessed by cosmic forces, but simply because he had learned how to manipulate existence in specific ways that placed him in this advantageous position.

At this moment in time, he was not successfully tangling with terrifically powerful entities in existence like THE Living Paradox, or THE Living Origin, or THE First Hunger, or even THE Creature himself because he was anyone particularly special or unique.

He did not delude himself with comfortable lies to believe that he possessed some sort of hidden inheritance or innate power that would naturally make him stand out against these terrifying monsters who literally had existence itself at their fingertips.

All he fundamentally had was himself and his determination. He knew with brutal honesty that if he slipped or made a critical mistake even once, that would simply be the end for him. Complete collapse.

So he endlessly forged his existence and his foundation to be genuinely capable of standing up against such overwhelmingly powerful beings. And the main and only real weapon that he possessed for this impossible task was something he had cultivated even before he forged the concepts of Cheats or Protagonist.
It was always Mana.
Oh, Mana!
And even this particular energy could not truly be considered something uniquely special to him alone. Countless creatures throughout existence utilized and had access to various forms of energy.

What was genuinely astounding for him was his systematic cultivation to make Mana infinite within his existence. What was truly glorious for him was forging his entire being behind this single concept as he walked the very Way of Mana itself and was building his entire Civilization around it as foundational principle.
He had taken what countless other trillions upon Decillions of creatures throughout existence also possessed and systematically elevated it to a point where it became utterly undeniable.
He was laying his claim across all of Existence with a simple but profound declaration: that energy, that pure Mana specifically, had to be behind absolutely everything.
So he smiled with satisfaction as he looked around at the terrifying region surrounding his position in Ginnungagap.

“Mana is behind everything,” he said aloud with a voice carrying conviction. “So is its distinction even more critically important in Ginnungagap specifically? For it to not be suppressed by this domain, it has to be considered genuinely native to this place. And even Hunger did not receive the distinction of something native here!”
The theory was becoming increasingly clear in his analytical mind. What he needed to do now was systematically explore to better understand the implications.

If Mana was truly deemed native to this primordial domain, and this place was filled with environmental instabilities and Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms, just what extraordinary things could he potentially accomplish by leveraging it?

In a place saturated with immense existential danger, there were a few distinct approaches where he could proceed forward. He could choose careful exploration, moving around cautiously and slowly breaking down each mystery with methodical analysis.
Or alternatively...
Noah closed his eyes with decision made and focused his awareness inward.
DUM! DUM!
He felt the powerful beat of his heart resonating through his chest. He felt THE Organ of Civilization spinning rapidly within his mind with concentrated purpose.
He placed his hand deliberately on his chest over his heart and spoke with a simple command.
“Run free, Mana,” he said with a voice carrying absolute authority.

His smiling figure began to shine with brilliant blue-gold radiance as his body transformed into concentrated energy. He began systematically releasing vast seas of blue-gold Primus Mana that spread outward in all directions from his position!
HUUM!
His Way of Mana expressed freely. His weavings of existence made manifest. His greatest wonder unleashed without restraint.
He spread it out across the landscape with complete freedom and abandon!

Why carefully navigate this land of death where his existence could be violently unraveled in storms of instability at any unpredictable moment, when he could instead loudly leverage the one unique aspect of his being that was considered native to this place?

Perhaps conventional wisdom suggested he should absolutely not do this reckless thing. But he did it anyway because at this critical moment, when he unleashed endless waves of his Primus Mana without limitation, he felt unfathomably free.
He felt a profound sense of belonging as he experienced his Primus Mana flowing endlessly outward through the environment all around his position.
HUUUM!

As he continued this dramatic release, the instability and disastrous weavings of existence nearby began to surge catastrophically. They began spreading outward rapidly across the surrounding Gigaparsecs in response to his actions.
For long seconds, he maintained this flooding release of pure Primus Mana.
And seconds continued to pass without immediate catastrophe.
And then...
|Little Thing, why are you being so unnecessarily loud?|
BOOM!
