He did not delude himself with comfortable lies to believe that he possessed some sort of hidden inheritance or innate power that would naturally make him stand out against these terrifying monsters who literally had existence itself at their fingertips.
All he fundamentally had was himself and his determination.
He knew with brutal honesty that if he slipped or made a critical mistake even once, that would simply be the end for him.
Complete collapse.
So he endlessly forged his existence and his foundation to be genuinely capable of standing up against such overwhelmingly powerful beings.
And the main and only real weapon that he possessed for this impossible task was something he had cultivated even before he forged the concepts of Cheats or Protagonist.
It was always Mana.
Oh, Mana!
And even this particular energy could not truly be considered something uniquely special to him alone.
Countless creatures throughout existence utilized and had access to various forms of energy.
What was genuinely astounding for him was his systematic cultivation to make Mana infinite within his existence.

What was truly glorious for him was forging his entire being behind this single concept as he walked the very Way of Mana itself and was building his entire Civilization around it as foundational principle.
He had taken what countless other trillions upon Decillions of creatures throughout existence also possessed and systematically elevated it to a point where it became utterly undeniable.
He was laying his claim across all of Existence with a simple but profound declaration: that energy, that pure Mana specifically, had to be behind absolutely everything.
So he smiled with satisfaction as he looked around at the terrifying region surrounding his position in Ginnungagap.
“Mana is behind everything,” he said aloud with a voice carrying conviction.
“So is its distinction even more critically important in Ginnungagap specifically?
For it to not be suppressed by this domain, it has to be considered genuinely native to this place.
And even Hunger did not receive the distinction of something native here!”
The theory was becoming increasingly clear in his analytical mind.
What he needed to do now was systematically explore to better understand the implications.

If Mana was truly deemed native to this primordial domain, and this place was filled with environmental instabilities and Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms, just what extraordinary things could he potentially accomplish by leveraging it?
In a place saturated with immense existential danger, there were a few distinct approaches where he could proceed forward.
He could choose careful exploration, moving around cautiously and slowly breaking down each mystery with methodical analysis.
Or alternatively...
Noah closed his eyes with decision made and focused his awareness inward.
DUM!
DUM!
He felt the powerful beat of his heart resonating through his chest.
He felt THE Organ of Civilization spinning rapidly within his mind with concentrated purpose.
He placed his hand deliberately on his chest over his heart and spoke with a simple command.
“Run free, Mana,” he said with a voice carrying absolute authority.
His smiling figure began to shine with brilliant blue-gold radiance as his body transformed into concentrated energy.
He began systematically releasing vast seas of blue-gold Primus Mana that spread outward in all directions from his position!
HUUM!
His Way of Mana expressed freely.
His weavings of existence made manifest.
His greatest wonder unleashed without restraint.
He spread it out across the landscape with complete freedom and abandon!

Why carefully navigate this land of death where his existence could be violently unraveled in storms of instability at any unpredictable moment, when he could instead loudly leverage the one unique aspect of his being that was considered native to this place?
Perhaps conventional wisdom suggested he should absolutely not do this reckless thing.
But he did it anyway because at this critical moment, when he unleashed endless waves of his Primus Mana without limitation, he felt unfathomably free.
He felt a profound sense of belonging as he experienced his Primus Mana flowing endlessly outward through the environment all around his position.
HUUUM!
As he continued this dramatic release, the instability and disastrous weavings of existence nearby began to surge catastrophically.
They began spreading outward rapidly across the surrounding Gigaparsecs in response to his actions.
For long seconds, he maintained this flooding release of pure Primus Mana.
And seconds continued to pass without immediate catastrophe.
And then...
|Little Thing, why are you being so unnecessarily loud?|
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4571: The First Tongue II
paragraphs: Everything froze instantly in response to that ancient voice.

Noah’s eyes opened wide as he observed how the surroundings had entered a unique state of temporal suspension. His Mana had integrated with the surrounding region so profoundly and uniquely that it felt like waves of an endless ocean had formed across the landscape.
Yet it was now all completely frozen in place as if time itself had stopped flowing. His existence vibrated with recognition of overwhelming power as he looked ahead toward the source of the voice.

In the distance, he could see both the massive wooly mammoth and the arthropod-like creature that had examined him earlier. They were looking in his direction now, but they clearly were not the ones who had spoken.
They actually stayed back at a distance with seemingly annoyed expressions on their alien features.
And far ahead of both of them, Noah saw a massive creature that possessed a vaguely humanoid shape but seemed to be completely overflowing with dense hair covering every surface.

This ancient-looking entity’s entire body appeared covered by obsidian-gold hair so thick that none of his actual features were fully visible beneath the coverage. Even his face was completely obscured behind the flowing strands.
The being radiated presence that spoke of incomprehensible age and accumulated wisdom. When he spoke, his words seemed to carry weight like ancient proclamations of fundamental truth.
Noah observed with cautious analytical eyes as in this environment of frozen time and space, a single hairy hand emerged slowly from the dense obsidian-gold hair covering the entity’s form.

This hand reached out and touched the frozen seas of Primus Mana that Noah had released. And even though Noah could not actually see the face of this tremendously powerful entity beneath all that hair, he could almost tangibly feel a sense of genuine surprise emanating from it.
He looked at this being with cautious but shining eyes as he opened his mouth and spoke with deliberate simplicity.
"Hello," he said clearly.
A single word. A simple greeting.
But the response was unexpected.
An immense silence followed his spoken word before moments later, the hairy entity’s voice echoed out again through the frozen space.

|What rubbish are you trying to communicate with that crude method?|the voice said with tone mixing confusion and instruction.|You were just speaking perfectly clearly with The First Tongue moments ago. Your intent was filled with hope, unbound confidence, and wonderful novelty. I can still feel those qualities resonating now. Use your proper Voice to speak. Use The First Tongue as you were doing.|
As Noah heard these instructive words, his eyes opened even wider with sudden realization and understanding.

The voice was not actually coming from the head region of this entity covered completely with hair. Instead, it manifested as a pulse of obsidian-gold light surrounding them, emanating directly from their Way of Existence itself.
Their Way of Existence that seemed overwhelmingly grand and incomprehensibly refined. But within its fundamental structure, Noah could distinctly feel clear traces ofManaat its absolute core.
The First Tongue, this ancient being had called it.
Naturally, the only method of communication he had just been using before speaking aloud was his glorious Primus Mana flowing freely.
And so with this understanding clarified, he closed his mouth again. Pure blue-gold Primus Mana gushed forth from his existence once more as he deliberately spoke using Mana itself as the medium.
As he spoke withThe First Tonguedirectly.
|Hello,| he communicated through pure Primus Mana expression.
The glorious hairy humanoid entity moved closer in response as their body pulsed with terrifically concentrated power that made the environment resonate.

|Yes yes, hello indeed, Little Anomaly,|the ancient voice responded with what almost seemed like satisfaction. |What is it specifically that you are searching for in these malformed weavings of Existence to be expressing yourself so loudly and freely here?|

Noah’s eyes shone even brighter with analytical focus as he looked directly at this terrifyingTHElevel entity. Details began falling rapidly into his enhanced perception through his Lens of Civilization.
A comprehensive status sheet materialized before his vision.
|Name: Aeon-Strand Keeper, Ul’moreth THE Primeval Titan)|
|Classification: First Generation Ginnu Lifeform|
|Age: Exists since Ginnungagap’s formation|
|Depth: THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Complexity: Undefined (predates measurement systems)|
|Purity: Undefined (incompatible with standard metrics)|
|WAY OF EXISTENCE|
|The Way of Primordial Continuity|
|Philosophy: All things flow from The First Tongue and return to it eventually|
|GENESIS PRINCIPLES (3)|
|1. Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Mana - Mana before it specialized|
|2. Genesis Principle of Temporal Perpetuity - Time as continuous flow rather than discrete moments|
|3. Genesis Principle of Existential Foundation - The bedrock upon which all reality constructs itself|
|SINGULARITY PRINCIPLES (5)|
|1. Singularity Principle of Infinite Patience|
|2. Singularity Principle of Accumulated Wisdom|
|3. Singularity Principle of Harmonic Resonance|
|4. Singularity Principle of Ancestral Memory|
|5. Singularity Principle of Primordial Preservation|
|UNIQUE ATTRIBUTES|
|Keeper of Thr First Knowledge |
|Hair of Continuity - Each strand contains compressed history and can extend across dimensions|
|Native Authority - Complete immunity to Ginnungagap’s suppression effects|
|Non-aggressive unless fundamental laws are violated|
|Believes all paths eventually lead back to The First Tongue|
Noah looked at the overwhelming details of this terrifically ancient being. But he could not pull his eyes away from one specific section of the information.
The Principles listed in the status sheet.
Above Singularity-level Principles, this entity possessed something fundamentally different and more profound.
This being heldGenesis Principles!
And all three of them related directly to Mana and its foundational nature in existence.
Oh!

Noah had met many creatures over the past months and days of his journey through time and space, but none had made him stop and truly observe them as deeply as he was currently examining this entity standing before him.
Ul’moreth.
THE Primeval Titan.

The status sheet of this being alone contained an overwhelming amount of information to unpack and process, with one of the most significant revelations being the Principles classified at a tier standing distinctly above the level of Singularity.
Genesis Principles.
This ancient entity who followedThe Way of Primordial Continuityactually possessed three complete Genesis Principles, with each one seeming progressively grander and more profound than the last.
The Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Mana. The Genesis Principle of Temporal Perpetuity. The Genesis Principle of Existential Foundation.
Each one appeared just as magnificent if not more magnificent than the last in its implications. What Noah would give to somehow get his hands on understanding even one of them completely!

Even more ridiculously extraordinary was how this being was not merely at the Surface Depth or even the Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty, but instead stood at the absolutely terrifying classification ofTHE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.

He was a terrifically powerful and mighty being as Noah looked at the obsidian gold waves of his Way pulsing around him. And Noah could undoubtedly observe clear traces of pureManawrapping around the core of that Way like foundational threads!

chapters.title: Chapter 4572: The First Tongue III
paragraphs: Such a tremendously powerful being had already said a great deal of profound things that had expanded Noah’s knowledge significantly. But there was considerably more that he wanted to understand, and his hunger for comprehension was burning intensely.
This entity had directly asked him what he specifically wanted by spreading out his Primus Mana so loudly and freely across this domain.

So Noah responded with straightforward honesty. Well, not really speaking with verbal words as much as vibrating and pulsing with his Primus Mana itself. The energy being referred to by this ancient being asThe First Tongue.

|I am simply looking to advance on my Way of Existence and attain THE Civilizational Authority as quickly as circumstances allow,|Noah communicated through pure Mana expression.|I am also actively searching for knowledge and understanding. I am very interested to learn more regarding this First Tongue you have mentioned, since I have always known it simply as Mana.|
He paused before continuing with honest self assessment.

|I know instinctively that I am stepping my feet in the correct direction with my cultivation. But I seem to be fundamentally lacking the proper building blocks of knowledge and understanding to progress as efficiently as I could be. I need...foundational comprehension.|

THE Primeval Titanlooked at Noah with what felt like unique consideration, though his face remained completely obscured beneath the dense obsidian gold hair. He raised one hairy hand with deliberate motion.

The two massive creatures positioned behind him responded immediately. The wooly mammoth like Void-Tusk Colossus and the arthropod flying entity both released concentrated bursts of their own respective Ways of Existence in acknowledgment.
Then they began moving away with purpose as if they had been formally dismissed to freely resume whatever activities they had been engaged in before this interruption.
And thus the only entities remaining in this frozen sea of golden blue Primus Mana were Noah andTHE Primeval Titan,standing in contemplative observation of each other.
Ul’moreth’sancient voice resonated across the space between them with profound weight.

|What a genuinely weird thing you are, Little Anomaly,|he said with tone mixing amusement and interest.|Asking me to explain something fundamental, and yet you already hold more intrinsic purity of it than most other entities I have encountered across eons. Like asking me to describe water while you yourself are drowning in an ocean of it.|
He shifted his position slightly, his hair flowing with the movement.
|But very well. Let me illuminate what The First Tongue truly represents at its core.|

|Before there were words to describe power, before concepts crystallized into distinct Sovereignties with their own identities and dominions, there existed only The First Tongue,|he began with voice carrying ancient authority.|Pure, undifferentiated potential that flowed through the primordial void like breath flows through lungs. What you call Mana, Little Anomaly, is not merely one energy among countless others that entities can choose to cultivate.|
His presence intensified with emphasis.

|It is the original language through which existence first learned to speak itself into being. The fundamental alphabet from which all other forms of communication and expression would eventually derive.|
BOOM!
Noah felt his entire existence buzzing powerfully as he absorbed these words. His Way was roiling and pulsing with recognition as he continued listening with absolute focus.

|All the countless Sovereignties that entities across Existence now cultivate and wage war over...Storm, Hunger, Origin, Paradox, Time, Space, and all the rest...they are specialized dialects that emerged when The First Tongue fragmented and differentiated into comprehensible words,|Ul’moreth continued with flowing wisdom.|Like a mighty river splitting into countless tributaries over time, each individual stream believes itself unique and separate, completely forgetting they all flow ultimately from the same ancient source.|

|We who remain here, the Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms, have kept The First Tongue within our core existence even with our own differentiations and specializations. One can even say we have no choice but to do. We do not steer far from that primordial foundation no matter how much we evolve or refine ourselves.|
His hand gestured broadly at the environment.

|Did you wonder why Ginnungagap does not suppress what you wield so freely? Because effective suppression requires the recognition of foreignness, of fundamental otherness. How can this primordial domain possibly reject what has always been its own essential essence since formation?|

|The Light of Ginnungagap looks upon your flowing Mana and sees not an intruder or invader to be eliminated, but rather a child who has finally returned home after wandering lost through ages of differentiation and specialization. You are recognized as native because you carry The First Tongue in a form that predates the very concept of foreign versus native.|
HUUM!
Noah’s mind raced with the implications asUl’morethcontinued his profound explanation.

|There exists a fundamental paradox in the nature of power cultivation, one that has consumed the contemplation of the wise,| he said with philosophical weight.|To grow stronger, must one specialize and refine, walking ever further from the primordial simplicity? Developing focused mastery over specific concepts and authorities?|

|Or does true power actually lie in returning to the beginning, to that state of undifferentiated potential where all possibilities existed simultaneously before choice narrowed them into singular paths?|
His voice carried genuine uncertainty.
|The First Tongue holds no definitive answers to this eternal question, only more questions that echo through eternity without resolution.|

Noah’s existence continued to buzz and resonate intensely as he absorbed the words of this ancient entity. Their voice with its immense depth and accumulated wisdom seemed to be actively urging his Way forward through pure comprehension!
New prompts began materializing rapidly before his vision.
|Your Way of Existence is advancing at accelerated pace through direct transmission of ancient knowledge.|
|Understanding of core weavings has deepened substantially.|
|Integration of The First Tongue concept with existing Mana cultivation occurring.|
|THE ORGAN OF CIVILIZATION: DEVELOPMENT ALERT|
|Current Maturity: 13%|
|Understanding of foundational principles accelerating development.|
|New pathways opening within Organ structure.|

Noah observed these prompts flickering across his enhanced perception asUl’morethlooked directly at him. And even though Noah could not actually see the face of this tremendously ancient being beneath all that flowing hair, he could almost tangibly feel as if they were smiling with satisfaction at his rapid progress.
They continued speaking while carefully observing Noah’s advancement in real time.

|It is genuinely unique to witness one advance significantly on their Way in real time from what I dismissively call the rubbish words of someone like me,| Ul’morethsaid with what sounded like pleased surprise. |But I will continue with the lesson since you are proving to be such a receptive creature.|

|There is an old understanding, Little Anomaly, older than the very distinctions between THE and Pre-THE classifications that entities now obsess over. It says that all existence across all domains and all eras is fundamentally a conversation The First Tongue is having with itself, asking endless questions about what it could potentially become if it truly tried.|
His voice grew more intense with the weight of this revelation.

|Every entity, every manifestation of power, every cultivated Sovereignty is simply Mana exploring a different answer to the eternal question: what am I capable of being? Each specialization represents one possible answer among infinite possibilities.|

|But your expression is genuinely unique among those I have encountered,|he said with voice carrying genuine interest. |The intent you radiated when you spread out your weavings so freely feltboundlessandunrestricted. You, in your infinite expression of Mana, are asking a question that The First Tongue rarely poses to itself.|
His presence leaned forward slightly.
|What if I refused to choose a single path? What if I remained everything simultaneously instead of becoming something specific and limited?|
BOOM!

Noah’s body became suffused with more and more concentrated waves of pure Primus Mana in response to this profound understanding. His eyes began burning brilliantly and releasing visible beams of blue gold light as comprehension cascaded through his existence.
In front of his vision, new prompts materialized with critical information.
|Understanding of your Way has vastly advanced through alignment with primordial truth.|
|The concept of Infinite Mana has been philosophically validated at fundamental level.|
|Your approach of refusing specialization has been recognized as legitimate path.|
|THE Organ of Civilizationhas advanced further|
|Current Maturity: 15%|
|Foundational understanding ofThe First Tongueis continuing to be incorporated into development.|
|Efficiency of Primus Mana processing increased by 99%.|
|Path towardTHE Civilizational Authorityclarified substantially.|
Noah’s entire existence trembled with the weight of advancement as he stood beforeTHE Primeval Titan, absorbing wisdom that entities would wage wars to obtain!

It says that all existence across all domains and all eras is fundamentally a conversation The First Tongue is having with itself, asking endless questions about what it could potentially become if it truly tried.|
His voice grew more intense with the weight of this revelation.
|Every entity, every manifestation of power, every cultivated Sovereignty is simply Mana exploring a different answer to the eternal question: what am I capable of being?
Each specialization represents one possible answer among infinite possibilities.|

|But your expression is genuinely unique among those I have encountered,|he said with voice carrying genuine interest. |The intent you radiated when you spread out your weavings so freely feltboundlessandunrestricted.
You, in your infinite expression of Mana, are asking a question that The First Tongue rarely poses to itself.|
His presence leaned forward slightly.
|What if I refused to choose a single path?
What if I remained everything simultaneously instead of becoming something specific and limited?|
BOOM!
Noah’s body became suffused with more and more concentrated waves of pure Primus Mana in response to this profound understanding.
His eyes began burning brilliantly and releasing visible beams of blue gold light as comprehension cascaded through his existence.
In front of his vision, new prompts materialized with critical information.
|Understanding of your Way has vastly advanced through alignment with primordial truth.|
|The concept of Infinite Mana has been philosophically validated at fundamental level.|
|Your approach of refusing specialization has been recognized as legitimate path.|
|THE Organ of Civilizationhas advanced further|
|Current Maturity: 15%|
|Foundational understanding ofThe First Tongueis continuing to be incorporated into development.|
|Efficiency of Primus Mana processing increased by 99%.|
|Path towardTHE Civilizational Authorityclarified substantially.|
Noah’s entire existence trembled with the weight of advancement as he stood beforeTHE Primeval Titan, absorbing wisdom that entities would wage wars to obtain!

chapters.title: Chapter 4573: The First Tongue IV
paragraphs: Across existence, entities specialized in their cultivation and advancement.
The very act of following any Way that was not pure Mana could be considered a form of specialization, even if practitioners did not consciously recognize it as such.

The Way of Fire, The Way of Ice, The Way of Gravity, The Way of Destruction. One could mention countless concepts across all domains and folds, and there would be corresponding specializations built around each one.

Noah had many powerful concepts cultivated within his existence. Gravitation, Polarity, Fire, Chaos, and many others pulsed with potency inside him. But he had deliberately not chosen to make any of them his fundamental Way of Existence. He had chosen Mana over all of them as his core foundation.

If he had instead chosen to follow The Way of Infinity as his fundamental path, would he have been considered to have specialized in that concept? And would such a choice have meant losing pure Mana entirely from his cultivation?

He could not say for certain what might have occurred. But because he had chosen The Way of Mana as his foundation, he could now fully embody the quality of Infinity within that Mana itself without sacrificing versatility.

And now, as he received more and more profound knowledge regarding this wonder from an ancient teacher, his Way was advancing even further with remarkable speed. Knowledge remained absolutely critical when it came to making genuine progress in one’s Way of Existence.
THE Primeval Titanlooked at Noah with what felt like growing discernment beneath all that flowing hair.

|It is not impossible to keep advancing without choosing a specialized identity,|Ul’moreth said with measured consideration. |But it is extraordinarily difficult for reasons most entities do not comprehend. Pure Mana, The First Tongue itself in its undifferentiated state, simultaneously holds all possible identities and none at all. This creates a fundamental problem.|
His presence intensified with emphasis.

|Existences who wish to cultivate power must choose something specific to attach their Way to, to give it a defined identity and direction. Otherwise, they would catastrophically explode from trying to express all identities in existence simultaneously. After all, individual entities themselves are not boundless in their capacity. They have limits to what they can contain and process.|

|You somehow managed to avoid this existential constraint entirely. You fully formed your Way around Mana, The First Tongue itself without collapsing. The only explanation for why your existence did not implode when you decided to make your fundamental path The Way of The First Tongue was that you also had to be boundless in some critical aspect. You had to be compatible with taking on Mana’s already boundless identity without being destroyed by that boundlessness.|
His voice carried a question that was also an answer.

|If all of us could have accomplished what you have done, do you genuinely think we would not all be walking The Way of The First Tongue in its pure form rather than accepting variations and specializations of it?|
BOOM!
Another set of profound words made complex truths suddenly clear in Noah’s understanding.

The issue was simple when properly explained.The First Tongue, pure Mana in its undifferentiated state, contained the potential for every possible identity that could exist. Life, Death, Helios, Singed, Outerversal, Fire, Ice, Storm, Hunger, Time, Space, Gravity, and infinite others all existed as potential expressions within it.

For a normal entity with finite capacity to declare"I follow The Way of Mana"would be like trying to pour an ocean into a cup. The sheer boundless nature of what Mana represented would overflow and shatter any container that tried to hold all of it simultaneously.

So entities specialized. They chose one tributary from the infinite river. They declared "I will be Fire" or "I will be Storm" and accepted the limitations that came with such focus in exchange for the ability to actually survive their cultivation.

But Noah had declared his Way to be Mana itself while simultaneously possessing Infinite Mana as a fundamental characteristic of his existence. He had made himself a boundless container before attempting to hold the boundless substance.His infinite capacity matched the infinite potential of what he was trying to cultivate.
That was the critical difference. That was why his path was possible when it should have been impossible.

Noah’s entire existence continued to shine with luminous and terrifically bright light as he absorbed the full implications of this revelation. His body radiated waves of blue gold Primus Mana with increasing intensity.
Ul’moreth looked at him with what felt distinctly like a smile beneath all that obscuring hair. The ancient being rose upward slightly and spoke with purposeful direction.
|Come on, follow me. There is more you must witness and understand.|

With such words,THE Primeval Titanradiated concentrated obsidian gold light that wrapped gently but firmly around Noah’s form. The energy began pulling him along smoothly, heading deeper into the heart of Ginnungagap’s ancient landscape.
Noah continued monitoring his rapidly advancing Way of Existence as they traveled. New comprehensions were integrating into his foundation with each passing moment.
This revelation explained so much. This was precisely why his weavings of Protagonist, Cheats, and Loot had been buzzing with such fervor since his arrival here!
Oh, what a genuinely glorious place Ginnungagap was turning out to be!
In an entirely different direction of Ginnungagap’s vast territory, separated by countless Gigaparsecs of dangerous terrain, a very different scene was unfolding.
BOOM!
"I! Fucking! Hate! Ginnungagap!" The voice ofTHE First Hungerboomed out across the chaotic landscape with genuine frustration and rage.
The surrounding environment trembled asTHE First Hunger and THE Living Originfought desperately against three massive Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms that had ambushed them after slipping past the first.

The first creature resembled a serpentine dragon covered in crystallized obsidian scales, but its body twisted through dimensions in ways that made tracking its position nearly impossible. Its multiple heads existed in different spatial layers simultaneously, striking from angles that should not geometrically exist.

The second was a massive arachnid with legs that extended through temporal rifts, allowing it to attack from multiple points in time at once. Each strike came from both past and future simultaneously, creating paradoxical wounds that tried to collapse causality itself.

The third appeared as a shifting mass of liquid obsidian that could not maintain consistent form, constantly flowing between solid and ethereal states. It absorbed attacks by simply ceasing to exist at the moment of impact, then reforming to strike back.
The battle was absolutely brutal in its intensity.

THE First Hungerhad his jaws opened impossibly wide, releasing seas of obsidian crimson Hunger that systematically devoured massive chunks of the creatures’ existence. But the suppression of The Light of Ginnungagap reduced his authority by ninety percent, forcing him to expend tremendous effort for effects that would normally be trivial!

chapters.title: Chapter 4574: The First Tongue V
paragraphs: His Way of Hunger manifested as countless ravenous mouths that snapped and consumed, but they moved sluggishly compared to his normal devastating speed. He was forced to fight with precision rather than overwhelming power.

THE Living Originstood beside him with expression of intense concentration. Her Way of Origin manifested as white gold chains that attempted to bind the creatures to their foundational state, forcing them to return to simpler forms that could be more easily managed.

But the Ginnu Lifeforms resisted her authority instinctively. They had been born from The First Tongue before the concept of Origin had fully differentiated, giving them partial immunity to her power.
The clash of their Ways created spectacular visual displays as fundamental concepts warred against each other.

And yet despite being outnumbered and severely suppressed, both THE entities were maintaining the advantage through sheer skill and accumulated experience. Their Ways were not just defending but actively evolving through the pressure of combat.

THE First Hunger’sHunger was becoming more refined, learning to devour the very concept of resistance itself rather than just physical matter.THE Living Origin’schains were beginning to bind not just forms but the underlying principles that allowed forms to exist.
They were both growing stronger even while struggling, their comprehension deepening through this brutal trial.
But the frustration was evident in their expressions. This should have been a trivial encounter for entities of their caliber. The suppression made everything unnecessarily difficult and tedious!
Across Ginnungagap’s endless landscape, in yet another region entirely, Noah was experiencing a vastly different journey.

The terrifying regions of unstable existence that might have posed lethal threats to him were being crossed with remarkable speed and safety as Ul’moreth pulled him effortlessly along through the chaos.

Zones of collapsing reality that would have unraveled Pre-THE entities in moments passed by without incident. The ancient being navigated through the deadly terrain as easily as one might walk through an open field.
|Where are we going?| Noah asked with calm curiosity.
Ul’moreth’s reply came with patient explanation.

|You are walking the correct path and have attained understanding that others cannot replicate. You possess something genuinely unique. But everything you currently have remains rudimentary and incomplete in its development,| he said with measured assessment.|I have given you merely a glimpse of what The First Tongue truly means. You are stringing together your syllables incoherently like a child learning to speak. You do not really know much about the language’s deeper structure yet.|
His voice carried purpose.

|I will teach you more comprehensively. I will show you exactly how much you still need to learn. You stand at less than one percent of true understanding of The First Tongue’s complete framework. I will also show you others like me. The Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms who remember the earliest expressions.|
As they crossed this endless and terrifically dangerous landscape with ease, Ul’moreth asked a question that invited contemplation.
|Why do you think we are called Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms specifically?|
Noah simply shook his head and expressed honestly that he did not know the answer.

Ul’moreth’s form shone with concentrated obsidian gold light as he began another lengthy explanation. Around his body, waves of his Way occasionally formed into illusory diagrams and representations that illustrated his words with startling clarity.
Images of energy coalescing into the first attempts at structured forms appeared and dissolved around them as he spoke.

|You perceive us as Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms, and that designation carries more truth and tragedy than those who speak it casually from distant folds could ever comprehend,|he began with voice carrying weight of ages. |But let me illuminate a fundamental misunderstanding that permeates this terminology, Little Anomaly.|
An image formed showingThe First Tongueas pure flowing energy attempting to take physical shape for the first time.

|We were not malformed by accident, by corruption, or by some catastrophic failure in the process of our creation. We were malformed by necessity, by the very nature of what it means to be the first attempts at structured existence emerging from undifferentiated chaos.|
The visual shifted to show Mana crystallizing into bizarre shapes that defied conventional geometry.

|When The First Tongue first began expressing itself into discrete forms rather than remaining as pure potential, it did not possess the refined knowledge or accumulated wisdom of countless generations of evolution to guide it. Imagine, if you can, the very first time Mana attempted to become something other than itself. It had no template to follow, no successful example to emulate, no understanding of what constituted proper form versus aberrant deviation.|
|It simply tried. And whatever emerged from that trying was the foundation upon which all subsequent existence would build.|
Images of strange creatures taking form from primordial energy filled the space around them.

|We who dwell here in Ginnungagap are not malformed descendants of perfect ancestors who degraded over time. We are the originals, Little Anomaly. The first drafts. The prototype attempts. When The First Tongue first learned to crystallize into living beings with consciousness and will, it produced us. Creatures whose very existence embodies the mutations and anomalies inherent in any virgin attempt at formation.|
He gestured at his own form.

|My hair that spirals through dimensions it should not touch? That is Mana learning for the very first time that space could be curved and folded. The Void-Tusk Colossus you observed earlier with tusks that pierce dimensional barriers? That creature represents the moment when The First Tongue discovered that existence had layers and tried to create something that could navigate between them, not quite understanding the process yet.|
More images formed showing the arthropod creature Noah had seen.

|The arthropod you saw flying above, with segments that exist partially in different dimensional layers simultaneously, creating that horrifying visual of presence and absence? That is not corruption or damage, but rather The First Tongue’s initial exploration of the concept that a single entity could occupy multiple states of reality at once. It did not understand the rules well enough yet to make such a being stable or aesthetically pleasing by the standards that would later develop. It simply attempted, and the result was what you now classify as malformation.|
The visuals shifted to show refined, perfect forms emerging much later.

|What later generations call perfection...the clean lines, the logical structures, the bodies that obey conventional spatial and physical laws...these are refinements that emerged only after The First Tongue had practiced existence countless times and learned from each iteration what worked and what did not.|

|But we Ginnu Lifeforms carry within our very structure the raw experimental data of The First Tongue’s first attempts. Every anomaly in our forms, every aspect that seems wrong or impossible, represents a lesson that The First Tongue learned about the boundaries of what existence could support.|
His voice carried pride mixed with ancient sorrow.

|This is why we appear so terrible and alien to entities who evolved in the later, more refined eras of existence. The mutations and anomalies were not flaws to be corrected, Little Anomaly. They were discoveries. Each malformation taught The First Tongue something essential about the nature of structured existence.|
The images dissolved as he concluded his explanation.

|So yes, Little Anomaly, we are Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms. But malformed only by standards that were invented after we already existed. By the standards of The First Tongue itself, by the measure of pure undifferentiated Mana before it learned what shapes it should avoid, we are exactly as we were meant to be. The living record of existence learning to exist, preserved in this ancient domain so that the memory of existence’s first words would never be lost.|
BOOM!

One thing was becoming astoundingly clear to Noah. Ul’moreth genuinely liked to talk and explain. But every single word felt grand and revelatory. Noah wanted him to simply continue speaking endlessly!
But suddenly their movement slowed as the obsidian gold brilliance around them began to flicker and dim.
|Oh, we have arrived,|Ul’moreth announced with tone suggesting significance.
The golden blue radiance enveloping them dissipated completely as they came to a gentle stop.
Noah looked around with heightened awareness and curiosity.
Where exactly was here? Where had this terrifying ancient monster brought him to in the depths of Ginnungagap?

chapters.title: Chapter 4575 - Capítulo 4575: The First Tongue VI
paragraphs: Capítulo 4575: The First Tongue VI
When the obsidian gold light surrounding Noah and Ul’moreth finally faded, Noah found himself descending toward something that expanded his comprehension of scale.

They were approaching the edge of a massive floating landmass that had to be tens of thousands of Gigaparsecs wide at minimum. The sheer size of it was something that many could not fully grasp due to the workings of Ginnungagap!

The edges they were landing toward displayed serene obsidian waterfalls that cascaded downward into the void below. But these were not water in any conventional sense. They were flowing instabilities of existence itself, filled with pure concentrated Mana that had not yet differentiated into any specialized form.
The falls shimmered with all possible colors and none simultaneously, creating visual paradoxes.

Noah’s gaze swept across the vast landscape stretching before him. Endlessly extending forests covered much of the visible terrain, their trees unlike anything he had seen before. Mountains rose in the distance with peaks that seemed to pierce through dimensional barriers.
But what caught his attention most intensely was a figure sitting casually near the edge of this vast floating landmass.

He had to squint and enhance his vision to be certain he was seeing correctly. There was a humanoid entity wearing a simple straw hat, holding a fishing pole with one hand while the line was cast down into the endless unstable obsidian expanse far below.
The being appeared remarkably human at first glance. But as Noah’s perception sharpened, he noticed the malformation that marked this entity as a Ginnu Lifeform.

The figure possessed six arms in total, though only one currently held the fishing pole. The other five rested casually at different positions along their torso. Their skin carried faint obsidian patterns that pulsed with concentrated authority.
Tendrils of obsidian radiance wrapped around the fishing line, extending down into the chaos below as if the entity was literally fishing in the unstable weavings of existence itself.
The being looked up calmly as Noah and Ul’moreth completed their descent and arrival.
|Ul’moreth, what have you brought over now?| the entity asked with a voice carrying relaxed curiosity mixed with mild amusement, of course, it was expressed through The First Tongue!
Ul’moreth replied with measured calm as they landed on the solid surface.

|Something new in existence, or really something unfathomably old depending on your preferred definition,| he said with tone suggesting significance. |Ains, meet Little Anomaly. Little Anomaly, this is Ains, THE Fisherman.|
Noah’s eyes shone brightly with analytical focus as he looked at this tremendously powerful being. He nodded and used pure Primus Mana to express himself in greeting.
|Hello,| he communicated through concentrated pulse of Primus Mana.
The moment his greeting manifested, THE Fisherman’s eyes pulsed with sudden recognition. He squinted with closer examination before speaking with growing interest.
|Is that...|he began with voice trailing off.
Ul’moreth smiled beneath his obscuring hair and nodded with confirmation.

His tone became more contemplative.

Cannot inflate his ego when he knows so little and remains so comparatively weak. Cannot have him beginning to believe all of existence could potentially fall under his fingertips before he has even survived to maturity...he could die so, so quickly and easily after all because of his potential...|
Ul’moreth’s voice carried dark amusement.

|But hey, how many entities across all of existence have gone into the embrace of The First Tongue so completely? He is already so deeply in tune with it that if anyone does manage to collapse him, he may even make existence itself richer through his dissolution.|
THE Fisherman laughed heartily at this observation, his voice booming across the landscape.
|Bahaha, do not terrify the Little Anomaly with such morbid speculation!| he said with genuine mirth. |You brought him here for what purpose exactly?|
Ul’moreth responded with simple directness.
|Just some foundational teaching and demonstration. Help me out if I am missing anything critical in my explanations.|

|Name: Ains, THE Fisherman|
|Distinctions: THE Patient Angler, THE Keeper of Primordial Hooks, THE One Who Fishes In Chaos|
|Additional Information: VEILED|
|Note: This entity has deliberately obscured deeper analysis.|

Because he really was not.
All he genuinely had right now was potential.

And potential was an extraordinarily dangerous thing if one mistook it for actual present strength. He had the theoretical potential to arguably stand against and possibly even exceed entities like THE Creature and THE Living Paradox eventually. That was the extent of what his current advantages represented.

He absolutely would not allow himself to be deluded by how boundless and infinite this potential appeared to be. For now, he would calmly continue to expand his knowledge systematically and gather more critical information.
It seemed existence had truly unfathomable depths and mysteries still waiting to be discovered.
So he observed THE Fisherman with attention as he and Ul’moreth came to fully stand before him.
New prompts flashed before Noah’s vision with environmental information.
|You have arrived at: The Primordial Genesis Shore|
|Classification: Ancient Ginnu Settlement|
|Description: One of the first stable landmasses formed in Ginnungagap.|
|Inhabitants: Unknown number of Ginnu Lifeforms of varying power levels.|
|Warning: This location contains entities at THE Surface Depth and potentially beyond.|
|Environmental Properties: Minimal suppression for those who speak/know The First Tongue.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4576 - Capítulo 4576: The First Tongue VII
paragraphs: Capítulo 4576: The First Tongue VII
Noah processed this information with growing understanding of just how significant this location was. The Primordial Genesis Shore!
One of the first places where chaos became order, where The First Tongue permeated thoroughly!
He stared at the seeming endlessness of the landscape stretching before him and wondered with genuine curiosity what other terrifying entities and incomprehensible things lay within its vast depths.
|Little Anomaly.|
Ul’moreth’s voice called out to him with focus, pulling his attention back from contemplation of the environment.

|Before I take you deeper into the Shore to meet others and show you more of what exists here, let me provide you with some rudimentary foundational knowledge,| he said with measured purpose. |So that someone with your extraordinary potential does not embarrass themselves through ignorance when encountering those who understand these concepts intimately.|
The space around Ul’moreth began to shimmer as his obsidian gold authority manifested into illusory diagrams that would illustrate his upcoming explanation.

|You vibrate your Mana with such remarkable purity, Little Anomaly, and yet you do not truly speak in the linguistic sense,| he began with voice carrying patient instruction. |You shout formless intent into the void and expect existence to interpret your meaning successfully. Like an infant crying without developed vocabulary, relying entirely on others to guess what you need based on emotional tone alone.|
An illusory image formed showing an entity releasing shapeless bursts of energy.

|But what if I told you that The First Tongue is not merely a poetic metaphor I use for dramatic effect? What if I explained further that Mana, or more accurately The First Tongue itself, is quite literally a language with grammar, syntax, vocabulary, and structural rules as precise as any spoken tongue? In fact, considerably more precise than any verbal language could ever achieve.|
The diagram shifted to show structured patterns of Mana arranged with glorious precision.

|This knowledge is not known by many across the vast expanses of existence,| Ul’moreth continued with emphasis. |Beyond us Ginnu Lifeforms who were born when The First Tongue was still actively being formed and refined, and perhaps a scattered handful of truly exceptional entities across all the eras who somehow stumbled upon fragments of this understanding through extraordinary circumstances, virtually no one in the Infinite Unfurling comprehends that Mana, that The First Tongue, can be wielded as the fundamental language of existence itself rather than merely as raw energy to be shaped through will.|

|The First Tongue, at its most fundamental basic unit of expression, contains what we call a Phoneme. A single letter in the alphabet of reality itself. Every Phoneme, every deliberately structured pulse of pure undifferentiated Mana, represents a fundamental unit of meaning. Like the letters of any alphabet, individually quite simple in isolation, but capable of infinite complexity when properly combined through grammatical rules.|
The illusory diagrams showed individual pulses combining into more complex structures.

|What you have been doing, spreading your infinite Mana across Ginnungagap’s domains, is functionally equivalent to shouting the same vowel sound repeatedly at progressively increasing volume,| he said with tone mixing observation and instruction. |Impressive in its raw power and fundamental purity, absolutely. But utterly lacking in sophisticated linguistic meaning. You produce the raw sound successfully, but you do not form actual words. And without constructing proper words, Little Anomaly, you cannot speak the complete sentences that reshape reality at its deepest foundational levels.|

|I tell you this not to diminish what you have already accomplished, which is genuinely extraordinary,| Ul’moreth added with reassuring emphasis. |But rather to illuminate how much further you can potentially advance from this already impressive foundation. You already possess what nearly all of existence does not have access to. The direct connection to pure undifferentiated Mana that allows The First Tongue to be spoken freely at all.|

|This is extraordinarily rare beyond measure. Most entities could dedicate eternity itself to trying to learn what I am about to teach you and never succeed in even basic comprehension, because they have specialized too far from the primordial source. They have traded versatility for focused power and cannot return to the undifferentiated state.|
The diagrams showed branching paths, with most leading away from a central source while one path maintained connection.

|The First Tongue operates across multiple fundamental tiers of expression, each building upon the previous level like a tower reaching toward absolute comprehension of existence itself. But we will start with the foundation.|

Nearby, Noah listened with complete focus as his existence continued to advance with each piece of new information. His THE Organ of Civilization was making measurable progress with every additional concept integrated into his understanding!
He noticed THE Fisherman shake his head with apparent boredom at Ul’moreth’s lengthy explanation.
The entity pulled up his fishing line and examined it, finding nothing caught. He cast it back out into the chaotic waters below with practiced motion.

|Ul’moreth, all your extended talking has thoroughly bored me,| THE Fisherman said with voice carrying playful criticism. |Let me take over the explanation for the Little One here. My voice has considerably sweeter quality to it than your ancient droning, yes?|
He turned his attention directly to Noah with more animated energy.

|So Little Anomaly, continuing from where Ul’moreth was heading before he put us all to sleep with excessive verbosity, let me explain the basic foundational level of The First Tongue with more efficiency.|

|The first tier of expression is what we call Phonemes as he was trying to mention. These are the individual pulses, the basic units of structured Mana that every entity across existence manipulates and releases, usually without any conscious awareness of what they are truly doing from a linguistic perspective. When you release a burst of Mana to create some effect, you are producing Phonemes. But you produce them as raw, unstructured expressions.|
THE Fisherman gestured with one of his free hands for emphasis.

|We Ginnu Lifeforms understand Phonemes as letters, as the fundamental alphabet of existence itself. We know intrinsically that each pulse can be shaped with intentional structure, with grammatical precision, to produce effects that completely transcend mere energy manipulation. This is why our malformed bodies can wield authority that seems utterly impossible by conventional understanding. We are not breaking or violating the rules of existence, Little Anomaly. We are speaking fluently in its native language while all others fumble awkwardly with broken dialects and corrupted vocabulary.|
He looked over at Ul’moreth with amused expression.
|Bahaha, Ul’moreth, how was that explanation? More concise, yes? I believe I captured the slight undertone of arrogance in your typical voice quite accurately, yes?|

Ul’moreth’s form remained still, though Noah imagined the ancient being was blinking with mild exasperation beneath all that obscuring hair. They turned their attention back to Noah and continued the lesson.

|I will resume the explanation from here,| Ul’moreth said with patient tone. |There are higher tiers of expression beyond individual Phonemes, structures of increasing linguistic complexity that I will not burden you with until you have properly mastered the basics. Let me focus your attention on teaching you to speak individual letters correctly before we even attempt to construct complete words.|
|Even this foundation, properly understood and applied with skill, will elevate your capabilities beyond what most THE level entities can achieve across their entire existence.|
His presence intensified with significance.

|This is the gift I offer you, Little Anomaly. The ability to speak rather than merely shout, to construct precise linguistic meaning rather than rely entirely on formless intent. Are you prepared to learn The First Tongue as it was originally meant to be spoken?|
The question hung in the air with tremendous weight.
Noah felt his rapidly expanding existence resonating with the knowledge being shared. He replied with simple conviction as his eyes pulsed with a glorious sense of tyranny!
|I am ready to learn.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4577 - Capítulo 4577: The First Tongue VIII
paragraphs: Capítulo 4577: The First Tongue VIII
|Now we begin the true lesson, Little Anomaly,| Ul’moreth said with voice carrying the accumulated gravity of ages.

|A single Phoneme, Little Anomaly, could represent the concept of Fire. Another might embody Ice. Still others express concepts like Motion, Stillness, Expansion, Compression, Life, Death, and countless others spanning all possible ideas. Each one is a complete letter in the alphabet of existence itself, a basic unit of meaning that The First Tongue uses to construct more complex expressions.|

|It is possible for entities at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty to potentially learn individual Phonemes if they maintain adequate connection to The First Tongue. Below that level of power, an anomaly like yourself will find it relatively easy to accomplish. For others without your unique advantages, successfully learning even one Phoneme would be an extraordinary rarity. Unless they possess a genuinely deep connection with The First Tongue naturally.|
His voice intensified with the weight of revelation.

| When you speak a Phoneme of The First Tongue, when you properly activate that single pulse representing a concept, you are not merely generating an effect through your own limited personal power and individual understanding.|

|The Phoneme, when spoken correctly with proper pronunciation and structural integrity, automatically borrows and channels power from all the surrounding Principles of Existence that are prevalent across reality itself. It reaches out through the fundamental fabric of existence and draws upon the accumulated weight of every expression of that concept that has ever manifested anywhere across all domains and all time.|
The revelation hung in the surrounding air like thunder waiting to strike.
Noah blinked.
What?
He had to rewind what he heard and replay it again!

When you activate a Phenome, you would not merely be generating an effect with your own power? You would borrow power and channel the power of all surrounding Principles of Existence that are prevalent?
What?!

|Let me make this abundantly clear with a concrete example that will demonstrate the magnitude of difference we are discussing here. If you, with your current level of cultivation, were to generate fire through conventional energy manipulation means, you would be producing flame powered exclusively by your own Mana reserves, shaped by your own personal comprehension, limited strictly by your own developed Principles. The result would be fire scaled precisely to your individual capability and nothing more.|

|But if you were to speak the Phoneme of Fire in The First Tongue, if you were to utter that single basic letter with proper pronunciation and structural accuracy, the effect would be categorically different in nature. That single pulse would reach out across existence and borrow power from the surrounding fire based Principles of Existence that are woven permanently into the very fabric of reality.|
His presence leaned closer with teaching emphasis.

|Simply whispering the letter for Fire in The First Tongue, even imperfectly with flawed pronunciation, will unleash flame backed by multiple Grand Principles that exist across all domains. And if you spoke that Phoneme with sufficient perfection, with flawless pronunciation and complete structural understanding, it would draw upon even Singularity Principles related to the concept of Fire.|

|The flames produced would not be your fire, Little Anomaly. They would be Fire itself, the platonic ideal of combustion and transformative heat, channeled through your utterance but powered by the accumulated weight of that concept across all of existence. Do you comprehend the fundamental difference? This is not merely a matter of quantitative scale. This is qualitatively different in kind.|
Noah’s mind reeled with the staggering implications as Ul’moreth continued his explanation.

|This is why The First Tongue is considered the original language through which existence burned with creative force. Because when existence first declared let there be Fire, it was not generating flame through personal effort or individual power. It was speaking a Phoneme that defined what Fire would be across all future reality, establishing the Principles that would govern combustion forever after.|

|And this is also why so few entities across all of existence understand or can effectively utilize The First Tongue, Little Anomaly. It is not merely difficult to learn. It is almost impossible for those who have already deeply specialized into particular dialects. Once you have committed yourself fully to The Way of Storm or The Way of Hunger or any other specialized path, you have fundamentally altered your existence to resonate with that particular frequency.|

|Attempting to speak The First Tongue in its pure form after such deep specialization is like trying to sing in a vocal register your physical form can no longer reach. The capability has been permanently traded away in exchange for focused mastery. It is not absolutely impossible, as there are exceptional monsters out there who can still accomplish it despite specialization. But mainly those who have some connection to undifferentiated Mana, or those who recognize their Way stems from The First Tongue and inherently maintain a connection to it in its purest state, retain the ability to speak these Phonemes with any real effectiveness.|
His obsidian gold hair began to shimmer with concentrated purpose and building power.

|Now, Little Anomaly, let me demonstrate what a single Phoneme can accomplish when spoken with adequate understanding and sufficient power. Watch carefully with all your enhanced perception. Observe not just the result, but the underlying structure of what I am doing. This...is the Phoneme of Fire.|
HUUM!
Ul’moreth’s entire being seemed to become perfectly still for a moment. Then he began to vibrate with a specific pattern that Noah could perceive through his enhanced senses.
The Phoneme of Fire.

Externally, it manifested as a sound that was not quite sound in any conventional sense. It was more like a fundamental frequency that existence itself recognized and responded to instinctively. A single sustained pulse of Mana vibrating at a specific rate that represented the complete concept of combustion, of transformation through heat, of energy unleashed through rapid oxidation.
But Noah could see considerably deeper than just the surface manifestation. He could observe the internal structure of what Ul’moreth was actually doing beneath the obvious display.

The ancient being was not simply releasing shapeless Mana into the environment. He was shaping it into a precise linguistic pattern, a grammatical construct that existence itself could read and interpret like written text. The pulse had rhythm, cadence, tonal quality. It was a complete declarative statement compressed into a single letter.
And as that Phoneme was spoken with Ul’moreth’s tremendous accumulated power and flawless understanding backing it, Noah witnessed something truly extraordinary.

The light of multiple Principles he could barely recognize began to shimmer in the surrounding environment. These were not Principles that Ul’moreth personally possessed or had utilized himself. They were Principles related to Fire that existed prevalently throughout Ginnungagap and even beyond.
The Principle of Rapid Transformation. The Principle of Consuming Heat. The Principle of Elemental Fury. And numerous others Noah could not fully identify or comprehend.
All of them responded immediately to the spoken Phoneme. All of them offered their accumulated power to support the utterance.
In the next moment, reality itself seemed to tear open above them with violent force.
An infinitely rising pillar of obsidian gold fire erupted into the skies of Ginnungagap with such devastating power that the environment itself trembled from the manifestation!
The flames were not normal combustion by any measure. They burned with concentrated authority that completely transcended conventional understanding.

The heat radiating from the pillar was so intense that Ul’moreth had to immediately position himself protectively in front of Noah, his hair extending outward to form a shielding barrier. Even with that substantial protection, Noah could feel the terrifically scorching temperature trying to penetrate through.

Nearby, THE Fisherman made a sound of mild annoyance as if the temperature had gotten slightly too uncomfortable for his casual fishing. He harrumphed with displeasure and calmly went back to observing his line.

Meanwhile, Noah’s mind processed the power level with shocking recognition. That infinitely rising column of obsidian gold fire possessed enough concentrated force to completely scorch and incinerate a THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity without any difficulty whatsoever. It was flame backed by the accumulated weight of Fire as a concept across all of existence.
From a single letter. From one Phoneme spoken with proper pronunciation and adequate power.

The pillar continued burning in the sky above them like a beacon of primordial creative force as Ul’moreth allowed it to persist for several more demonstrative moments before finally ceasing his utterance.
The obsidian gold flames dissipated gradually, leaving the surrounding environment scorched but fundamentally intact.
Ul’moreth turned back to face Noah fully, his presence radiating satisfaction at the successful demonstration.

|That, Little Anomaly, was the result of a single Phoneme of The First Tongue,| he said with voice carrying measured intensity. |One letter from the languagr of existence, spoken with adequate power and understanding. Not a complete word, not a sentence, not a paragraph of complex meaning. Simply the equivalent of pronouncing the letter F in your crude common speech.|

|But because it was uttered by someone like me, with my accumulated power and deep understanding of The First Tongue’s linguistic structure, that single letter channeled enough force to extinguish weak THE entities completely. If I had spoken a complete set of Phonemes, something we call a Logos which represents a full word constructed from multiple Phonemes arranged with grammatical precision, the effect would have been incomparably more devastating.|
Oh!
Phenomes were the letters, and Logos...were words!
But he was just getting introduced to the letters at this moment.
Ul’moreth’s obsidian gold hair flowed with purposeful motion as he continued his explanation.

|The Phoneme I just demonstrated represents a concept that can only crudely be translated into common language as Fire, or Immolation, or Combustion, or any other woefully inadequate definition of flame and transformative heat. But The First Tongue does not deal in such imprecise terminology. The Phoneme contains the complete and total essence of what Fire is at a fundamental level of existence.|

|When spoken properly, it does not politely ask existence “please create fire for me if you would be so kind.” It authoritatively declares “Fire exists here now” with such absolute conviction that reality has no choice whatsoever but to comply immediately. And because the declaration is made in existence’s own native language, it responds with the full accumulated weight of that concept across all its manifestations throughout all of reality.|
Ul’moreth’s presence seemed to focus entirely on Noah with concentrated teaching intensity.

|This will be the first Phoneme I teach you to speak properly, Little Anomaly. The letter that represents the primordial concept of transformative heat and consuming flame. And before you object that there might be simpler starting points for a beginning student, understand that I am choosing this particular Phoneme quite deliberately for specific pedagogical reasons.|

|Fire is one of the most fundamental concepts in structured existence. It was among the very first expressions when The First Tongue began differentiating into specialized forms. Learning to speak this Phoneme will teach you the basic grammar and underlying structure that supports all other Phonemes. Master this one, and all the others will become progressively easier to learn through pattern recognition.|
BOOM!
The weight of this teaching settled over Noah as he prepared himself to attempt the impossible.
Learning to speak existence’s native language!
His existence radiated a profound sense of quintessential tyranny as he closed his eyes...and he breathed.

sentences.text: Capítulo 4577: The First Tongue VIII
|Now we begin the true lesson, Little Anomaly,| Ul’moreth said with voice carrying the accumulated gravity of ages.
|A single Phoneme, Little Anomaly, could represent the concept of Fire.
Another might embody Ice.
Still others express concepts like Motion, Stillness, Expansion, Compression, Life, Death, and countless others spanning all possible ideas.
Each one is a complete letter in the alphabet of existence itself, a basic unit of meaning that The First Tongue uses to construct more complex expressions.|
|It is possible for entities at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty to potentially learn individual Phonemes if they maintain adequate connection to The First Tongue.
Below that level of power, an anomaly like yourself will find it relatively easy to accomplish.
For others without your unique advantages, successfully learning even one Phoneme would be an extraordinary rarity.
Unless they possess a genuinely deep connection with The First Tongue naturally.|
His voice intensified with the weight of revelation.

| When you speak a Phoneme of The First Tongue, when you properly activate that single pulse representing a concept, you are not merely generating an effect through your own limited personal power and individual understanding.|

|The Phoneme, when spoken correctly with proper pronunciation and structural integrity, automatically borrows and channels power from all the surrounding Principles of Existence that are prevalent across reality itself.

It reaches out through the fundamental fabric of existence and draws upon the accumulated weight of every expression of that concept that has ever manifested anywhere across all domains and all time.|
The revelation hung in the surrounding air like thunder waiting to strike.
Noah blinked.
What?
He had to rewind what he heard and replay it again!
When you activate a Phenome, you would not merely be generating an effect with your own power?
You would borrow power and channel the power of all surrounding Principles of Existence that are prevalent?
What?!
|Let me make this abundantly clear with a concrete example that will demonstrate the magnitude of difference we are discussing here.

If you, with your current level of cultivation, were to generate fire through conventional energy manipulation means, you would be producing flame powered exclusively by your own Mana reserves, shaped by your own personal comprehension, limited strictly by your own developed Principles.
The result would be fire scaled precisely to your individual capability and nothing more.|

|But if you were to speak the Phoneme of Fire in The First Tongue, if you were to utter that single basic letter with proper pronunciation and structural accuracy, the effect would be categorically different in nature.
That single pulse would reach out across existence and borrow power from the surrounding fire based Principles of Existence that are woven permanently into the very fabric of reality.|
His presence leaned closer with teaching emphasis.
|Simply whispering the letter for Fire in The First Tongue, even imperfectly with flawed pronunciation, will unleash flame backed by multiple Grand Principles that exist across all domains.

And if you spoke that Phoneme with sufficient perfection, with flawless pronunciation and complete structural understanding, it would draw upon even Singularity Principles related to the concept of Fire.|
|The flames produced would not be your fire, Little Anomaly.
They would be Fire itself, the platonic ideal of combustion and transformative heat, channeled through your utterance but powered by the accumulated weight of that concept across all of existence.
Do you comprehend the fundamental difference?
This is not merely a matter of quantitative scale.
This is qualitatively different in kind.|
Noah’s mind reeled with the staggering implications as Ul’moreth continued his explanation.
|This is why The First Tongue is considered the original language through which existence burned with creative force.
Because when existence first declared let there be Fire, it was not generating flame through personal effort or individual power.
It was speaking a Phoneme that defined what Fire would be across all future reality, establishing the Principles that would govern combustion forever after.|
|And this is also why so few entities across all of existence understand or can effectively utilize The First Tongue, Little Anomaly.
It is not merely difficult to learn.
It is almost impossible for those who have already deeply specialized into particular dialects.

Once you have committed yourself fully to The Way of Storm or The Way of Hunger or any other specialized path, you have fundamentally altered your existence to resonate with that particular frequency.|
|Attempting to speak The First Tongue in its pure form after such deep specialization is like trying to sing in a vocal register your physical form can no longer reach.
The capability has been permanently traded away in exchange for focused mastery.
It is not absolutely impossible, as there are exceptional monsters out there who can still accomplish it despite specialization.

But mainly those who have some connection to undifferentiated Mana, or those who recognize their Way stems from The First Tongue and inherently maintain a connection to it in its purest state, retain the ability to speak these Phonemes with any real effectiveness.|
His obsidian gold hair began to shimmer with concentrated purpose and building power.
|Now, Little Anomaly, let me demonstrate what a single Phoneme can accomplish when spoken with adequate understanding and sufficient power.
Watch carefully with all your enhanced perception.
Observe not just the result, but the underlying structure of what I am doing.
This...is the Phoneme of Fire.|
HUUM!
Ul’moreth’s entire being seemed to become perfectly still for a moment.
Then he began to vibrate with a specific pattern that Noah could perceive through his enhanced senses.
The Phoneme of Fire.
Externally, it manifested as a sound that was not quite sound in any conventional sense.
It was more like a fundamental frequency that existence itself recognized and responded to instinctively.
A single sustained pulse of Mana vibrating at a specific rate that represented the complete concept of combustion, of transformation through heat, of energy unleashed through rapid oxidation.
But Noah could see considerably deeper than just the surface manifestation.
He could observe the internal structure of what Ul’moreth was actually doing beneath the obvious display.
The ancient being was not simply releasing shapeless Mana into the environment.
He was shaping it into a precise linguistic pattern, a grammatical construct that existence itself could read and interpret like written text.
The pulse had rhythm, cadence, tonal quality.
It was a complete declarative statement compressed into a single letter.
And as that Phoneme was spoken with Ul’moreth’s tremendous accumulated power and flawless understanding backing it, Noah witnessed something truly extraordinary.
The light of multiple Principles he could barely recognize began to shimmer in the surrounding environment.
These were not Principles that Ul’moreth personally possessed or had utilized himself.
They were Principles related to Fire that existed prevalently throughout Ginnungagap and even beyond.
The Principle of Rapid Transformation.
The Principle of Consuming Heat.
The Principle of Elemental Fury.

All of them responded immediately to the spoken Phoneme.
All of them offered their accumulated power to support the utterance.
In the next moment, reality itself seemed to tear open above them with violent force.

They burned with concentrated authority that completely transcended conventional understanding.
