paragraphs: Capítulo 4578: The First Tongue IX
In another corner of Ginnungagap, separated by countless Gigaparsecs from the peaceful shore where teaching was occurring, a very different scene unfolded.
While Noah received instruction on a single letter, a Phoneme of The First Tongue, something remarkably similar was manifesting elsewhere with far more violent intent.

The battle between THE First Hunger and THE Living Origin against the three Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms had escalated to a critical point. The serpentine dragon with crystallized obsidian scales had locked multiple heads around Tor’s arms, attempting to collapse his Way through dimensional compression. The massive arachnid struck from temporal angles, its legs piercing through past and future simultaneously. The liquid obsidian mass flowed between solid and ethereal states, absorbing attacks and reforming to strike back.
Tor cursed violently as he sensed something shifting in the fundamental nature of the battle.
“They are doing their monstrous things!” he roared with recognition and mounting frustration.
The three Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms suddenly stopped their physical assault. Their bodies began to vibrate with synchronized purpose, their malformed structures pulsing with concentrated power.
Faint flickers of pure Mana, hidden deep within their core existence, activated simultaneously.
They were speaking The First Tongue!
All three entities began to utter a single letter with tremendous effort and power expenditure. A letter that most closely represented the concept of Fire in existence’s native language.
The surrounding reality responded immediately to their pronunciation.

Multiple Grand Principles related to flame and combustion began to shimmer into visibility throughout the chaotic landscape. The Principle of Consuming Heat manifested as waves of distortion. The Principle of Elemental Fury pulsed with building intensity. The Principle of Rapid Transformation flickered at the edges of perception.
Then Singularity Principles began to respond as well, lending their incomparably greater weight to the utterance.
Three pillars of terrifying flame erupted simultaneously from the Ginnu Lifeforms, each with its own unique coloration based on the entity conjuring it.

The serpentine dragon produced flames of deep crimson mixed with obsidian black, spiraling upward with devouring hunger. The arachnid’s fire manifested as pale violet that existed partially in multiple temporal states, burning past and future simultaneously. The liquid mass generated silver white flames that shifted between solid and ethereal just like its own form!
All three pillars converged on THE First Hunger and THE Living Origin with devastating force.
Tor’s eyes widened with genuine alarm as he felt the concentrated power bearing down on them. This was by far the strongest attack they had faced in this entire miserable encounter!

THE Living Origin was already moving, her Way of Origin manifesting as defensive chains that attempted to bind the incoming flames to their foundational state before combustion. White gold barriers formed in intricate geometric patterns.

Tor released seas of obsidian crimson Hunger that devoured massive sections of the approaching fire, consuming the flames before they could reach them. His jaws opened impossibly wide, creating voids that swallowed existence itself.
The collision created spectacular explosions of conflicting authorities as fundamental concepts warred against each other.
Fire tried to consume. Hunger tried to devour. Origin tried to reduce everything to its source state.
The landscape around them scorched and cracked from the sheer intensity of power being exchanged. Reality itself groaned under the pressure of so many high level Principles activating simultaneously.

But despite the terrifying nature of the attack, both THE entities proved their competence and vast experience. Through coordinated effort and masterful application of their Ways, they managed to defend against and systematically disperse the converging pillars of flame.
Tor stood amidst the dissipating fire with expression of absolute rage. His entire body radiated killing intent as his Way pulsed with fury.
“Okay. Okay! That’s it!” he roared with voice shaking the environment. “I tried to hold back somewhat in this damned suppressive place, but no more restraint!”
His obsidian crimson Hunger exploded outward with terrifying new intensity.

They were holding back somewhat. Because they knew...one should not easily kill a Malformed Ginnu Lifeform! One Ginnu killed would have one branded and hunted down by all other Ginnu as they would not survive Ginnungagap!
Back on the Primordial Genesis Shore, in the calm and ancient landscape, teaching continued without awareness of the violent events occurring elsewhere.
Ul’moreth settled into a teaching posture, his entire demeanor shifting to that of patient instructor.

|Now, Little Anomaly, I will break down the internal structure of this Phoneme so you can understand what you must reproduce,| he said with measured focus. |Pay attention to every detail, because pronunciation is absolutely critical. A single error in frequency, rhythm, or tonal quality will cause the Phoneme to fail completely, or worse, to produce unpredictable and potentially catastrophic results.|
Noah kept his eyes closed and breathed in and out with steady rhythm as he listened with complete concentration.

|The Phoneme of Fire begins with a rising pulse,| Ul’moreth explained with clarity. |You must start at a baseline frequency that resonates with undifferentiated Mana, then systematically increase the vibration rate. But this is not a smooth, continuous increase. It must follow a specific progression that matches the natural expansion rate of combustion.|
His voice carried the weight of precise instruction accumulated over eons.

|As you raise the frequency, you must simultaneously compress the Mana into tighter and tighter density. This creates internal tension, potential energy waiting to be released. The compression follows an inverse relationship to the frequency increase. As one rises, the other contracts proportionally.|

|When the frequency reaches a specific threshold, one that you will learn to recognize through practice, you must introduce a percussive accent. A sharp spike in intensity that punctuates the rising tone. This accent represents the ignition point, the moment when potential becomes kinetic, when compression transforms into expansion.|

|Immediately following the accent, you must allow the Mana to explode outward in a controlled expansion. Throughout all of this, you must maintain a specific emotional and intentional quality. The Phoneme is not just mechanics and mathematics. It carries meaning, purpose, identity. Fire is transformation, consumption, purification, destruction that enables renewal. Your intent must embody all of these qualities simultaneously without contradiction.|
Ul’moreth paused deliberately to ensure Noah was absorbing the full complexity of what was being taught.

|The entire sequence, from initial pulse to final expansion, must occur within a precise temporal window. Too slow, and the Phoneme loses coherence and dissipates without effect. Too fast, and the structure collapses before it can channel the surrounding Principles. The timing I am about to demonstrate represents the minimum viable duration for this Phoneme.|
The ancient being prepared himself again for another demonstration with teaching purpose.

|Watch now as I speak the Phoneme once more, but this time I will slow down the process significantly so you can observe each component separately. In actual practice, these elements blend together seamlessly, but for teaching purposes, I will separate them for your analysis.|
Ul’moreth began to vibrate again, but this time the Phoneme unfolded in deliberate slow motion.
Noah kept his eyes closed and sensed everything with pure Mana, seeing colors even more vibrantly through his enhanced perception. He could observe each distinct phase with crystalline clarity.

The rising frequency that climbed from baseline. The simultaneous compression that created visible density increase in the concentrated energy. The sharp percussive accent that marked the critical transition point. The controlled explosion outward in geometric patterns.
Rising, compression, accent, expansion.
And threading through all of it like a fundamental melody, the intentional quality that gave the mechanics meaning and purpose!

This time, because the Phoneme was spoken slowly for teaching demonstration, the resulting fire was considerably less intense. Instead of an infinite pillar reaching toward the sky, a controlled sphere of obsidian gold flame manifested above them, rotating slowly to display its internal structure.

|Do you see the framework now, Little Anomaly?| Ul’moreth asked with patient instruction. |Each component serves a specific purpose. Remove any single element, and the Phoneme fails. Execute any element incorrectly, and the result will be flawed.|
The teaching flame dissipated as Ul’moreth concluded his explanation.

|This is not simple energy manipulation where close enough produces acceptable results. The First Tongue demands precision because it is fundamentally linguistic rather than merely mechanical. You are not generating fire through brute force. You are speaking a word that means Fire, and existence responds to correct pronunciation.|

|Now, Little Anomaly,| Ul’moreth said with voice carrying both encouragement and challenge. |I have demonstrated the Phoneme twice. I have broken down its internal structure and explained each component. I have given you the theoretical framework you need to understand what you must accomplish.|
His presence seemed to focus entirely on Noah with concentrated teaching intensity.

|It is time for you to attempt speaking your first letter of The First Tongue. Do not expect success on your initial try, or your tenth, or your hundredth. Most entities require years of dedicated practice before they can produce even a flawed approximation of a single Phoneme. But you possess advantages that others do not. So perhaps you will surprise even these ancient expectations.|
Ul’moreth gestured for Noah to begin.
|Speak the Phoneme of Fire. Attempt to reproduce what I have demonstrated. And we shall see how quickly you can learn to speak existence’s native language.|
Truly speak in The First Tongue.
Noah could not help but smile as his mind currently existed in an unprecedented state of wonder and focused clarity.
He felt the beat of his Heart. He felt the rhythm of THE Organ of Civilization pulsing within his existence.
And he began.
Fire.
He knew Fire intimately. He held fire within him as one of his many cultivated concepts. Fire was one of his closest companions in his journey of advancement.
And he now simply needed to utter fire in a different language. In THE Language of Existence itself, in The First Tongue.

His Primus Mana burned with terrifying intensity as concentrated waves of The First Tongue surrounded him. His figure unconsciously began rising toward the skies, lifted by the sheer power flowing through him.
The rising frequency. The simultaneous compression. The sharp percussive accent. The controlled explosion outward.

He executed every single component in proper sequence with The First Tongue, and it felt natural. It felt normal, as if he should have always been communicating like this since the beginning of his existence.
And at the very end of the carefully structured sequence, he spoke.
|Fire.|
HUUM!
The word could not possibly encompass what the character truly stood for in The First Tongue. It was simply the most literal and inadequate translation possible.
The moment he uttered it with proper pronunciation and structure, everything changed.
BOOM!

He felt his THE Organ of Civilization explode with advancement alongside the rest of his existence. His Complexity and Purity spiked upward by hundreds of Decillions instantly as THE Organ of Civilization right away exceeded twenty percent development in a single magnificent leap.
And when he opened his eyes to observe what he had created, wonder filled his being.

He found himself floating at the center of a glorious and beautifully swirling hurricane of blue gold flames that rose infinitely toward the skies and began expanding outward across an entire Gigaparsec of space- powered by Principles he did not even have access to.
The flames were unique. They were Fire itself, the platonic ideal of transformative heat and consuming combustion, powered by the accumulated weight of that concept across all of existence.

They swirled around him in patterns of breathtaking complexity, forming geometric shapes that shifted and evolved. Blue gold light illuminated everything for vast distances, turning the sky into a canvas of primordial creative force.
Noah smiled with genuine sense of wonder mixed with recognition of the tyrannical power he had just manifested. He could instinctively feel the truth of what he had created.
These flames carried such concentrated authority that it would be impossibly difficult to find any Pre-THE entity who could survive contact with them!
Oh!
From speaking a single letter. From pronouncing one Phoneme of The First Tongue with adequate accuracy on his very first attempt.
Down below on the shore, far beneath the expanding hurricane of blue gold flames, two ancient beings looked at each other with very different expressions.
Ul’moreth stared upward at his student’s achievement with mixture of pride and shock.
|Well damn,| he said simply, his usual verbose nature momentarily stunned into brevity.
THE Fisherman had stopped his casual fishing entirely. His six arms were still as he gazed upward with serious and stern expression that contrasted sharply with his earlier playful demeanor.
When he spoke, his voice carried somber weight that made the gravity of the situation abundantly clear.

|This is dangerous, Ul’moreth,| he said with tone mixing concern and warning. |He is dangerous, which means he is therefore in immense danger himself. You have to be extremely careful with how you handle this Little Anomaly. One wrong step, and The Others will descend upon him.|
WAA!
The implications hung heavy in the air as they both continued watching Noah floating at the center of his first spoken word in existence’s native language.
A hurricane of blue gold fire that proclaimed to nearby regions of Ginnungagap that something unprecedented had just occurred, even as Ul’moreth and THE Fisherman moved to conceal!

And threading through all of it like a fundamental melody, the intentional quality that gave the mechanics meaning and purpose!
This time, because the Phoneme was spoken slowly for teaching demonstration, the resulting fire was considerably less intense.
Instead of an infinite pillar reaching toward the sky, a controlled sphere of obsidian gold flame manifested above them, rotating slowly to display its internal structure.
|Do you see the framework now, Little Anomaly?| Ul’moreth asked with patient instruction. |Each component serves a specific purpose.
Remove any single element, and the Phoneme fails.
Execute any element incorrectly, and the result will be flawed.|
The teaching flame dissipated as Ul’moreth concluded his explanation.
|This is not simple energy manipulation where close enough produces acceptable results.
The First Tongue demands precision because it is fundamentally linguistic rather than merely mechanical.
You are not generating fire through brute force.
You are speaking a word that means Fire, and existence responds to correct pronunciation.|
|Now, Little Anomaly,| Ul’moreth said with voice carrying both encouragement and challenge. |I have demonstrated the Phoneme twice.
I have broken down its internal structure and explained each component.
I have given you the theoretical framework you need to understand what you must accomplish.|
His presence seemed to focus entirely on Noah with concentrated teaching intensity.
|It is time for you to attempt speaking your first letter of The First Tongue.
Do not expect success on your initial try, or your tenth, or your hundredth.
Most entities require years of dedicated practice before they can produce even a flawed approximation of a single Phoneme.
But you possess advantages that others do not.
So perhaps you will surprise even these ancient expectations.|
Ul’moreth gestured for Noah to begin.
|Speak the Phoneme of Fire.
Attempt to reproduce what I have demonstrated.
And we shall see how quickly you can learn to speak existence’s native language.|
Truly speak in The First Tongue.
Noah could not help but smile as his mind currently existed in an unprecedented state of wonder and focused clarity.
He felt the beat of his Heart.
He felt the rhythm of THE Organ of Civilization pulsing within his existence.
And he began.
Fire.
He knew Fire intimately.
He held fire within him as one of his many cultivated concepts.
Fire was one of his closest companions in his journey of advancement.
And he now simply needed to utter fire in a different language.
In THE Language of Existence itself, in The First Tongue.
His Primus Mana burned with terrifying intensity as concentrated waves of The First Tongue surrounded him.
His figure unconsciously began rising toward the skies, lifted by the sheer power flowing through him.
The rising frequency.
The simultaneous compression.
The sharp percussive accent.
The controlled explosion outward.
He executed every single component in proper sequence with The First Tongue, and it felt natural.
It felt normal, as if he should have always been communicating like this since the beginning of his existence.
And at the very end of the carefully structured sequence, he spoke.
|Fire.|
HUUM!
The word could not possibly encompass what the character truly stood for in The First Tongue.
It was simply the most literal and inadequate translation possible.
The moment he uttered it with proper pronunciation and structure, everything changed.
BOOM!
He felt his THE Organ of Civilization explode with advancement alongside the rest of his existence.
His Complexity and Purity spiked upward by hundreds of Decillions instantly as THE Organ of Civilization right away exceeded twenty percent development in a single magnificent leap.
And when he opened his eyes to observe what he had created, wonder filled his being.

He found himself floating at the center of a glorious and beautifully swirling hurricane of blue gold flames that rose infinitely toward the skies and began expanding outward across an entire Gigaparsec of space- powered by Principles he did not even have access to.
The flames were unique.
They were Fire itself, the platonic ideal of transformative heat and consuming combustion, powered by the accumulated weight of that concept across all of existence.
They swirled around him in patterns of breathtaking complexity, forming geometric shapes that shifted and evolved.
Blue gold light illuminated everything for vast distances, turning the sky into a canvas of primordial creative force.
Noah smiled with genuine sense of wonder mixed with recognition of the tyrannical power he had just manifested.
He could instinctively feel the truth of what he had created.
These flames carried such concentrated authority that it would be impossibly difficult to find any Pre-THE entity who could survive contact with them!
Oh!
From speaking a single letter.
From pronouncing one Phoneme of The First Tongue with adequate accuracy on his very first attempt.
Down below on the shore, far beneath the expanding hurricane of blue gold flames, two ancient beings looked at each other with very different expressions.
Ul’moreth stared upward at his student’s achievement with mixture of pride and shock.
|Well damn,| he said simply, his usual verbose nature momentarily stunned into brevity.
THE Fisherman had stopped his casual fishing entirely.
His six arms were still as he gazed upward with serious and stern expression that contrasted sharply with his earlier playful demeanor.
When he spoke, his voice carried somber weight that made the gravity of the situation abundantly clear.
|This is dangerous, Ul’moreth,| he said with tone mixing concern and warning. |He is dangerous, which means he is therefore in immense danger himself.
You have to be extremely careful with how you handle this Little Anomaly.
One wrong step, and The Others will descend upon him.|
WAA!
The implications hung heavy in the air as they both continued watching Noah floating at the center of his first spoken word in existence’s native language.
A hurricane of blue gold fire that proclaimed to nearby regions of Ginnungagap that something unprecedented had just occurred, even as Ul’moreth and THE Fisherman moved to conceal!

paragraphs: Capítulo 4579: The First Tongue X
Far from the Infinite Unfurling, far from Ginnungagap’s ancient shores where teaching and wonder unfolded, there existed a place that defied conventional understanding.
Inside THE Loom.

An endless sea of obsidian gold paradox stretched infinitely in all directions, filled with unfathomable musings of existence itself. The paradox was not empty abstraction. It contained actual immense Weavings of Existence alongside its inner workings, its flow, and even more horrifyingly, the way that existence expressed itself through fundamental language.

The sea of paradox seemed to sit atop all of it with tyrannical glory, drowning everything beneath its weight while simultaneously revealing truths that should remain hidden. And even this overwhelming perception was merely what could be glimpsed at surface level. There were countless more intricacies lurking in depths that defied comprehension in this mere glimpse.

In such a terrifying sea, there floated a singular entity with eyes closed as if relaxing in peaceful meditation. His entire existence wore the allure of paradox itself, his form refusing to sit still or maintain consistent state. This was a manifestation of THE Living Paradox. Not his true self, but a powerful projection.
But moments later, the expression alone told a different story. The calmness and relaxation faded completely as a frown appeared on features that rarely showed such emotion.
Something had occurred that should not have occurred.

He maintained countless countermeasures in place to notify him of any major changes across existence. His enemy was THE Creature, the entity that had triumphed in the Infinite Unfurling against all others through methods that remained fucking terrifying even to contemplate.

So THE Living Paradox required countless safeguards and monitoring systems for this entity. Even now, with all his accumulated victories and advantages, he knew with absolute certainty that he had not truly won.
But something had just occurred. A change in the fundamental patterns he observed. And as he pondered what it might be, his frown deepened further as he turned his gaze toward a certain direction.
A place outside THE Loom.
A place where something unprecedented was unfolding.
In the domain that used to be THE Transcendent Paradoxical Folds, now reduced to something far more terrible, the devastation defied description.

The region had become a zone of immense collapse. All of existence in this area seemed dark, swallowed by shadows that consumed light and meaning alike. The only point of illumination came from a single source.

The figure of The Disciple of THE Creature raised a sword that shone brilliantly like a solitary candle of existence refusing to be extinguished. The blade radiated light that seemed to hold a glimmer of a Genesis Principle woven into its very structure.
That faint illumination revealed the absolutely devastating state of the battlefield.

All the False THE Avatars from THE Loom either seemed to be missing entirely or only parts of their bodies remained visible, scattered across the collapsed landscape like discarded toys. Limbs, torsos, heads, all separated and dissolving slowly.
The only one still living and intact was Ambessa, her gaze unfathomably somber as she bellowed with desperation while being chased relentlessly by The First Farmer.
The ancient being moved with calm purpose, his voice carrying patient instruction.
“Stay still, the harvest will be quick and painless!”

Khor looked like a small walking calamity given physical form. Her entire presence radiated destruction barely contained. She directed a deadly concentrated gaze toward Schrodinger at this moment, preparing to eliminate that particular threat.
But the figure of The Disciple of THE Creature stepping forward with raised sword caused her to pause with genuine caution. That blade was dangerous even to her.
In the midst of such a terrifying scene of absolute devastation, the figure of The Infiniverse stood with unusual stillness.

She had silently already sent a message to Alexander Asmodeus that he did not need to attempt anything with the Shattered Part of The Heart of Law. His services were no longer required for that particular task.
Because at this moment, something far more significant was occurring.
|Sis, did you receive all that?!| The voice of Ruination echoed out with genuine shock and excitement.

She was referring to the lesson Noah had transmitted across time and space through their absolute connection. The teaching he had received, he had immediately shared with his most important constructs.

The connection between Ruination, The Infiniverse, and Noah remained absolute and unbreakable. At this moment, The Infiniverse nodded as she almost seemed to enter a daze before replying with voice carrying wonder.
|I got it. I fucking got it completely. The First Tongue!|
Ruination was shocked into silence at her sister’s unusual cursing!
The eyes of The Infiniverse held a hint of fanaticism as she processed the implications.

She had direct access to her Master’s weavings through their fundamental connection. She could pull from his Mana reserves as if they were her own. And she was already such an integral construct that existed on a scale bigger than any Transcendent Fold, more complex than any single domain across existence.

By her very nature as a living construct of unfathomable sophistication, The Infiniverse could effectively be considered similar to any Fold across existence. There...had to be weavings of Principles coursing through her structure that made up her existence, just as Principles wove through conventional reality.
In nature, Existence held Principles that most entities did not even know existed or could be accessed.
The First Tongue, through its letters alone, could induce power from surrounding Principles to act on behalf of the one speaking.

As the construct she was, with Principles forming the foundation of her very being, if she was now beginning to learn a language that could make it easier to perceive Principles and even freely initiate assistance from them...
|Hah.|
The Infiniverse laughed lightly with voice carrying dark anticipation.
She closed her eyes with focused concentration.
She remembered every detail of the lesson her Master had transmitted through their connection. The structural breakdown, the precise sequence, the intentional quality required.

The rising frequency that started from baseline. The simultaneous compression that created visible density increase in concentrated energy. The sharp percussive accent that marked the critical transition point. The controlled explosion outward in geometric patterns.
She went through all the details her Master had been taught by ancient beings who understood existence’s native language.
Then she opened her eyes and looked directly toward The Disciple of THE Creature.

His attention had somehow already turned toward her as if he sensed something fundamentally wrong occurring. His laid back expression showed shock and genuine alarm for the first time in this entire battle, as if he recognized what was about to happen.

And he moved fast for the first time ever, crossing vast distance in an instant as he swung his sword with desperate urgency. Existence cried out from the force of his strike as he bellowed with serious intensity.
“How do you know that?!”
Apart from him, there was another who reacted with equal alarm.

Schrodinger, whose gaze had been clear and focused throughout the battle, became slightly hazy for a brief moment. As if someone else far grander was momentarily seeing through his eyes, borrowing his perception to observe this impossible event.
And that distant gaze was frowning with deep concern.
Khor was shocked at the sudden eruption of unique power signatures she did not recognize. But The Infiniverse remained exactly where she stood at this moment without moving to defend or retreat.
For the first time since her creation, she spoke in a language older than her Master’s existence.
|Fire.|
She spoke it in The First Tongue.
The word manifested as a perfectly structured Phoneme, carrying all the components her Master had been taught. Rising frequency, compression, accent, expansion, intent.

It was extraordinarily difficult to say which entity in existence was more utterly obscene. Noah, who had spoken his first Phoneme successfully on his initial attempt, or his construct who was given transmitted information about a lesson and successfully uttered her first letter with actual meaning on her very first attempt as well.
She spoke the letter representing Fire in existence’s native language.
And in this region of collapse where reality had been shattered, Principles not even understood by most entities here moved of their own volition in response.
The Principle of Consuming Transformation. The Principle of Primordial Combustion. The Principle of Existential Ignition. And others that had no names in conventional language.
All of them responded to the properly spoken Phoneme.
And... Existence itself began to burn.

Not merely the space or the matter or the energy in this region. Existence as a concept, the fundamental fabric that allowed anything to be, erupted into flames that transcended conventional understanding.

Blue gold fire mixed with silver white radiance spread outward from The Infiniverse’s position with catastrophic speed. The flames burned through collapsed reality, through dimensional barriers, through the very concept of spatial limitation!
The Disciple of THE Creature’s sword strike, carrying a glimmer of Genesis Principle authority, met the expanding wall of existential fire head on.
The collision created an explosion that briefly illuminated the entire collapsed domain like a second sun being born!
Many across the vast expanses of existence wondered about The Disciples of THE Creature with a mixture of fear and curiosity.

They pondered exactly what a terrifying entity like THE Creature could have possibly taught his disciples to make them so formidable. What knowledge could the entity that held The Way of Existence itself as his fundamental path impart to those who followed him?
What secrets did he share? What techniques did he demonstrate? What Principles did he illuminate?
The answer was far easier to comprehend than many realized, though no less profound for its simplicity.

THE Creature taught his disciples the same thing Existence taught to all who truly listened. The same lesson that reality demonstrated with every passing moment, every transformation, every beginning and ending across all domains and all time.

THE Creature did not need to create elaborate techniques or invent complex methodologies. He simply showed his disciples how existence already functioned at its deepest levels, then taught them to work with those fundamental mechanics rather than against them.
What he taught them... could very easily be inferred!
